 425 |   <script type="module">
 426 |     /**
 427 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 428 |      *
 429 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 430 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 431 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 432 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 433 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 434 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 435 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 436 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 437 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 438 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 439 |      *
 440 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 441 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 442 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 443 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 444 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 445 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 446 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 447 |      */
 448 | 
 449 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 450 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 451 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';

 483 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 484 |     /**
 485 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 486 |      */
 487 | 
 488 |     /**
 489 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 490 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 491 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 492 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 493 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 494 |      */
 495 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 496 | 
 497 |     /**
 498 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 499 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 500 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 501 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 502 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 503 |      */
 504 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 505 | 
 506 |     /**
 507 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 508 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 509 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 510 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 511 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 512 |      */
 513 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 514 | 
 515 |     /**
 516 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 517 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 518 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 519 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 520 |      */
 521 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 522 | 
 523 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 524 |     /**
 525 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 526 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 527 |      */
 528 | 
 529 |     /**
 530 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 531 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 532 |      */
 533 |     let externalProgress = null;
 534 | 
 535 |     /**
 536 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 537 |      * Supports two message types:
 538 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 539 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 540 |      */
 541 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 542 |       const data = e && e.data;
 543 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 544 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 545 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 546 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 547 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 548 |         externalProgress = null;
 549 |       }
 550 |     });
 551 | 
 552 |     /**
 553 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 554 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 555 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 556 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 557 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 558 |      */
 559 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 560 | 
 561 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 562 |     /**
 563 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 564 |      */
 565 | 
 566 |     /**
 567 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 568 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 569 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 570 |      */
 571 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 572 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 573 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 574 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 575 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 576 |     }
 577 | 
 578 |     /**
 579 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 580 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 581 |      */
 582 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 583 | 
 584 |     /**
 585 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 586 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 587 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 588 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 589 |      */
 590 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 591 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 592 |       const res = [];
 593 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 594 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 595 |       }
 596 |       return res;
 597 |     }
 598 | 
 599 |     /**
 600 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 601 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 602 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 603 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 604 |      */
 605 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 606 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 607 |       for (const c of corners) {
 608 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 609 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 610 |       }
 611 |       return true;
 612 |     }
 613 | 
 614 |     /**
 615 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 616 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 617 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 618 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 619 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 620 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 621 |      */
 622 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 623 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 624 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 625 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 626 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 627 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 628 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 629 |       }
 630 |       return lo;
 631 |     }

 633 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 634 |     /**
 635 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 636 |      *
 637 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 638 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 639 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 640 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 641 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 642 |      *
 643 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 644 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 645 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 646 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 647 |      *
 648 |      * CACHING:
 649 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 650 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 651 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 652 |      */
 653 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 654 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 655 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 656 | 
 657 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 658 | 
 659 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 660 |       .then(response => response.json())
 661 |       .then(data => {
 662 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 663 |       })
 664 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 665 | 
 666 |     /**
 667 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 668 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 669 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 670 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 671 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 672 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 673 |      */
 674 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 675 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 676 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 677 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 678 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 679 | 
 680 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 681 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 682 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 683 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 684 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 685 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 686 | 
 687 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 688 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 689 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 690 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 691 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 692 |       ctx.fill();
 693 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 694 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 695 |       /**
 696 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 697 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 698 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 699 |        */
 700 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 701 |         ctx.save();
 702 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 703 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 704 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 705 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 706 | 
 707 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 708 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 709 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 710 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 711 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 712 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 713 | 
 714 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 715 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 716 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 717 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 718 |           // Vertical lines
 719 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 720 |             ctx.beginPath();
 721 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 722 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 723 |             ctx.stroke();
 724 |           }
 725 |           // Horizontal lines
 726 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 727 |             ctx.beginPath();
 728 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 729 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 730 |             ctx.stroke();
 731 |           }
 732 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 733 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 734 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 735 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 736 |             ctx.beginPath();
 737 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 738 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 739 |             ctx.stroke();
 740 |           }
 741 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 742 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 743 |           ctx.beginPath();
 744 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 745 |           ctx.stroke();
 746 |           ctx.beginPath();
 747 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 748 |           ctx.stroke();
 749 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 750 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 751 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 752 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 753 |             ctx.beginPath();
 754 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 755 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 756 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 757 |             ctx.stroke();
 758 |           }
 759 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 760 |           // Hexagon pattern
 761 |           const r = size*0.22;
 762 |           ctx.beginPath();
 763 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 764 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 765 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 766 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 767 |           }
 768 |           ctx.closePath();
 769 |           ctx.stroke();
 770 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 771 |           // Sine wave pattern
 772 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 773 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 774 |             ctx.beginPath();
 775 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 776 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 777 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 778 |             }
 779 |             ctx.stroke();
 780 |           }
 781 |         }
 782 |         ctx.restore();
 783 |       };
 784 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 785 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 786 | 
 787 |       if (drawGloss) {
 788 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 789 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 790 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 791 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 792 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 793 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 794 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 795 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 796 |         ctx.fill();
 797 |       }
 798 | 
 799 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 800 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 801 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 802 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 803 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 804 |       return tex;
 805 |     }
 806 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 807 | 
 808 |     /**
 809 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 810 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 811 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 812 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 813 |      */
 814 |     function shuffle(array) {
 815 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 816 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 817 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 818 |       }
 819 |       return array;
 820 |     }
 821 | 
 822 |     /**
 823 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 824 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 825 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 826 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 827 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 828 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 829 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 830 |      */
 831 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 832 |       ctx.beginPath();
 833 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 834 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 835 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 836 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 837 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 838 |       ctx.closePath();
 839 |     }
 840 | 
 841 |     /**
 842 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 843 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 844 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 845 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 846 |      */
 847 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 848 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 849 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 850 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 851 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 852 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 853 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 854 |     }
 855 |     /**
 856 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss
 857 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 textures, one per pattern
 858 |      */
 859 |     function getLargeStickerTextures(){
 860 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs;
 861 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 862 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;
 863 |       return texs;
 864 |     }
 865 | 
 866 |     /**
 867 |      * Get cached textures for mini cubes with solid colors (no patterns, no gloss)
 868 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 solid color textures
 869 |      */
 870 |     function getMiniStickerTextures(){
 871 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs;
 872 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], false, false));
 873 |       STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs = texs;
 874 |       return texs;
 875 |     }
 876 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 877 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 878 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;
 879 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 880 |       const planes = [];
 881 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 882 |       const dirs = [
 883 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 884 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 885 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 886 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 887 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z
 888 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 889 |       ];
 890 |       dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
 891 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 892 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 893 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 894 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 895 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 896 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 897 |         mesh.add(m);
 898 |         planes.push(m);
 899 |       });
 900 |       return planes;
 901 |     }

 903 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 904 |     /**
 905 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 906 |      *
 907 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 908 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 909 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 910 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 911 |      *
 912 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 913 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 914 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 915 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 916 |      *
 917 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 918 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 919 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 920 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 921 |      *
 922 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 923 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 924 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)
 925 |      * @returns {THREE.Mesh} Configured cube mesh with edges
 926 |      */
 927 |     function makeCube(size, fillColor, edgeColor, cubeIndex = 0) {
 928 |       const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
 929 |       let mesh;
 930 | 
 931 |       if (size > 0.1) {
 932 |         if (size >= 0.99) {
 933 |           // ===== LARGE CUBE CREATION =====
 934 |           // 27 large cubes forming the initial Rubik's cube structure
 935 |           const pats = fixedFaceAssignments.length > 0 ? fixedFaceAssignments.slice() : shuffle(FACE_PATTERNS.slice()); // Randomize pattern order per cube
 936 |           // Load all 6 bump map textures
 937 |           const bumpTextures = [1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n => {
 938 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 939 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 940 |             tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 941 |             tex.repeat.set(1, 1);
 942 |             return tex;
 943 |           });
 944 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 945 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 946 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out
 947 |             color: new THREE.Color(fillColor), // Use the fillColor parameter instead of hardcoded value
 948 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],
 949 |             bumpScale: 1.0, // Maximum bump effect
 950 |             transparent: false, // Opaque for performance
 951 |             depthWrite: false, // Disable depth writing to prevent z-fighting
 952 |             depthTest: true, // Still test depth for proper ordering

1025 |     /**
1026 |      * Set fill color for all meshes in a 3D object hierarchy
1027 |      * Used for global color changes during different animation phases
1028 |      * @param {THREE.Object3D} obj3D - Root object to traverse
1029 |      * @param {number} color - Color value (hex number)

1031 |     function setCubeFillColor(obj3D, color) {
1032 |       obj3D.traverse(o => {
1033 |         if (o.isMesh && o.material) {
1034 |           if (Array.isArray(o.material)) {
1035 |             // Handle multi-material meshes (cubes with different face materials)
1036 |             o.material.forEach(m => { if (m && m.color) m.color.set(color); });
1037 |           } else {
1038 |             // Handle single-material meshes
1039 |             if (o.material.color) o.material.color.set(color);
1040 |           }
1041 |         }
1042 |       });
1043 |     }

1229 |     // ===== MINI CUBE SYSTEM (729 PIECES) =====
1230 |     /**

1261 |             m.userData.initialScale = 0.0001; // Start tiny for growth animation
1262 |             m.scale.setScalar(m.userData.initialScale);
1263 | 
1264 |             miniGroup.add(m);
1265 |             miniCubes.push(m);
1266 |           }
1267 |         }
1268 |       }
1269 |     }

1402 |     function onPointerDown(e){
1403 |       isDragging = true;
1404 |       dragLast.x = e.clientX; dragLast.y = e.clientY;
1405 |       try { canvas.setPointerCapture && canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch(_){}
1406 |       e.preventDefault();
1407 |     }
1408 |     function onPointerMove(e){
1409 |       if (!isDragging) return;
1410 |       const dx = e.clientX - dragLast.x;
1411 |       const dy = e.clientY - dragLast.y;
1412 |       dragLast.x = e.clientX; dragLast.y = e.clientY;
1413 |       if (inInteractivePhase) {
1414 |         root.rotation.y += dx * SPIN_SENS;
1415 |         root.rotation.x += dy * SPIN_SENS;
1416 |       }
1417 |       e.preventDefault();
1418 |     }
1419 |     function onPointerUp(e){
1420 |       isDragging = false;
1421 |       try { canvas.releasePointerCapture && canvas.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch(_){}
1422 |       e.preventDefault();
1423 |     }
1424 |     canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown, { passive: false });
1425 |     window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, { passive: false });
1426 |     window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp, { passive: false });

  1 | import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, forwardRef, useImperativeHandle } from 'react';
  2 | import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
  3 | import enTranslations from '../locales/en.json';
  4 | import arTranslations from '../locales/ar.json';
  5 | 
  6 | interface RubiksIframeProps {
  7 |   height?: string;
  8 |   progress?: number | null; // 0..1 to externally drive the animation; null to let iframe use its own scroll
  9 |   onReady?: () => void;
 10 |   onProgress?: (value: number) => void;
 11 |   onPhaseChange?: (id: number, label: string) => void;
 12 | }
 13 | 
 14 | const RubiksIframe = forwardRef<HTMLIFrameElement, RubiksIframeProps>(
 15 |   ({ height = '100vh', progress = null, onReady, onProgress, onPhaseChange }, ref) => {
 16 |     const iframeRef = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement | null>(null);
 17 |     const resourcesInjectedRef = useRef(false);
 18 |     const initialLanguageRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
 19 |     useImperativeHandle(ref, () => iframeRef.current as HTMLIFrameElement, []);
 20 |     const { i18n } = useTranslation();
 21 | 
 22 |   const targetOrigin = useMemo(() => '*', []);
 23 | 
 24 |   // Inject i18n resources into iframe when it loads
 25 |   useEffect(() => {
 26 |     const iframe = iframeRef.current;
 27 |     if (!iframe) return;
 28 | 
 29 |     const handleLoad = () => {
 30 |       const win = iframe.contentWindow;
 31 |       if (!win) return;
 32 | 
 33 |       console.log('[RubiksIframe] Iframe loaded, injecting i18n resources');
 34 |       // Inject i18n resources
 35 |       (win as any).i18nResources = {
 36 |         en: enTranslations,
 37 |         ar: arTranslations
 38 |       };
 39 |       resourcesInjectedRef.current = true;
 40 |       initialLanguageRef.current = i18n.language;
 41 |       console.log('[RubiksIframe] i18n resources injected. Triggering initial render with language:', i18n.language);
 42 | 
 43 |       // Trigger initial render with current language
 44 |       win.postMessage({ type: 'RENDER_OVERLAYS', lang: i18n.language }, targetOrigin);
 45 |     };
 46 | 
 47 |     iframe.addEventListener('load', handleLoad);
 48 |     return () => {
 49 |       iframe.removeEventListener('load', handleLoad);
 50 |       resourcesInjectedRef.current = false;
 51 |       initialLanguageRef.current = null;
 52 |     };
 53 |   }, [targetOrigin, i18n.language]);
 54 | 
 55 |   // Listen to messages from the iframe
 56 |   useEffect(() => {
 57 |     function handleMessage(e: MessageEvent) {
 58 |       const data = e && (e.data as any);
 59 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 60 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_READY') {
 61 |         console.log('[RubiksIframe] Received RUBIKS_READY from iframe');
 62 |         onReady && onReady();
 63 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_PROGRESS') {
 64 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 65 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) onProgress && onProgress(v);
 66 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_PHASE') {
 67 |         const id = Number(data.id);
 68 |         const label = String(data.label ?? '');
 69 |         if (!Number.isNaN(id)) onPhaseChange && onPhaseChange(id, label);
 70 |       }
 71 |     }
 72 |     window.addEventListener('message', handleMessage);
 73 |     return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handleMessage);
 74 |   }, [onReady, onProgress, onPhaseChange]);
 75 | 
 76 |   // Send language change to iframe when language changes (but not on initial render)
 77 |   useEffect(() => {
 78 |     // Skip if this is the initial language or resources not injected yet
 79 |     if (!resourcesInjectedRef.current || initialLanguageRef.current === i18n.language) {
 80 |       return;
 81 |     }
 82 | 
 83 |     const win = iframeRef.current?.contentWindow;
 84 |     if (!win) return;
 85 |     
 86 |     console.log('[RubiksIframe] Language changed from', initialLanguageRef.current, 'to', i18n.language);
 87 |     initialLanguageRef.current = i18n.language;
 88 |     win.postMessage({ type: 'RENDER_OVERLAYS', lang: i18n.language }, targetOrigin);
 89 |   }, [i18n.language, targetOrigin]);
 90 | 
 91 |   // Push progress to the iframe when provided
 92 |   useEffect(() => {
 93 |     const win = iframeRef.current?.contentWindow;
 94 |     if (!win) return;
 95 |     if (progress === null || typeof progress === 'undefined') {
 96 |       win.postMessage({ type: 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL' }, targetOrigin);
 97 |     } else {
 98 |       const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(progress)));
 99 |       if (!Number.isNaN(v)) {
100 |         win.postMessage({ type: 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS', value: v }, targetOrigin);
101 |       }
102 |     }
103 |   }, [progress, targetOrigin]);
104 | 
105 |     return (
106 |       <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height }}>
107 |         <iframe
108 |           ref={iframeRef}
109 |           src="/rubiks-cdn.html"
110 |           title="Rubiks Animation"
111 |           style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', border: 'none' }}
112 |           allow="autoplay; fullscreen; xr-spatial-tracking; clipboard-write"
113 |           sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-pointer-lock allow-top-navigation"
114 |         />
115 |       </div>
116 |     );
117 |   }
118 | );
119 | 
120 | export default RubiksIframe;

 372 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 373 |         <h1>Transforming Strategy Execution</h1>
 374 |         <h2>COMPLEXITY AS AN ASSET</h2>
 375 |         <p>Most transformations fail because complexity overwhelms. We turned that complexity into an advantage—redefining planning, risks, and dashboards inside one integrated model.</p>
 376 |       </div></section>
 377 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 378 |         <h1>Imagine a Parallel Universe</h1>
 379 |         <h2>WHERE TRANSFORMATIONS<br>
 380 | FLOW</h2>
 381 |         <p>Let us show you a week in that universe — A Week in the Life of a Transformation Team &lt;video link&gt;. Farfetched? It’s here. We built the MVP: a Net.js web app with a Supabase database and a Gemini Assistant, built on a five-year scenario dataset inspired by real transformation events.</p>
 382 |       </div></section>
 383 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 384 |         <h1>So How Did We Do It?</h1>
 385 |         <h2>THE RIGHT QUESTIONS FIRST</h2>
 386 |         <p>Before answers, you need the right questions. This journey begins by uncovering the questions that matter most—the ones that unlock how complexity really works.</p>
 387 |       </div></section>
 388 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 389 |         <h1>The Anatomy of an Organization</h1>
 390 |         <h2>WHAT MAKES AN ORGANIZATION?</h2>
 391 |         <p>Many things, like a living system of systems—Strategy, Policies, Processes, Digital  shaped by external forces such as markets and global events. Real transformation means understanding how these components interact, not treating them in isolation.</p>
 392 |       </div></section>
 393 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 394 |         <h1>The Hidden Relations</h1>
 395 |         <h2>HOW DEEP DOES IT GO?</h2>
 396 |         <p>Each component has its own inputs, outputs, and hidden ties to others. When those ties are mapped, patterns emerge—a structure that shows why small changes ripple across the whole system.</p>
 397 |       </div></section>
 398 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 399 |         <h1>The Moment of Truth</h1>
 400 |         <h2>SHOULD YOU WALK THIS JOURNEY?</h2>
 401 |         <p>We already did—and the answer is yes. But do it with eyes open. Complexity runs deeper than expected, and guidance is scarce. That’s why we built a model that captures the whole picture and makes the path navigable.</p>
 402 |       </div></section>
 403 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 404 |         <h1>Locks, Locks Everywhere</h1>
 405 |         <h2>WHAT DID 2 YEARS REVEAL?</h2>
 406 |         <p>Unlock after unlock, the journey was long and often tedious. Every piece had to be dissected, connected, and validated until a full digital twin of dependencies emerged. Just as we reached this milestone, AI leapt forward—suddenly powerful, affordable, and accessible—turning what seemed impossible into reality.</p>
 407 |       </div></section>
 408 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 409 |         <h1>The Future, Ready Today</h1>
 410 |         <h2>WHAT PATH WILL YOU CHOOSE?</h2>
 411 |         <p>With the AI core in place, the Digital Twin comes alive. We’ve hit a milestone, but the journey is still unfolding. Two paths now await: a Knowledge Path, where you contribute ideas and shape the future of transformations; and a Builder Path, where you begin your own strategy execution journey and put the twin to work.</p>
 412 |       </div></section>

 425 |   <script type="module">
 426 |     /**
 427 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 428 |      *
 429 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 430 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 431 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 432 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 433 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 434 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 435 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 436 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 437 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 438 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 439 |      *
 440 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 441 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 442 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 443 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 444 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 445 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 446 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 447 |      */
 448 | 
 449 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 450 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 451 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 452 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 453 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 454 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 455 | 
 456 |     // Background video speed control
 457 |     const bgVideo = document.querySelector('.bg-video');
 458 |     const VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE = 0.4;
 459 |     function applyVideoSpeed() { 
 460 |       try { if (bgVideo) bgVideo.playbackRate = VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE; } catch(_){}
 461 |     }
 462 |     if (bgVideo) { bgVideo.addEventListener('loadeddata', applyVideoSpeed); bgVideo.addEventListener('play', applyVideoSpeed); }
 463 |     applyVideoSpeed();
 464 | 
 465 |     // ===== ENHANCED NAVIGATION FOR FINALE BUTTONS =====
 466 |     function handleNavigation(e) {
 467 |       e.preventDefault();
 468 |       const navPath = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('href');
 469 |       if (navPath && window.top) {
 470 |         window.top.location.hash = navPath;
 471 |       }
 472 |     }
 473 | 
 474 |     function initializeNavigation() {
 475 |       const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.finale-enter-btn');
 476 |       btns.forEach(btn => {
 477 |         btn.addEventListener('click', handleNavigation);
 478 |       });
 479 |     }
 480 |     
 481 |     setTimeout(initializeNavigation, 200); // Increased timeout for safety
 482 | 
 483 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 484 |     /**
 485 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 486 |      */
 487 | 
 488 |     /**
 489 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 490 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 491 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 492 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 493 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 494 |      */
 495 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 496 | 
 497 |     /**
 498 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 499 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 500 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 501 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 502 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 503 |      */
 504 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 505 | 
 506 |     /**
 507 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 508 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 509 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 510 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 511 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 512 |      */
 513 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 514 | 
 515 |     /**
 516 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 517 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 518 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 519 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 520 |      */
 521 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 522 | 
 523 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 524 |     /**
 525 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 526 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 527 |      */
 528 | 
 529 |     /**
 530 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 531 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 532 |      */
 533 |     let externalProgress = null;
 534 | 
 535 |     /**
 536 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 537 |      * Supports two message types:
 538 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 539 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 540 |      */
 541 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 542 |       const data = e && e.data;
 543 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 544 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 545 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 546 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 547 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 548 |         externalProgress = null;
 549 |       }
 550 |     });
 551 | 
 552 |     /**
 553 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 554 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 555 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 556 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 557 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 558 |      */
 559 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 560 | 
 561 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 562 |     /**
 563 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 564 |      */
 565 | 
 566 |     /**
 567 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 568 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 569 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 570 |      */
 571 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 572 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 573 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 574 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 575 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 576 |     }
 577 | 
 578 |     /**
 579 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 580 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 581 |      */
 582 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 583 | 
 584 |     /**
 585 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 586 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 587 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 588 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 589 |      */
 590 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 591 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 592 |       const res = [];
 593 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 594 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 595 |       }
 596 |       return res;
 597 |     }
 598 | 
 599 |     /**
 600 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 601 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 602 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 603 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 604 |      */
 605 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 606 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 607 |       for (const c of corners) {
 608 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 609 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 610 |       }
 611 |       return true;
 612 |     }
 613 | 
 614 |     /**
 615 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 616 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 617 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 618 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 619 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 620 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 621 |      */
 622 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 623 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 624 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 625 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 626 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 627 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 628 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 629 |       }
 630 |       return lo;
 631 |     }

 633 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 634 |     /**
 635 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 636 |      *
 637 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 638 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 639 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 640 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 641 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 642 |      *
 643 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 644 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 645 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 646 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 647 |      *
 648 |      * CACHING:
 649 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 650 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 651 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 652 |      */
 653 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 654 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 655 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 656 | 
 657 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 658 | 
 659 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 660 |       .then(response => response.json())
 661 |       .then(data => {
 662 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 663 |       })
 664 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 665 | 
 666 |     /**
 667 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 668 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 669 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 670 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 671 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 672 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 673 |      */
 674 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 675 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 676 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 677 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 678 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 679 | 
 680 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 681 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 682 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 683 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 684 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 685 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 686 | 
 687 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 688 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 689 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 690 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 691 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 692 |       ctx.fill();
 693 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 694 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 695 |       /**
 696 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 697 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 698 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 699 |        */
 700 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 701 |         ctx.save();
 702 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 703 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 704 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 705 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 706 | 
 707 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 708 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 709 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 710 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 711 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 712 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 713 | 
 714 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 715 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 716 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 717 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 718 |           // Vertical lines
 719 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 720 |             ctx.beginPath();
 721 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 722 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 723 |             ctx.stroke();
 724 |           }
 725 |           // Horizontal lines
 726 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 727 |             ctx.beginPath();
 728 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 729 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 730 |             ctx.stroke();
 731 |           }
 732 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 733 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 734 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 735 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 736 |             ctx.beginPath();
 737 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 738 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 739 |             ctx.stroke();
 740 |           }
 741 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 742 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 743 |           ctx.beginPath();
 744 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 745 |           ctx.stroke();
 746 |           ctx.beginPath();
 747 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 748 |           ctx.stroke();
 749 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 750 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 751 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 752 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 753 |             ctx.beginPath();
 754 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 755 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 756 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 757 |             ctx.stroke();
 758 |           }
 759 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 760 |           // Hexagon pattern
 761 |           const r = size*0.22;
 762 |           ctx.beginPath();
 763 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 764 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 765 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 766 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 767 |           }
 768 |           ctx.closePath();
 769 |           ctx.stroke();
 770 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 771 |           // Sine wave pattern
 772 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 773 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 774 |             ctx.beginPath();
 775 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 776 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 777 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 778 |             }
 779 |             ctx.stroke();
 780 |           }
 781 |         }
 782 |         ctx.restore();
 783 |       };
 784 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 785 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 786 | 
 787 |       if (drawGloss) {
 788 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 789 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 790 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 791 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 792 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 793 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 794 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 795 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 796 |         ctx.fill();
 797 |       }
 798 | 
 799 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 800 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 801 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 802 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 803 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 804 |       return tex;
 805 |     }
 806 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 807 | 
 808 |     /**
 809 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 810 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 811 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 812 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 813 |      */
 814 |     function shuffle(array) {
 815 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 816 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 817 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 818 |       }
 819 |       return array;
 820 |     }
 821 | 
 822 |     /**
 823 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 824 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 825 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 826 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 827 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 828 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 829 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 830 |      */
 831 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 832 |       ctx.beginPath();
 833 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 834 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 835 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 836 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 837 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 838 |       ctx.closePath();
 839 |     }
 840 | 
 841 |     /**
 842 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 843 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 844 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 845 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 846 |      */
 847 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 848 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 849 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 850 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 851 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 852 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 853 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 854 |     }
 855 |     /**
 856 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss
 857 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 textures, one per pattern
 858 |      */
 859 |     function getLargeStickerTextures(){
 860 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs;
 861 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 862 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;
 863 |       return texs;
 864 |     }
 865 | 
 866 |     /**
 867 |      * Get cached textures for mini cubes with solid colors (no patterns, no gloss)
 868 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 solid color textures
 869 |      */
 870 |     function getMiniStickerTextures(){
 871 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs;
 872 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], false, false));
 873 |       STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs = texs;
 874 |       return texs;
 875 |     }
 876 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 877 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 878 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;
 879 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 880 |       const planes = [];
 881 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 882 |       const dirs = [
 883 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 884 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 885 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 886 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 887 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z
 888 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 889 |       ];
 890 |       dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
 891 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 892 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 893 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 894 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 895 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 896 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 897 |         mesh.add(m);
 898 |         planes.push(m);
 899 |       });
 900 |       return planes;
 901 |     }

 903 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 904 |     /**
 905 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 906 |      *
 907 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 908 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 909 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 910 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 911 |      *
 912 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 913 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 914 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 915 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 916 |      *
 917 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 918 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 919 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 920 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 921 |      *
 922 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 923 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 924 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)
 925 |      * @returns {THREE.Mesh} Configured cube mesh with edges
 926 |      */
 927 |     function makeCube(size, fillColor, edgeColor, cubeIndex = 0) {

 929 |       let mesh;
 930 | 
 931 |       if (size > 0.1) {
 932 |         if (size >= 0.99) {
 933 |           // ===== LARGE CUBE CREATION =====
 934 |           // 27 large cubes forming the initial Rubik's cube structure
 935 |           const pats = fixedFaceAssignments.length > 0 ? fixedFaceAssignments.slice() : shuffle(FACE_PATTERNS.slice()); // Randomize pattern order per cube
 936 |           // Load all 6 bump map textures
 937 |           const bumpTextures = [1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n => {
 938 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 939 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 940 |             tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 941 |             tex.repeat.set(1, 1);
 942 |             return tex;
 943 |           });
 944 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 945 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 946 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out
 947 |             color: new THREE.Color(fillColor), // Use the fillColor parameter instead of hardcoded value
 948 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],
 949 |             bumpScale: 1.0, // Maximum bump effect
 950 |             transparent: false, // Opaque for performance
 951 |             depthWrite: false, // Disable depth writing to prevent z-fighting
 952 |             depthTest: true, // Still test depth for proper ordering
 953 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides (important for cube faces)
 954 |             metalness: 1.0, // Fully metallic
 955 |             roughness: 0.1, // Very shiny
 956 |             polygonOffset: true, // Offset depth to prevent z-fighting with edges

 961 |         } else {

 964 |          // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 965 |           // --- ORIGINAL MINI CUBE MATERIAL CREATION (commented out) ---
 966 |           // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({

 968 |           //   transparent: false, // Opaque
 969 |           //   opacity: 1.0, // Fully opaque
 970 |           //   depthWrite: true, // Enable depth writing to prevent see-through
 971 |           //   depthTest: true, // Test depth
 972 |           //   side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides
 973 |           //   metalness: 0.25, // Balanced metallic feel
 974 |           //   roughness: 0.5 // Balanced surface roughness
 975 |           // });
 976 |           // mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
 977 | 
 978 |           // --- MINI CUBE MATERIAL WITH NO GLOW/EMISSIVE ---
 979 |           const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 980 |             color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC),
 981 |             transparent: false,
 982 |             opacity: 1.0,
 983 |             depthWrite: true,
 984 |             depthTest: true,
 985 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide,
 986 |             metalness: 0.25,
 987 |             roughness: 0.5,
 988 |             emissive: new THREE.Color(0x000000), // No glow
 989 |             emissiveIntensity: 0.0 // No glow

 991 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
 992 |         }
 993 |       } else {

1000 |           clearcoat: 1.0, // Clear coat layer for extra shine
1001 |           clearcoatRoughness: 0.15, // Smooth clear coat
1002 | //          envMapIntensity: 1.2 // Environment reflection intensity
1003 |         });
1004 |         mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat); // Single material for all faces
1005 |       }
1006 |       // ===== MESH CONFIGURATION =====
1007 |       mesh.castShadow = true; // Cast shadows for depth
1008 |       mesh.receiveShadow = true; // Receive shadows from other objects
1009 | 
1010 |       // ===== EDGE CREATION =====
1011 |       // Add edges for all cubes, but make mini-cube edges very thin
1012 |       const edges = new THREE.LineSegments(

1450 |      * PHASE TIMING (as percentage of total scroll):

1453 |      * 3: 12.06-14.48% - Pieces settle with random rotations
1454 |      * 4: 14.48-31.38% - Large cubes shrink, mini-cubes emerge
1455 |      * 5: 31.38-43.0% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud
1456 |      * 6: 43.0-52.0% - Mini-cubes recolor cyan to purple one-by-one
1457 |      * 7: 52.0-62.0% - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
1458 |      * 8: 62.0-70.0% - Transform into final spherical sculpture
1459 |      * 9: 70.0-100% - Interactive final formation with mouse controls

 244 |             return window.parent.document.documentElement.lang;

 246 |         } catch (e) {}

 248 |         if (params.get('lang')) return params.get('lang');
 249 |         return 'en';
 250 |       }
 251 | 
 252 |        // Define overlayRoot before renderOverlays function
 253 |        const overlayRoot = document.getElementById(\'phaseOverlay\');
 254 | 
 255 | function renderOverlays(forceLang) {
 256 |   let lang = forceLang || getLang();
 257 |   lang = lang && lang.startsWith('ar') ? 'ar' : 'en';
 258 |   console.log('[renderOverlays] Step 1: Language =', lang);

 273 |  // console.log('[renderOverlays] Step 5: Starting to process keys');
 274 | 
 275 |         overlayKeys.forEach(key => {

 301 |                   </div>

 303 |               </div>

 308 |                 <h1>${data.h1}</h1>
 309 |                 <h2>${data.h2}</h2>
 310 |                 <p>${data.p}</p>
 311 |               </div>
 312 |             `;
 313 |           }
 314 |         });  //this closes forEach
 315 |         console.log('[renderOverlays] Step 6: Final HTML length =', 
 316 |         overlayInner.innerHTML.length);
 317 | 
 318 |   console.log('[renderOverlays] Final HTML =', overlayInner.innerHTML.length, 'chars');
 319 |

 375 |     <div class="hero-row">
 376 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 377 |         <h1>Transforming Strategy Execution</h1>
 378 |         <h2>COMPLEXITY AS AN ASSET</h2>
 379 |         <p>Most transformations fail because complexity overwhelms. We turned that complexity into an advantage—redefining planning, risks, and dashboards inside one integrated model.</p>
 380 |       </div></section>
 381 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 382 |         <h1>Imagine a Parallel Universe</h1>
 383 |         <h2>WHERE TRANSFORMATIONS<br>
 384 | FLOW</h2>
 385 |         <p>Let us show you a week in that universe — A Week in the Life of a Transformation Team &lt;video link&gt;. Farfetched? It’s here. We built the MVP: a Net.js web app with a Supabase database and a Gemini Assistant, built on a five-year scenario dataset inspired by real transformation events.</p>
 386 |       </div></section>
 387 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 388 |         <h1>So How Did We Do It?</h1>
 389 |         <h2>THE RIGHT QUESTIONS FIRST</h2>
 390 |         <p>Before answers, you need the right questions. This journey begins by uncovering the questions that matter most—the ones that unlock how complexity really works.</p>
 391 |       </div></section>
 392 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 393 |         <h1>The Anatomy of an Organization</h1>
 394 |         <h2>WHAT MAKES AN ORGANIZATION?</h2>
 395 |         <p>Many things, like a living system of systems—Strategy, Policies, Processes, Digital  shaped by external forces such as markets and global events. Real transformation means understanding how these components interact, not treating them in isolation.</p>
 396 |       </div></section>
 397 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 398 |         <h1>The Hidden Relations</h1>
 399 |         <h2>HOW DEEP DOES IT GO?</h2>
 400 |         <p>Each component has its own inputs, outputs, and hidden ties to others. When those ties are mapped, patterns emerge—a structure that shows why small changes ripple across the whole system.</p>
 401 |       </div></section>
 402 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 403 |         <h1>The Moment of Truth</h1>
 404 |         <h2>SHOULD YOU WALK THIS JOURNEY?</h2>
 405 |         <p>We already did—and the answer is yes. But do it with eyes open. Complexity runs deeper than expected, and guidance is scarce. That’s why we built a model that captures the whole picture and makes the path navigable.</p>
 406 |       </div></section>
 407 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 408 |         <h1>Locks, Locks Everywhere</h1>
 409 |         <h2>WHAT DID 2 YEARS REVEAL?</h2>
 410 |         <p>Unlock after unlock, the journey was long and often tedious. Every piece had to be dissected, connected, and validated until a full digital twin of dependencies emerged. Just as we reached this milestone, AI leapt forward—suddenly powerful, affordable, and accessible—turning what seemed impossible into reality.</p>
 411 |       </div></section>
 412 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 413 |         <h1>The Future, Ready Today</h1>
 414 |         <h2>WHAT PATH WILL YOU CHOOSE?</h2>
 415 |         <p>With the AI core in place, the Digital Twin comes alive. We’ve hit a milestone, but the journey is still unfolding. Two paths now await: a Knowledge Path, where you contribute ideas and shape the future of transformations; and a Builder Path, where you begin your own strategy execution journey and put the twin to work.</p>
 416 |       </div></section>

 429 |   <script type="module">
 430 |     /**
 431 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 432 |      *
 433 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 434 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 435 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 436 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 437 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 438 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 439 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 440 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 441 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 442 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 443 |      *
 444 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 445 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 446 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 447 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 448 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 449 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 450 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 451 |      */
 452 | 
 453 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 454 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 455 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 456 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 457 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 458 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 459 | 
 460 |     // Background video speed control
 461 |     const bgVideo = document.querySelector('.bg-video');
 462 |     const VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE = 0.4;
 463 |     function applyVideoSpeed() { 
 464 |       try { if (bgVideo) bgVideo.playbackRate = VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE; } catch(_){}
 465 |     }
 466 |     if (bgVideo) { bgVideo.addEventListener('loadeddata', applyVideoSpeed); bgVideo.addEventListener('play', applyVideoSpeed); }
 467 |     applyVideoSpeed();
 468 | 
 469 |     // ===== ENHANCED NAVIGATION FOR FINALE BUTTONS =====
 470 |     function handleNavigation(e) {
 471 |       e.preventDefault();
 472 |       const navPath = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('href');
 473 |       if (navPath && window.top) {
 474 |         window.top.location.hash = navPath;
 475 |       }
 476 |     }
 477 | 
 478 |     function initializeNavigation() {
 479 |       const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.finale-enter-btn');
 480 |       btns.forEach(btn => {
 481 |         btn.addEventListener('click', handleNavigation);
 482 |       });
 483 |     }
 484 |     
 485 |     setTimeout(initializeNavigation, 200); // Increased timeout for safety
 486 | 
 487 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 488 |     /**
 489 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 490 |      */
 491 | 
 492 |     /**
 493 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 494 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 495 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 496 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 497 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 498 |      */
 499 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 500 | 
 501 |     /**
 502 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 503 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 504 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 505 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 506 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 507 |      */
 508 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 509 | 
 510 |     /**
 511 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 512 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 513 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 514 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 515 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 516 |      */
 517 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 518 | 
 519 |     /**
 520 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 521 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 522 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 523 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 524 |      */
 525 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 526 | 
 527 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 528 |     /**
 529 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 530 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 531 |      */
 532 | 
 533 |     /**
 534 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 535 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 536 |      */
 537 |     let externalProgress = null;
 538 | 
 539 |     /**
 540 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 541 |      * Supports two message types:
 542 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 543 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 544 |      */
 545 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 546 |       const data = e && e.data;
 547 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 548 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 549 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 550 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 551 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 552 |         externalProgress = null;
 553 |       }
 554 |     });
 555 | 
 556 |     /**
 557 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 558 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 559 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 560 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 561 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 562 |      */
 563 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 564 | 
 565 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 566 |     /**
 567 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 568 |      */
 569 | 
 570 |     /**
 571 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 572 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 573 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 574 |      */
 575 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 576 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 577 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 578 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 579 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 580 |     }
 581 | 
 582 |     /**
 583 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 584 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 585 |      */
 586 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 587 | 
 588 |     /**
 589 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 590 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 591 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 592 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 593 |      */
 594 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 595 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 596 |       const res = [];
 597 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 598 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 599 |       }
 600 |       return res;
 601 |     }
 602 | 
 603 |     /**
 604 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 605 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 606 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 607 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 608 |      */
 609 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 610 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 611 |       for (const c of corners) {
 612 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 613 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 614 |       }
 615 |       return true;
 616 |     }
 617 | 
 618 |     /**
 619 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 620 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 621 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 622 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 623 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 624 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 625 |      */
 626 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 627 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 628 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 629 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 630 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 631 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 632 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 633 |       }
 634 |       return lo;
 635 |     }
