 637 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 638 |     /**
 639 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 640 |      *
 641 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 642 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 643 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 644 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 645 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 646 |      *
 647 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 648 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 649 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 650 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 651 |      *
 652 |      * CACHING:
 653 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 654 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 655 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 656 |      */
 657 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 658 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 659 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 660 | 
 661 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 662 | 
 663 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 664 |       .then(response => response.json())
 665 |       .then(data => {
 666 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 667 |       })
 668 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 669 | 
 670 |     /**
 671 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 672 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 673 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 674 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 675 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 676 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 677 |      */
 678 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 679 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 680 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 681 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 682 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 683 | 
 684 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 685 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 686 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 687 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 688 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 689 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 690 | 
 691 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 692 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 693 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 694 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 695 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 696 |       ctx.fill();
 697 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 698 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 699 |       /**
 700 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 701 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 702 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 703 |        */
 704 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 705 |         ctx.save();
 706 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 707 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 708 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 709 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 710 | 
 711 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 712 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 713 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 714 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 715 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 716 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 717 | 
 718 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 719 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 720 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 721 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 722 |           // Vertical lines
 723 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 724 |             ctx.beginPath();
 725 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 726 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 727 |             ctx.stroke();
 728 |           }
 729 |           // Horizontal lines
 730 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 731 |             ctx.beginPath();
 732 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 733 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 734 |             ctx.stroke();
 735 |           }
 736 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 737 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 738 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 739 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 740 |             ctx.beginPath();
 741 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 742 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 743 |             ctx.stroke();
 744 |           }
 745 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 746 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 747 |           ctx.beginPath();
 748 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 749 |           ctx.stroke();
 750 |           ctx.beginPath();
 751 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 752 |           ctx.stroke();
 753 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 754 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 755 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 756 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 757 |             ctx.beginPath();
 758 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 759 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 760 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 761 |             ctx.stroke();
 762 |           }
 763 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 764 |           // Hexagon pattern
 765 |           const r = size*0.22;
 766 |           ctx.beginPath();
 767 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 768 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 769 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 770 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 771 |           }
 772 |           ctx.closePath();
 773 |           ctx.stroke();
 774 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 775 |           // Sine wave pattern
 776 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 777 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 778 |             ctx.beginPath();
 779 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 780 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 781 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 782 |             }
 783 |             ctx.stroke();
 784 |           }
 785 |         }
 786 |         ctx.restore();
 787 |       };
 788 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 789 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 790 | 
 791 |       if (drawGloss) {
 792 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 793 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 794 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 795 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 796 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 797 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 798 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 799 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 800 |         ctx.fill();
 801 |       }
 802 | 
 803 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 804 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 805 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 806 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 807 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 808 |       return tex;
 809 |     }
 810 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 811 | 
 812 |     /**
 813 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 814 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 815 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 816 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 817 |      */
 818 |     function shuffle(array) {
 819 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 820 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 821 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 822 |       }
 823 |       return array;
 824 |     }
 825 | 
 826 |     /**
 827 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 828 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 829 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 830 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 831 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 832 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 833 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 834 |      */
 835 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 836 |       ctx.beginPath();
 837 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 838 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 839 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 840 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 841 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 842 |       ctx.closePath();
 843 |     }
 844 | 
 845 |     /**
 846 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 847 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 848 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 849 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 850 |      */
 851 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 852 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 853 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 854 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 855 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 856 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 857 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 858 |     }
 859 |     /**
 860 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss
 861 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 textures, one per pattern
 862 |      */
 863 |     function getLargeStickerTextures(){
 864 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs;
 865 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 866 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;
 867 |       return texs;
 868 |     }
 869 | 
 870 |     /**
 871 |      * Get cached textures for mini cubes with solid colors (no patterns, no gloss)
 872 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 solid color textures
 873 |      */
 874 |     function getMiniStickerTextures(){
 875 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs;
 876 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], false, false));
 877 |       STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs = texs;
 878 |       return texs;
 879 |     }
 880 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 881 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 882 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;
 883 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 884 |       const planes = [];
 885 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 886 |       const dirs = [
 887 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 888 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 889 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 890 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 891 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z
 892 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 893 |       ];
 894 |       dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
 895 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 896 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 897 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 898 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 899 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 900 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 901 |         mesh.add(m);
 902 |         planes.push(m);
 903 |       });
 904 |       return planes;
 905 |     }

 907 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 908 |     /**
 909 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 910 |      *
 911 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 912 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 913 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 914 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 915 |      *
 916 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 917 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 918 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 919 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 920 |      *
 921 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 922 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 923 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 924 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 925 |      *
 926 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 927 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 928 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)
 929 |      * @returns {THREE.Mesh} Configured cube mesh with edges
 930 |      */
 931 |     function makeCube(size, fillColor, edgeColor, cubeIndex = 0) {
 932 |       const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
 933 |       let mesh;
 934 | 
 935 |       if (size > 0.1) {
 936 |         if (size >= 0.99) {
 937 |           // ===== LARGE CUBE CREATION =====
 938 |           // 27 large cubes forming the initial Rubik's cube structure
 939 |           const pats = fixedFaceAssignments.length > 0 ? fixedFaceAssignments.slice() : shuffle(FACE_PATTERNS.slice()); // Randomize pattern order per cube
 940 |           // Load all 6 bump map textures
 941 |           const bumpTextures = [1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n => {
 942 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 943 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 944 |             tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 945 |             tex.repeat.set(1, 1);
 946 |             return tex;
 947 |           });
 948 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 949 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 950 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out
 951 |             color: new THREE.Color(fillColor), // Use the fillColor parameter instead of hardcoded value
 952 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],
 953 |             bumpScale: 1.0, // Maximum bump effect
 954 |             transparent: false, // Opaque for performance
 955 |             depthWrite: false, // Disable depth writing to prevent z-fighting
 956 |             depthTest: true, // Still test depth for proper ordering
 957 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides (important for cube faces)
 958 |             metalness: 1.0, // Fully metallic
 959 |             roughness: 0.1, // Very shiny
 960 |             polygonOffset: true, // Offset depth to prevent z-fighting with edges
 961 |             polygonOffsetFactor: -4,
 962 |             polygonOffsetUnits: -4
 963 |           }));
 964 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mats); // Array of 6 materials, one per face
 965 |         } else {
 966 |           // ===== MINI CUBE CREATION =====
 967 |           // 729 mini cubes that emerge from within large cubes
 968 |          // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 969 |           // --- ORIGINAL MINI CUBE MATERIAL CREATION (commented out) ---
 970 |           // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 971 |           //   color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC), // Blue color for mini-cubes
 972 |           //   transparent: false, // Opaque
 973 |           //   opacity: 1.0, // Fully opaque
 974 |           //   depthWrite: true, // Enable depth writing to prevent see-through
 975 |           //   depthTest: true, // Test depth
 976 |           //   side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides
 977 |           //   metalness: 0.25, // Balanced metallic feel
 978 |           //   roughness: 0.5 // Balanced surface roughness
 979 |           // });
 980 |           // mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
 981 | 
 982 |           // --- MINI CUBE MATERIAL WITH NO GLOW/EMISSIVE ---
 983 |           const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 984 |             color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC),
 985 |             transparent: false,
 986 |             opacity: 1.0,
 987 |             depthWrite: true,
 988 |             depthTest: true,
 989 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide,
 990 |             metalness: 0.25,
 991 |             roughness: 0.5,
 992 |             emissive: new THREE.Color(0x000000), // No glow
 993 |             emissiveIntensity: 0.0 // No glow
 994 |           });

1043 |             if (o.material.color) o.material.color.set(color);
1044 |           }
1045 |         }
1046 |       });
1047 |     }

1449 |     // ===== ANIMATION PHASE SYSTEM =====
1450 |     /**
1451 |      * 9 distinct animation phases triggered by scroll progress
1452 |      * Each phase has specific timing, behavior, and visual characteristics
1453 |      *
1454 |      * PHASE TIMING (as percentage of total scroll):
1455 |      * 1: 0.00-2.01% - Initial idle state with gentle floating
1456 |      * 2: 2.01-12.06% - Large cubes explode into cloud formation
1457 |      * 3: 12.06-14.48% - Pieces settle with random rotations
1458 |      * 4: 14.48-31.38% - Large cubes shrink, mini-cubes emerge
1459 |      * 5: 31.38-43.0% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud
1460 |      * 6: 43.0-52.0% - Mini-cubes recolor cyan to purple one-by-one
1461 |      * 7: 52.0-62.0% - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
1462 |      * 8: 62.0-70.0% - Transform into final spherical sculpture
1463 |      * 9: 70.0-100% - Interactive final formation with mouse controls
1464 |      */
1465 |     const PHASES = [
1466 |       { id: 1, start: 0.00, end: 0.0201, label: 'Phase 1 — Idle / Gentle Float' },
1467 |       { id: 2, start: 0.0201, end: 0.1206, label: 'Phase 2 — First Dismantle / Dramatic Cloud' },
1468 |       { id: 3, start: 0.1206, end: 0.1448, label: 'Phase 3 — Settle with Perspective' },
1469 |       { id: 4, start: 0.1448, end: 0.3138, label: 'Phase 4 — Rubik Transform' },

- **public/rubiks-cdn.html**: Added `overlayRoot` definition and fixed overlayBlocks initialization
- **src/locales/en.json**: Fixed JSON syntax and added complete Arabic translations

- ✅ Displays text in both English and Arabic
- ✅ Properly animates text blocks as you scroll through phases

The complete end-to-end localization system is now functional and the text animation works perfectly with the 3D cube transformations.</result>

 377 |         <h1>Transforming Strategy Execution</h1>
 378 |         <h2>COMPLEXITY AS AN ASSET</h2>
 379 |         <p>Most transformations fail because complexity overwhelms. We turned that complexity into an advantage—redefining planning, risks, and dashboards inside one integrated model.</p>

 382 |         <h1>Imagine a Parallel Universe</h1>
 383 |         <h2>WHERE TRANSFORMATIONS<br>
 384 | FLOW</h2>
 385 |         <p>Let us show you a week in that universe — A Week in the Life of a Transformation Team &lt;video link&gt;. Farfetched? It’s here. We built the MVP: a Net.js web app with a Supabase database and a Gemini Assistant, built on a five-year scenario dataset inspired by real transformation events.</p>

 393 |         <h1>The Anatomy of an Organization</h1>
 394 |         <h2>WHAT MAKES AN ORGANIZATION?</h2>
 395 |         <p>Many things, like a living system of systems—Strategy, Policies, Processes, Digital  shaped by external forces such as markets and global events. Real transformation means understanding how these components interact, not treating them in isolation.</p>

 399 |         <h2>HOW DEEP DOES IT GO?</h2>
 400 |         <p>Each component has its own inputs, outputs, and hidden ties to others. When those ties are mapped, patterns emerge—a structure that shows why small changes ripple across the whole system.</p>
 401 |       </div></section>

 406 |       </div></section>

Just as we reached this milestone, AI leapt forward—suddenly powerful, affordable, and accessible—turning what seemed impossible into reality.</p>

 429 |   <script type="module">
 430 |     /**
 431 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 432 |      *
 433 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 434 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 435 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 436 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 437 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 438 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 439 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 440 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 441 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 442 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 443 |      *
 444 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 445 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 446 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 447 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 448 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 449 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 450 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 451 |      */
 452 | 
 453 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 454 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 455 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 456 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 457 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 458 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 459 | 
 460 |     // Background video speed control
 461 |     const bgVideo = document.querySelector('.bg-video');
 462 |     const VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE = 0.4;
 463 |     function applyVideoSpeed() { 
 464 |       try { if (bgVideo) bgVideo.playbackRate = VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE; } catch(_){}
 465 |     }
 466 |     if (bgVideo) { bgVideo.addEventListener('loadeddata', applyVideoSpeed); bgVideo.addEventListener('play', applyVideoSpeed); }
 467 |     applyVideoSpeed();
 468 | 
 469 |     // ===== ENHANCED NAVIGATION FOR FINALE BUTTONS =====
 470 |     function handleNavigation(e) {
 471 |       e.preventDefault();
 472 |       const navPath = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('href');
 473 |       if (navPath && window.top) {
 474 |         window.top.location.hash = navPath;
 475 |       }
 476 |     }
 477 | 
 478 |     function initializeNavigation() {
 479 |       const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.finale-enter-btn');
 480 |       btns.forEach(btn => {
 481 |         btn.addEventListener('click', handleNavigation);
 482 |       });
 483 |     }
 484 |     
 485 |     setTimeout(initializeNavigation, 200); // Increased timeout for safety
 486 | 
 487 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 488 |     /**
 489 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 490 |      */
 491 | 
 492 |     /**
 493 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 494 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 495 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 496 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 497 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 498 |      */
 499 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 500 | 
 501 |     /**
 502 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 503 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 504 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 505 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 506 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 507 |      */
 508 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 509 | 
 510 |     /**
 511 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 512 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 513 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 514 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 515 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 516 |      */
 517 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 518 | 
 519 |     /**
 520 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 521 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 522 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 523 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 524 |      */
 525 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 526 | 
 527 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 528 |     /**
 529 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 530 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 531 |      */
 532 | 
 533 |     /**
 534 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 535 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 536 |      */
 537 |     let externalProgress = null;
 538 | 
 539 |     /**
 540 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 541 |      * Supports two message types:
 542 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 543 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 544 |      */
 545 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 546 |       const data = e && e.data;
 547 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 548 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 549 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 550 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 551 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 552 |         externalProgress = null;
 553 |       }
 554 |     });
 555 | 
 556 |     /**
 557 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 558 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 559 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 560 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 561 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 562 |      */
 563 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 564 | 
 565 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 566 |     /**
 567 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 568 |      */
 569 | 
 570 |     /**
 571 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 572 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 573 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 574 |      */
 575 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 576 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 577 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 578 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 579 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 580 |     }
 581 | 
 582 |     /**
 583 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 584 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 585 |      */
 586 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 587 | 
 588 |     /**
 589 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 590 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 591 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 592 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 593 |      */
 594 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 595 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 596 |       const res = [];
 597 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 598 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 599 |       }
 600 |       return res;
 601 |     }
 602 | 
 603 |     /**
 604 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 605 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 606 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 607 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 608 |      */
 609 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 610 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 611 |       for (const c of corners) {
 612 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 613 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 614 |       }
 615 |       return true;
 616 |     }
 617 | 
 618 |     /**
 619 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 620 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 621 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 622 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 623 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 624 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 625 |      */
 626 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 627 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 628 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 629 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 630 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 631 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 632 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 633 |       }
 634 |       return lo;
 635 |     }
 636 | 
 637 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 638 |     /**
 639 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 640 |      *
 641 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 642 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 643 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 644 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 645 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 646 |      *
 647 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 648 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 649 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 650 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 651 |      *
 652 |      * CACHING:
 653 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 654 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 655 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 656 |      */
 657 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 658 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 659 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 660 | 
 661 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 662 | 
 663 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 664 |       .then(response => response.json())
 665 |       .then(data => {
 666 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 667 |       })
 668 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 669 | 
 670 |     /**
 671 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 672 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 673 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 674 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 675 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 676 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 677 |      */
 678 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 679 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 680 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 681 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 682 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 683 | 
 684 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 685 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 686 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 687 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 688 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 689 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 690 | 
 691 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 692 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 693 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 694 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 695 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 696 |       ctx.fill();
 697 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 698 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 699 |       /**
 700 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 701 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 702 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 703 |        */
 704 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 705 |         ctx.save();
 706 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 707 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 708 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 709 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 710 | 
 711 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 712 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 713 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 714 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 715 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 716 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 717 | 
 718 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 719 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 720 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 721 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 722 |           // Vertical lines
 723 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 724 |             ctx.beginPath();
 725 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 726 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 727 |             ctx.stroke();
 728 |           }
 729 |           // Horizontal lines
 730 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 731 |             ctx.beginPath();
 732 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 733 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 734 |             ctx.stroke();
 735 |           }
 736 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 737 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 738 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 739 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 740 |             ctx.beginPath();
 741 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 742 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 743 |             ctx.stroke();
 744 |           }
 745 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 746 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 747 |           ctx.beginPath();
 748 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 749 |           ctx.stroke();
 750 |           ctx.beginPath();
 751 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 752 |           ctx.stroke();
 753 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 754 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 755 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 756 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 757 |             ctx.beginPath();
 758 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 759 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 760 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 761 |             ctx.stroke();
 762 |           }
 763 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 764 |           // Hexagon pattern
 765 |           const r = size*0.22;
 766 |           ctx.beginPath();
 767 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 768 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 769 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 770 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 771 |           }
 772 |           ctx.closePath();
 773 |           ctx.stroke();
 774 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 775 |           // Sine wave pattern
 776 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 777 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 778 |             ctx.beginPath();
 779 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 780 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 781 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 782 |             }
 783 |             ctx.stroke();
 784 |           }
 785 |         }
 786 |         ctx.restore();
 787 |       };
 788 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 789 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 790 | 
 791 |       if (drawGloss) {
 792 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 793 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 794 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 795 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 796 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle

 798 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 799 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));

 810 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 811 | 
 812 |     /**
 813 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 814 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 815 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 816 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 817 |      */
 818 |     function shuffle(array) {
 819 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 820 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 821 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 822 |       }
 823 |       return array;
 824 |     }
 825 | 
 826 |     /**
 827 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 828 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 829 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 830 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 831 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 832 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 833 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 834 |      */
 835 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 836 |       ctx.beginPath();
 837 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 838 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 839 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 840 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 841 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 842 |       ctx.closePath();
 843 |     }
 844 | 
 845 |     /**
 846 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 847 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 848 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 849 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 850 |      */
 851 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 852 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 853 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 854 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 855 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 856 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 857 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 858 |     }

 865 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 866 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;

 880 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 881 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 882 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;
 883 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 884 |       const planes = [];
 885 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 886 |       const dirs = [
 887 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 888 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 889 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 890 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 891 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z
 892 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 893 |       ];
 894 |       dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
 895 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 896 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 897 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 898 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 899 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 900 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 901 |         mesh.add(m);
 902 |         planes.push(m);
 903 |       });
 904 |       return planes;
 905 |     }

 907 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====

 916 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:

 942 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 943 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;

 947 |           });
 948 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 949 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 950 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out
 951 |             color: new THREE.Color(fillColor), // Use the fillColor parameter instead of hardcoded value
 952 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],

 968 |          // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({

1029 |     /**
1030 |      * Set fill color for all meshes in a 3D object hierarchy
1031 |      * Used for global color changes during different animation phases

1033 |      * @param {number} color - Color value (hex number)
1034 |      */
1035 |     function setCubeFillColor(obj3D, color) {
1036 |       obj3D.traverse(o => {
1037 |         if (o.isMesh && o.material) {
1038 |           if (Array.isArray(o.material)) {
1039 |             // Handle multi-material meshes (cubes with different face materials)
1040 |             o.material.forEach(m => { if (m && m.color) m.color.set(color); });
1041 |           } else {
1042 |             // Handle single-material meshes
1043 |             if (o.material.color) o.material.color.set(color);
1044 |           }
1045 |         }
1046 |       });
1047 |     }

1458 |      * 4: 14.48-31.38% - Large cubes shrink, mini-cubes emerge
1459 |      * 5: 31.38-43.0% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud

1461 |      * 7: 52.0-62.0% - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns

1551 |     (function buildSculpture(){

1559 |           for(let b=0; b<lonSteps; b++){

1561 |             const nx = Math.sin(phi)*Math.cos(theta);

1572 |             k++;

1578 |     // ===== Text-Phase Sync (pin text while animation runs given phases) =====
1579 |     function setupPhaseTextSync(){
1580 |       const sections = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.hero-row .text-section'));
1581 |       if (sections.length < 8) return; // expect 8 sections
1582 |       // Use a fixed scroll budget (the spacer) to avoid feedback loops that desync phases
1583 |       const spacer = document.querySelector('.spacer');
1584 |       const baseBudget = spacer ? parseFloat(getComputedStyle(spacer).height) || 20000 : 20000;
1585 |       // Mapping of section index (0-based) to one or more animation phases to pin through
1586 |       const mapping = new Map([
1587 |         [3, [2,3]],   // The Anatomy of an Organization: P2 + P3
1588 |         [4, [4]],     // The Hidden Relations: P4
1589 |         [5, [5,6]],   // The Moment of Truth: P5 + P6
1590 |         [6, [7]],     // Locks, Locks Everywhere: P7
1591 |         [7, [8,9]],   // The Future, Ready Today: P8 + P9
1592 |       ]);
1593 |       let totalPads = 0;
1594 |       sections.forEach((sec, idx) => {
1595 |         let pad = sec.querySelector('.phase-pad');
1596 |         if (!pad) { pad = document.createElement('div'); pad.className = 'phase-pad'; sec.appendChild(pad); }
1597 |         let targetPx = 0;
1598 |         const phaseIds = mapping.get(idx);
1599 |         if (phaseIds){
1600 |           const ids = Array.isArray(phaseIds) ? phaseIds : [phaseIds];
1601 |           for (const id of ids) {
1602 |             const p = PHASES.find(pp => pp.id === id);
1603 |             if (p) targetPx += Math.max(0, Math.floor((p.end - p.start) * baseBudget));
1604 |           }
1605 |         }
1606 |         const needed = Math.max(0, targetPx);
1607 |         pad.style.height = needed + 'px';
1608 |         totalPads += needed;
1609 |       });
1610 |       // Offset pads by shrinking the spacer so total scroll stays aligned with the animation’s timeline
1611 |       if (spacer) {
1612 |         const minTail = 600; // keep extra tail so last sticky stays pinned through P9
1613 |         const newHeight = Math.max(minTail, baseBudget - totalPads + minTail);
1614 |         spacer.style.height = newHeight + 'px';
1615 |       }
1616 |     }

2586 |     // ===== Resize =====
2587 |     function fitCameraToPhase1Bounds() {
2588 |       const scale = 1.5;
2589 |       const halfExtent = (STEP + LARGE_SIZE * 0.5) * scale;
2590 |       const fov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov * 0.5);
2591 |       const rect = containerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
2592 |       const aspect = Math.max(0.0001, rect.width / Math.max(1, rect.height));
2593 |       const dVert = halfExtent / Math.tan(fov);
2594 |       const dHoriz = (halfExtent / aspect) / Math.tan(fov);
2595 |       let need = Math.max(dVert, dHoriz) * 1.8; // stronger margin to ensure full fit
2596 |       const current = camera.position.length();
2597 |       if (need < current) need = current; // never move closer than current distance
2598 |       const dir = camera.position.clone().normalize();
2599 |       camera.position.copy(dir.multiplyScalar(need));
2600 |       camera.lookAt(0, CAMERA_TARGET_Y, 0);
2601 |     }

 58 |       const data = e && (e.data as any);
 59 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 60 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_READY') {
 61 |         console.log('[RubiksIframe] Received RUBIKS_READY from iframe');
 62 |         onReady && onReady();
 63 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_PROGRESS') {
 64 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 65 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) onProgress && onProgress(v);
 66 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_PHASE') {
 67 |         const id = Number(data.id);
 68 |         const label = String(data.label ?? '');
 69 |         if (!Number.isNaN(id)) onPhaseChange && onPhaseChange(id, label);
 70 |       }
 71 |     }
 72 |     window.addEventListener('message', handleMessage);
 73 |     return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handleMessage);
 74 |   }, [onReady, onProgress, onPhaseChange]);
 75 | 
 76 |   // Send language change to iframe when language changes (but not on initial render)
 77 |   useEffect(() => {
 78 |     // Skip if this is the initial language or resources not injected yet
 79 |     if (!resourcesInjectedRef.current || initialLanguageRef.current === i18n.language) {
 80 |       return;
 81 |     }
 82 | 
 83 |     const win = iframeRef.current?.contentWindow;
 84 |     if (!win) return;
 85 |     
 86 |     console.log('[RubiksIframe] Language changed from', initialLanguageRef.current, 'to', i18n.language);
 87 |     initialLanguageRef.current = i18n.language;
 88 |     win.postMessage({ type: 'RENDER_OVERLAYS', lang: i18n.language }, targetOrigin);
 89 |   }, [i18n.language, targetOrigin]);
 90 | 
 91 |   // Push progress to the iframe when provided
 92 |   useEffect(() => {
 93 |     const win = iframeRef.current?.contentWindow;
 94 |     if (!win) return;
 95 |     if (progress === null || typeof progress === 'undefined') {
 96 |       win.postMessage({ type: 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL' }, targetOrigin);
 97 |     } else {
 98 |       const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(progress)));
 99 |       if (!Number.isNaN(v)) {
100 |         win.postMessage({ type: 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS', value: v }, targetOrigin);
101 |       }
102 |     }
103 |   }, [progress, targetOrigin]);
104 | 
105 |     return (
106 |       <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height }}>
107 |         <iframe
108 |           ref={iframeRef}
109 |           src="/rubiks-cdn.html"
110 |           title="Rubiks Animation"
111 |           style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', border: 'none' }}
112 |           allow="autoplay; fullscreen; xr-spatial-tracking; clipboard-write"
113 |           sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-pointer-lock allow-top-navigation"
114 |         />
115 |       </div>
116 |     );
117 |   }
118 | );
119 | 
120 | export default RubiksIframe;

 378 |         <h1>Transforming Strategy Execution</h1>
 379 |         <h2>COMPLEXITY AS AN ASSET</h2>
 380 |         <p>Most transformations fail because complexity overwhelms. We turned that complexity into an advantage—redefining planning, risks, and dashboards inside one integrated model.</p>

 383 |         <h1>Imagine a Parallel Universe</h1>

 385 | FLOW</h2>
 386 |         <p>Let us show you a week in that universe — A Week in the Life of a Transformation Team &lt;video link&gt;. Farfetched? It’s here. We built the MVP: a Net.js web app with a Supabase database and a Gemini Assistant, built on a five-year scenario dataset inspired by real transformation events.</p>

 394 |         <h1>The Anatomy of an Organization</h1>
 395 |         <h2>WHAT MAKES AN ORGANIZATION?</h2>
 396 |         <p>Many things, like a living system of systems—Strategy, Policies, Processes, Digital  shaped by external forces such as markets and global events. Real transformation means understanding how these components interact, not treating them in isolation.</p>
 397 |       </div></section>

 401 |         <p>Each component has its own inputs, outputs, and hidden ties to others. When those ties are mapped, patterns emerge—a structure that shows why small changes ripple across the whole system.</p>

Just as we reached this milestone, AI leapt forward—suddenly powerful, affordable, and accessible—turning what seemed impossible into reality.</p>

 430 |   <script type="module">
 431 |     /**
 432 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 433 |      *
 434 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 435 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 436 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 437 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 438 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 439 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 440 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 441 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 442 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 443 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 444 |      *
 445 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 446 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 447 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 448 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 449 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 450 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 451 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 452 |      */
 453 | 
 454 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 455 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 456 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 457 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 458 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 459 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 460 | 
 461 |     // Background video speed control
 462 |     const bgVideo = document.querySelector('.bg-video');
 463 |     const VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE = 0.4;
 464 |     function applyVideoSpeed() { 
 465 |       try { if (bgVideo) bgVideo.playbackRate = VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE; } catch(_){}
 466 |     }
 467 |     if (bgVideo) { bgVideo.addEventListener('loadeddata', applyVideoSpeed); bgVideo.addEventListener('play', applyVideoSpeed); }
 468 |     applyVideoSpeed();
 469 | 
 470 |     // ===== ENHANCED NAVIGATION FOR FINALE BUTTONS =====
 471 |     function handleNavigation(e) {
 472 |       e.preventDefault();
 473 |       const navPath = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('href');
 474 |       if (navPath && window.top) {
 475 |         window.top.location.hash = navPath;
 476 |       }
 477 |     }
 478 | 
 479 |     function initializeNavigation() {
 480 |       const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.finale-enter-btn');
 481 |       btns.forEach(btn => {
 482 |         btn.addEventListener('click', handleNavigation);
 483 |       });
 484 |     }
 485 |     
 486 |     setTimeout(initializeNavigation, 200); // Increased timeout for safety
 487 | 
 488 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 489 |     /**
 490 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 491 |      */
 492 | 
 493 |     /**
 494 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 495 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 496 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 497 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 498 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 499 |      */
 500 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 501 | 
 502 |     /**
 503 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 504 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 505 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 506 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 507 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 508 |      */
 509 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 510 | 
 511 |     /**
 512 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 513 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 514 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 515 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 516 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 517 |      */
 518 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 519 | 
 520 |     /**
 521 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 522 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 523 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 524 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 525 |      */
 526 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 527 | 
 528 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 529 |     /**
 530 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 531 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 532 |      */
 533 | 
 534 |     /**
 535 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 536 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 537 |      */
 538 |     let externalProgress = null;
 539 | 
 540 |     /**
 541 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 542 |      * Supports two message types:
 543 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 544 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 545 |      */
 546 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 547 |       const data = e && e.data;
 548 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 549 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 550 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 551 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 552 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 553 |         externalProgress = null;
 554 |       }
 555 |     });
 556 | 
 557 |     /**
 558 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 559 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 560 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 561 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 562 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 563 |      */
 564 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 565 | 
 566 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 567 |     /**
 568 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 569 |      */
 570 | 
 571 |     /**
 572 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 573 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 574 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 575 |      */
 576 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 577 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 578 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 579 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 580 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 581 |     }
 582 | 
 583 |     /**
 584 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 585 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 586 |      */
 587 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 588 | 
 589 |     /**
 590 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 591 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 592 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 593 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 594 |      */
 595 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 596 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 597 |       const res = [];
 598 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 599 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 600 |       }
 601 |       return res;
 602 |     }
 603 | 
 604 |     /**
 605 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 606 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 607 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 608 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 609 |      */
 610 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 611 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 612 |       for (const c of corners) {
 613 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 614 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 615 |       }
 616 |       return true;
 617 |     }
 618 | 
 619 |     /**
 620 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 621 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 622 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 623 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 624 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 625 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 626 |      */
 627 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 628 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 629 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 630 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 631 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 632 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 633 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 634 |       }
 635 |       return lo;
 636 |     }
 637 | 
 638 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 639 |     /**
 640 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 641 |      *
 642 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 643 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 644 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 645 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 646 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 647 |      *
 648 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 649 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 650 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 651 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 652 |      *
 653 |      * CACHING:
 654 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 655 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 656 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 657 |      */
 658 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 659 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 660 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 661 | 
 662 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 663 | 
 664 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 665 |       .then(response => response.json())
 666 |       .then(data => {
 667 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 668 |       })
 669 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 670 | 
 671 |     /**
 672 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 673 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 674 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 675 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 676 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 677 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 678 |      */
 679 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 680 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 681 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 682 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 683 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 684 | 
 685 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 686 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 687 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 688 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 689 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 690 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 691 | 
 692 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 693 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 694 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 695 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 696 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 697 |       ctx.fill();
 698 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 699 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 700 |       /**
 701 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 702 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 703 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 704 |        */
 705 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 706 |         ctx.save();
 707 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 708 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 709 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 710 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 711 | 
 712 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 713 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 714 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 715 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 716 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 717 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 718 | 
 719 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 720 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 721 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 722 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 723 |           // Vertical lines
 724 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 725 |             ctx.beginPath();
 726 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 727 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 728 |             ctx.stroke();
 729 |           }
 730 |           // Horizontal lines
 731 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 732 |             ctx.beginPath();
 733 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 734 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 735 |             ctx.stroke();
 736 |           }
 737 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 738 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 739 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 740 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 741 |             ctx.beginPath();
 742 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 743 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 744 |             ctx.stroke();
 745 |           }
 746 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 747 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 748 |           ctx.beginPath();
 749 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 750 |           ctx.stroke();
 751 |           ctx.beginPath();
 752 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 753 |           ctx.stroke();
 754 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 755 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 756 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 757 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 758 |             ctx.beginPath();
 759 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 760 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 761 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 762 |             ctx.stroke();
 763 |           }
 764 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 765 |           // Hexagon pattern
 766 |           const r = size*0.22;
 767 |           ctx.beginPath();
 768 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 769 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 770 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 771 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 772 |           }
 773 |           ctx.closePath();
 774 |           ctx.stroke();
 775 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 776 |           // Sine wave pattern
 777 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 778 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 779 |             ctx.beginPath();
 780 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 781 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 782 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 783 |             }
 784 |             ctx.stroke();
 785 |           }
 786 |         }
 787 |         ctx.restore();
 788 |       };
 789 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 790 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 791 | 
 792 |       if (drawGloss) {
 793 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 794 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 795 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 796 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 797 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 798 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 799 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 800 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 801 |         ctx.fill();
 802 |       }
 803 | 
 804 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 805 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 806 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 807 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 808 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 809 |       return tex;
 810 |     }
 811 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 812 | 
 813 |     /**
 814 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 815 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 816 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 817 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 818 |      */
 819 |     function shuffle(array) {
 820 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 821 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 822 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 823 |       }
 824 |       return array;
 825 |     }
 826 | 
 827 |     /**
 828 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 829 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 830 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 831 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 832 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 833 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 834 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 835 |      */
 836 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 837 |       ctx.beginPath();
 838 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 839 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 840 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 841 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 842 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 843 |       ctx.closePath();
 844 |     }
 845 | 
 846 |     /**
 847 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 848 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 849 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 850 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 851 |      */
 852 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 853 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 854 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 855 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 856 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 857 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 858 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 859 |     }
 860 |     /**
 861 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss
 862 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 textures, one per pattern
 863 |      */
 864 |     function getLargeStickerTextures(){
 865 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs;
 866 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 867 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;
 868 |       return texs;
 869 |     }
 870 | 
 871 |     /**
 872 |      * Get cached textures for mini cubes with solid colors (no patterns, no gloss)
 873 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 solid color textures
 874 |      */
 875 |     function getMiniStickerTextures(){
 876 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs;
 877 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], false, false));
 878 |       STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs = texs;
 879 |       return texs;
 880 |     }
 881 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 882 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 883 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;
 884 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 885 |       const planes = [];
 886 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 887 |       const dirs = [
 888 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 889 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 890 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 891 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 892 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z
 893 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 894 |       ];
 895 |       dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
 896 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 897 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 898 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 899 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 900 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 901 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 902 |         mesh.add(m);
 903 |         planes.push(m);
 904 |       });
 905 |       return planes;
 906 |     }

 908 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 909 |     /**
 910 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 911 |      *
 912 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 913 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 914 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 915 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 916 |      *
 917 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 918 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 919 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 920 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 921 |      *
 922 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 923 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 924 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 925 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 926 |      *
 927 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 928 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 929 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)

 936 |       if (size > 0.1) {

 940 |           const pats = fixedFaceAssignments.length > 0 ? fixedFaceAssignments.slice() : shuffle(FACE_PATTERNS.slice()); // Randomize pattern order per cube
 941 |           // Load all 6 bump map textures

 943 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 944 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 945 |             tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;

 947 |             return tex;
 948 |           });
 949 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 950 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 951 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out
 952 |             color: new THREE.Color(fillColor), // Use the fillColor parameter instead of hardcoded value
 953 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],
 954 |             bumpScale: 1.0, // Maximum bump effect
 955 |             transparent: false, // Opaque for performance

 957 |             depthTest: true, // Still test depth for proper ordering

 965 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mats); // Array of 6 materials, one per face
 966 |         } else {

 969 |          // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({

 986 |             transparent: false,
 987 |             opacity: 1.0,
 988 |             depthWrite: true,

 997 |         }
 998 |       } else {

1030 |     /**
1031 |      * Set fill color for all meshes in a 3D object hierarchy
1032 |      * Used for global color changes during different animation phases
1033 |      * @param {THREE.Object3D} obj3D - Root object to traverse
1034 |      * @param {number} color - Color value (hex number)
1035 |      */
1036 |     function setCubeFillColor(obj3D, color) {
1037 |       obj3D.traverse(o => {
1038 |         if (o.isMesh && o.material) {
1039 |           if (Array.isArray(o.material)) {
1040 |             // Handle multi-material meshes (cubes with different face materials)
1041 |             o.material.forEach(m => { if (m && m.color) m.color.set(color); });
1042 |           } else {
1043 |             // Handle single-material meshes
1044 |             if (o.material.color) o.material.color.set(color);
1045 |           }
1046 |         }
1047 |       });
1048 |     }

1166 |     // ===== LARGE CUBE SYSTEM (27 PIECES) =====
1167 |     /**

1172 |     const LARGE_SIZE = 1.0; // Base size for large cubes
1173 |     const GAP = 0.08; // Gap between cubes for visual separation
1174 |     const STEP = LARGE_SIZE + GAP; // Total spacing including gap

1424 |     function onPointerUp(e){

1455 |      * PHASE TIMING (as percentage of total scroll):

1458 |      * 3: 12.06-14.48% - Pieces settle with random rotations
1459 |      * 4: 14.48-31.38% - Large cubes shrink, mini-cubes emerge
1460 |      * 5: 31.38-43.0% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud
1461 |      * 6: 43.0-52.0% - Mini-cubes recolor cyan to purple one-by-one
1462 |      * 7: 52.0-62.0% - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
1463 |      * 8: 62.0-70.0% - Transform into final spherical sculpture
1464 |      * 9: 70.0-100% - Interactive final formation with mouse controls
1465 |      */

1548 |     // Final sculpture targets (layered spherical distribution with oriented/elongated minis)
1549 |     const sculpturePos = new Array(miniCubes.length);
1550 |     const sculptureQuat = new Array(miniCubes.length);
