 430 |   <script type="module">
 431 |     /**
 432 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 433 |      *
 434 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 435 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 436 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 437 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 438 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 439 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 440 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 441 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 442 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 443 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 444 |      *
 445 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 446 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 447 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 448 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 449 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 450 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 451 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 452 |      */
 453 | 
 454 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 455 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 456 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 457 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 458 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 459 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 460 | 
 461 |     // Background video speed control
 462 |     const bgVideo = document.querySelector('.bg-video');
 463 |     const VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE = 0.4;
 464 |     function applyVideoSpeed() { 
 465 |       try { if (bgVideo) bgVideo.playbackRate = VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE; } catch(_){}
 466 |     }
 467 |     if (bgVideo) { bgVideo.addEventListener('loadeddata', applyVideoSpeed); bgVideo.addEventListener('play', applyVideoSpeed); }
 468 |     applyVideoSpeed();
 469 | 
 470 |     // ===== ENHANCED NAVIGATION FOR FINALE BUTTONS =====
 471 |     function handleNavigation(e) {
 472 |       e.preventDefault();
 473 |       const navPath = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('href');
 474 |       if (navPath && window.top) {
 475 |         window.top.location.hash = navPath;
 476 |       }
 477 |     }
 478 | 
 479 |     function initializeNavigation() {
 480 |       const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.finale-enter-btn');
 481 |       btns.forEach(btn => {
 482 |         btn.addEventListener('click', handleNavigation);
 483 |       });
 484 |     }
 485 |     
 486 |     setTimeout(initializeNavigation, 200); // Increased timeout for safety
 487 | 
 488 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 489 |     /**
 490 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 491 |      */
 492 | 
 493 |     /**
 494 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 495 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 496 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 497 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 498 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 499 |      */
 500 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 501 | 
 502 |     /**
 503 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 504 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 505 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 506 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 507 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 508 |      */
 509 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 510 | 
 511 |     /**
 512 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 513 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 514 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 515 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 516 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 517 |      */
 518 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 519 | 
 520 |     /**
 521 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 522 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 523 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 524 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 525 |      */
 526 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 527 | 
 528 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 529 |     /**
 530 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 531 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 532 |      */
 533 | 
 534 |     /**
 535 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 536 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 537 |      */
 538 |     let externalProgress = null;
 539 | 
 540 |     /**
 541 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 542 |      * Supports two message types:
 543 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 544 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 545 |      */
 546 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 547 |       const data = e && e.data;
 548 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 549 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 550 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 551 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 552 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 553 |         externalProgress = null;
 554 |       }
 555 |     });
 556 | 
 557 |     /**
 558 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 559 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 560 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 561 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 562 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 563 |      */
 564 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 565 | 
 566 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 567 |     /**
 568 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 569 |      */
 570 | 
 571 |     /**
 572 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 573 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 574 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 575 |      */
 576 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 577 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 578 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 579 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 580 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 581 |     }
 582 | 
 583 |     /**
 584 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 585 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 586 |      */
 587 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 588 | 
 589 |     /**
 590 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 591 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 592 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 593 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 594 |      */
 595 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 596 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 597 |       const res = [];
 598 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 599 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 600 |       }
 601 |       return res;
 602 |     }
 603 | 
 604 |     /**
 605 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 606 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 607 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 608 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 609 |      */
 610 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 611 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 612 |       for (const c of corners) {
 613 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 614 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 615 |       }
 616 |       return true;
 617 |     }
 618 | 
 619 |     /**
 620 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 621 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 622 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 623 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 624 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 625 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 626 |      */
 627 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 628 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 629 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 630 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 631 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 632 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 633 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 634 |       }
 635 |       return lo;
 636 |     }
 637 | 
 638 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 639 |     /**
 640 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 641 |      *
 642 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 643 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 644 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 645 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 646 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 647 |      *
 648 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 649 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 650 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 651 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 652 |      *
 653 |      * CACHING:
 654 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 655 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 656 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 657 |      */
 658 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 659 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 660 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 661 | 
 662 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 663 | 
 664 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 665 |       .then(response => response.json())
 666 |       .then(data => {
 667 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 668 |       })
 669 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 670 | 
 671 |     /**
 672 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 673 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 674 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 675 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 676 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 677 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 678 |      */
 679 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 680 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 681 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 682 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 683 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 684 | 
 685 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 686 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 687 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 688 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 689 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 690 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 691 | 
 692 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 693 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 694 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 695 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 696 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 697 |       ctx.fill();
 698 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 699 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 700 |       /**
 701 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 702 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 703 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 704 |        */
 705 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 706 |         ctx.save();
 707 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 708 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 709 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 710 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 711 | 
 712 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 713 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 714 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 715 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 716 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 717 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 718 | 
 719 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 720 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 721 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 722 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 723 |           // Vertical lines
 724 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 725 |             ctx.beginPath();
 726 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 727 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 728 |             ctx.stroke();
 729 |           }
 730 |           // Horizontal lines
 731 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 732 |             ctx.beginPath();
 733 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 734 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 735 |             ctx.stroke();
 736 |           }
 737 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 738 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 739 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 740 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 741 |             ctx.beginPath();
 742 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 743 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 744 |             ctx.stroke();
 745 |           }
 746 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 747 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 748 |           ctx.beginPath();
 749 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 750 |           ctx.stroke();
 751 |           ctx.beginPath();
 752 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 753 |           ctx.stroke();
 754 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 755 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 756 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 757 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 758 |             ctx.beginPath();
 759 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 760 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 761 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 762 |             ctx.stroke();
 763 |           }
 764 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 765 |           // Hexagon pattern
 766 |           const r = size*0.22;
 767 |           ctx.beginPath();
 768 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 769 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 770 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 771 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 772 |           }
 773 |           ctx.closePath();
 774 |           ctx.stroke();
 775 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 776 |           // Sine wave pattern
 777 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 778 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 779 |             ctx.beginPath();
 780 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 781 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 782 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 783 |             }
 784 |             ctx.stroke();
 785 |           }
 786 |         }
 787 |         ctx.restore();
 788 |       };
 789 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 790 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 791 | 
 792 |       if (drawGloss) {
 793 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 794 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 795 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 796 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 797 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 798 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 799 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 800 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 801 |         ctx.fill();
 802 |       }
 803 | 
 804 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 805 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 806 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 807 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 808 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 809 |       return tex;
 810 |     }
 811 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 812 | 
 813 |     /**
 814 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 815 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 816 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 817 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 818 |      */
 819 |     function shuffle(array) {
 820 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 821 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 822 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 823 |       }
 824 |       return array;
 825 |     }
 826 | 
 827 |     /**
 828 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 829 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 830 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 831 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 832 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 833 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 834 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 835 |      */
 836 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 837 |       ctx.beginPath();
 838 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 839 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 840 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 841 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 842 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 843 |       ctx.closePath();
 844 |     }
 845 | 
 846 |     /**
 847 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 848 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 849 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 850 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 851 |      */
 852 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 853 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 854 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 855 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 856 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 857 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 858 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 859 |     }
 860 |     /**
 861 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss
 862 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 textures, one per pattern
 863 |      */
 864 |     function getLargeStickerTextures(){
 865 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs;
 866 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 867 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;
 868 |       return texs;
 869 |     }
 870 | 
 871 |     /**
 872 |      * Get cached textures for mini cubes with solid colors (no patterns, no gloss)
 873 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 solid color textures
 874 |      */
 875 |     function getMiniStickerTextures(){
 876 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs;
 877 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], false, false));
 878 |       STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs = texs;
 879 |       return texs;
 880 |     }
 881 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 882 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 883 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;

 888 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X

 893 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 894 |       ];

 896 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 897 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 898 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 899 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 900 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 901 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 902 |         mesh.add(m);
 903 |         planes.push(m);
 904 |       });

 908 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 909 |     /**
 910 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 911 |      *
 912 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 913 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 914 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 915 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 916 |      *
 917 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 918 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 919 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 920 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 921 |      *
 922 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 923 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 924 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 925 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 926 |      *
 927 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 928 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 929 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)
 930 |      * @returns {THREE.Mesh} Configured cube mesh with edges
 931 |      */
 932 |     function makeCube(size, fillColor, edgeColor, cubeIndex = 0) {
 933 |       const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
 934 |       let mesh;
 935 | 
 936 |       if (size > 0.1) {
 937 |         if (size >= 0.99) {
 938 |           // ===== LARGE CUBE CREATION =====
 939 |           // 27 large cubes forming the initial Rubik's cube structure
 940 |           const pats = fixedFaceAssignments.length > 0 ? fixedFaceAssignments.slice() : shuffle(FACE_PATTERNS.slice()); // Randomize pattern order per cube
 941 |           // Load all 6 bump map textures
 942 |           const bumpTextures = [1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n => {
 943 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 944 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 945 |             tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 946 |             tex.repeat.set(1, 1);
 947 |             return tex;
 948 |           });
 949 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 950 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 951 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out
 952 |             color: new THREE.Color(fillColor), // Use the fillColor parameter instead of hardcoded value
 953 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],
 954 |             bumpScale: 1.0, // Maximum bump effect
 955 |             transparent: false, // Opaque for performance
 956 |             depthWrite: false, // Disable depth writing to prevent z-fighting
 957 |             depthTest: true, // Still test depth for proper ordering
 958 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides (important for cube faces)
 959 |             metalness: 1.0, // Fully metallic
 960 |             roughness: 0.1, // Very shiny
 961 |             polygonOffset: true, // Offset depth to prevent z-fighting with edges
 962 |             polygonOffsetFactor: -4,
 963 |             polygonOffsetUnits: -4
 964 |           }));
 965 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mats); // Array of 6 materials, one per face
 966 |         } else {
 967 |           // ===== MINI CUBE CREATION =====
 968 |           // 729 mini cubes that emerge from within large cubes
 969 |          // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 970 |           // --- ORIGINAL MINI CUBE MATERIAL CREATION (commented out) ---
 971 |           // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 972 |           //   color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC), // Blue color for mini-cubes
 973 |           //   transparent: false, // Opaque
 974 |           //   opacity: 1.0, // Fully opaque
 975 |           //   depthWrite: true, // Enable depth writing to prevent see-through
 976 |           //   depthTest: true, // Test depth
 977 |           //   side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides
 978 |           //   metalness: 0.25, // Balanced metallic feel
 979 |           //   roughness: 0.5 // Balanced surface roughness
 980 |           // });
 981 |           // mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
 982 | 
 983 |           // --- MINI CUBE MATERIAL WITH NO GLOW/EMISSIVE ---
 984 |           const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 985 |             color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC),
 986 |             transparent: false,
 987 |             opacity: 1.0,
 988 |             depthWrite: true,
 989 |             depthTest: true,
 990 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide,
 991 |             metalness: 0.25,
 992 |             roughness: 0.5,
 993 |             emissive: new THREE.Color(0x000000), // No glow
 994 |             emissiveIntensity: 0.0 // No glow
 995 |           });
 996 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
 997 |         }
 998 |       } else {
 999 |         // ===== TINY CUBE CREATION =====
1000 |         // Smallest cubes in final sculpture formation
1001 |         const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
1002 |           color: fillColor,
1003 |           metalness: 1.0, // Highly metallic
1004 |           roughness: 0.25, // Smooth surface
1005 |           clearcoat: 1.0, // Clear coat layer for extra shine
1006 |           clearcoatRoughness: 0.15, // Smooth clear coat
1007 | //          envMapIntensity: 1.2 // Environment reflection intensity
1008 |         });
1009 |         mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat); // Single material for all faces
1010 |       }
1011 |       // ===== MESH CONFIGURATION =====
1012 |       mesh.castShadow = true; // Cast shadows for depth
1013 |       mesh.receiveShadow = true; // Receive shadows from other objects
1014 | 
1015 |       // ===== EDGE CREATION =====
1016 |       // Add edges for all cubes, but make mini-cube edges very thin
1017 |       const edges = new THREE.LineSegments(
1018 |         new THREE.EdgesGeometry(geom), // Extract edges from box geometry
1019 |         new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
1020 |           color: edgeColor, // Use provided edge color
1021 |           linewidth: size >= 0.99 ? 1 : 0.5 // Thin lines for mini-cubes
1022 |         })
1023 |       );
1024 |       edges.renderOrder = 10; // Render edges on top of faces
1025 |       mesh.add(edges); // Add as child so edges follow mesh transformations
1026 | 
1027 |       return mesh;
1028 |     }

1030 |     /**
1031 |      * Set fill color for all meshes in a 3D object hierarchy
1032 |      * Used for global color changes during different animation phases
1033 |      * @param {THREE.Object3D} obj3D - Root object to traverse
1034 |      * @param {number} color - Color value (hex number)
1035 |      */
1036 |     function setCubeFillColor(obj3D, color) {
1037 |       obj3D.traverse(o => {
1038 |         if (o.isMesh && o.material) {
1039 |           if (Array.isArray(o.material)) {
1040 |             // Handle multi-material meshes (cubes with different face materials)
1041 |             o.material.forEach(m => { if (m && m.color) m.color.set(color); });
1042 |           } else {
1043 |             // Handle single-material meshes
1044 |             if (o.material.color) o.material.color.set(color);
1045 |           }
1046 |         }
1047 |       });
1048 |     }

1234 |     // ===== MINI CUBE SYSTEM (729 PIECES) =====
1235 |     /**
1236 |      * Create the inner 729 mini-cubes that emerge from within the large cubes
1237 |      * Each large cube contains a 3x3x3 grid of mini-cubes (27 total per large cube)
1238 |      * Mini-cubes are initially hidden and grow during Phase 4 transformation

1241 |     const MINI_SIZE = 0.28; // Size of mini-cubes (smaller than large)

1249 |     // Generate mini-cubes within each large cube

1251 |       const lp = largePieces[ownerIndex];
1252 |       const base = lp.position.clone(); // Position relative to owning large cube
1253 | 
1254 |       // Create 3x3x3 grid within each large cube
1255 |       for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
1256 |         for (let j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
1257 |           for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) {
1258 |             const m = makeCube(MINI_SIZE, 0x1f2937, 0xffffff);
1259 |             m.position.set(base.x + i * MINI_STEP, base.y + j * MINI_STEP, base.z + k * MINI_STEP);
1260 | 
1261 |             // Store relationship data for animation logic
1262 |             m.userData.ownerIndex = ownerIndex; // Which large cube owns this mini
1263 |             m.userData.local = new THREE.Vector3(i, j, k); // Local position within 3x3x3 grid
1264 |             m.userData.isCenter = (i === 0 && j === 0 && k === 0); // Center mini-cube flag
1265 |             m.userData.base = new THREE.Vector3(i, j, k); // Base position for animations
1266 |             m.userData.initialScale = 0.0001; // Start tiny for growth animation
1267 |             m.scale.setScalar(m.userData.initialScale);
1268 | 
1269 |             miniGroup.add(m);
1270 |             miniCubes.push(m);
1271 |           }
1272 |         }
1273 |       }
1274 |     }

1294 |       SAMPLE_LARGE.forEach(i => {

1297 |           const wp = lp.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
1298 |           out += `L[${i}]: (${fmt(wp)})n`;
1299 |         }
1300 |       });
1301 |       if (miniGroup.visible) {
1302 |         out += `nMini cubes (sample indices ${SAMPLE_MINI.join(', ')}):n`;
1303 |         SAMPLE_MINI.forEach(i => {
1304 |           const m = miniCubes[i];
1305 |           if (m) {

 435 |   <script type="module">
 436 |     /**
 437 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 438 |      *
 439 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 440 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 441 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 442 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 443 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 444 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 445 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 446 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 447 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 448 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 449 |      *
 450 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 451 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 452 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 453 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 454 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 455 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 456 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 457 |      */
 458 | 
 459 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 460 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 461 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 462 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 463 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 464 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 465 | 
 466 |     // Background video speed control
 467 |     const bgVideo = document.querySelector('.bg-video');
 468 |     const VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE = 0.4;
 469 |     function applyVideoSpeed() { 
 470 |       try { if (bgVideo) bgVideo.playbackRate = VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE; } catch(_){}
 471 |     }
 472 |     if (bgVideo) { bgVideo.addEventListener('loadeddata', applyVideoSpeed); bgVideo.addEventListener('play', applyVideoSpeed); }
 473 |     applyVideoSpeed();
 474 | 
 475 |     // ===== ENHANCED NAVIGATION FOR FINALE BUTTONS =====
 476 |     function handleNavigation(e) {
 477 |       e.preventDefault();
 478 |       const navPath = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('href');
 479 |       if (navPath && window.top) {
 480 |         window.top.location.hash = navPath;
 481 |       }
 482 |     }
 483 | 
 484 |     function initializeNavigation() {
 485 |       const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.finale-enter-btn');
 486 |       btns.forEach(btn => {
 487 |         btn.addEventListener('click', handleNavigation);
 488 |       });
 489 |     }
 490 |     
 491 |     setTimeout(initializeNavigation, 200); // Increased timeout for safety
 492 | 
 493 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 494 |     /**
 495 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 496 |      */
 497 | 
 498 |     /**
 499 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 500 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 501 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 502 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 503 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 504 |      */
 505 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 506 | 
 507 |     /**
 508 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 509 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 510 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 511 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 512 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 513 |      */
 514 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 515 | 
 516 |     /**
 517 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 518 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 519 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 520 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 521 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 522 |      */
 523 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 524 | 
 525 |     /**
 526 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 527 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 528 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 529 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 530 |      */
 531 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 532 | 
 533 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 534 |     /**
 535 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 536 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 537 |      */
 538 | 
 539 |     /**
 540 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 541 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 542 |      */
 543 |     let externalProgress = null;
 544 | 
 545 |     /**
 546 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 547 |      * Supports two message types:
 548 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 549 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 550 |      */
 551 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 552 |       const data = e && e.data;
 553 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 554 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 555 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 556 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 557 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 558 |         externalProgress = null;
 559 |       }
 560 |     });
 561 | 
 562 |     /**
 563 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 564 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 565 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 566 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 567 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 568 |      */
 569 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 570 | 
 571 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 572 |     /**
 573 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 574 |      */
 575 | 
 576 |     /**
 577 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 578 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 579 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 580 |      */
 581 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 582 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 583 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 584 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 585 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 586 |     }
 587 | 
 588 |     /**
 589 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 590 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 591 |      */
 592 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 593 | 
 594 |     /**
 595 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 596 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 597 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 598 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 599 |      */
 600 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 601 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 602 |       const res = [];
 603 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 604 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 605 |       }
 606 |       return res;
 607 |     }
 608 | 
 609 |     /**
 610 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 611 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 612 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 613 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 614 |      */
 615 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 616 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 617 |       for (const c of corners) {
 618 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 619 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 620 |       }
 621 |       return true;
 622 |     }
 623 | 
 624 |     /**
 625 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 626 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 627 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 628 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 629 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 630 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 631 |      */
 632 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 633 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 634 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 635 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 636 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 637 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 638 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 639 |       }
 640 |       return lo;
 641 |     }
 642 | 
 643 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 644 |     /**
 645 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 646 |      *
 647 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 648 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 649 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 650 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 651 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 652 |      *
 653 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 654 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 655 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 656 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 657 |      *
 658 |      * CACHING:
 659 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 660 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 661 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 662 |      */
 663 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 664 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 665 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 666 | 
 667 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 668 | 
 669 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 670 |       .then(response => response.json())
 671 |       .then(data => {
 672 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 673 |       })
 674 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 675 | 
 676 |     /**
 677 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 678 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 679 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 680 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 681 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 682 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 683 |      */
 684 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 685 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 686 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 687 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 688 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 689 | 
 690 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 691 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 692 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 693 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 694 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 695 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 696 | 
 697 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 698 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 699 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 700 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 701 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 702 |       ctx.fill();
 703 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 704 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 705 |       /**
 706 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 707 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 708 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 709 |        */
 710 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 711 |         ctx.save();
 712 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 713 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 714 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 715 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 716 | 
 717 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 718 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 719 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 720 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 721 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 722 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 723 | 
 724 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 725 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 726 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 727 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 728 |           // Vertical lines
 729 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 730 |             ctx.beginPath();
 731 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 732 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 733 |             ctx.stroke();
 734 |           }
 735 |           // Horizontal lines
 736 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 737 |             ctx.beginPath();
 738 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 739 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 740 |             ctx.stroke();
 741 |           }
 742 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 743 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 744 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 745 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 746 |             ctx.beginPath();
 747 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 748 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 749 |             ctx.stroke();
 750 |           }
 751 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 752 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 753 |           ctx.beginPath();
 754 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 755 |           ctx.stroke();
 756 |           ctx.beginPath();
 757 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 758 |           ctx.stroke();
 759 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 760 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 761 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 762 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 763 |             ctx.beginPath();
 764 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 765 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 766 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 767 |             ctx.stroke();
 768 |           }
 769 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 770 |           // Hexagon pattern
 771 |           const r = size*0.22;
 772 |           ctx.beginPath();
 773 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 774 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 775 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 776 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 777 |           }
 778 |           ctx.closePath();
 779 |           ctx.stroke();
 780 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 781 |           // Sine wave pattern
 782 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 783 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 784 |             ctx.beginPath();
 785 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 786 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 787 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 788 |             }
 789 |             ctx.stroke();
 790 |           }
 791 |         }
 792 |         ctx.restore();
 793 |       };
 794 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 795 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 796 | 
 797 |       if (drawGloss) {
 798 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 799 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 800 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 801 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 802 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 803 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 804 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 805 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 806 |         ctx.fill();
 807 |       }
 808 | 
 809 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 810 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 811 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 812 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 813 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 814 |       return tex;
 815 |     }
 816 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 817 | 
 818 |     /**
 819 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 820 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 821 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 822 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 823 |      */
 824 |     function shuffle(array) {
 825 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 826 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 827 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 828 |       }
 829 |       return array;
 830 |     }
 831 | 
 832 |     /**
 833 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 834 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 835 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 836 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 837 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 838 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 839 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 840 |      */
 841 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 842 |       ctx.beginPath();
 843 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 844 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 845 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 846 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 847 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 848 |       ctx.closePath();
 849 |     }
 850 | 
 851 |     /**
 852 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 853 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 854 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 855 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 856 |      */
 857 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 858 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 859 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 860 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 861 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 862 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 863 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 864 |     }

 866 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss

 872 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;

 886 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 887 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 888 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;
 889 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 890 |       const planes = [];
 891 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 892 |       const dirs = [
 893 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 894 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 895 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 896 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 897 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z
 898 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 899 |       ];
 900 |       dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
 901 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 902 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 903 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 904 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 905 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 906 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 907 |         mesh.add(m);
 908 |         planes.push(m);
 909 |       });
 910 |       return planes;
 911 |     }

 913 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 914 |     /**
 915 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 916 |      *
 917 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 918 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 919 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 920 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 921 |      *
 922 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 923 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 924 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 925 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 926 |      *
 927 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 928 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 929 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 930 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 931 |      *
 932 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 933 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 934 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)
 935 |      * @returns {THREE.Mesh} Configured cube mesh with edges
 936 |      */
 937 |     function makeCube(size, fillColor, edgeColor, cubeIndex = 0) {
 938 |       const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
 939 |       let mesh;
 940 | 
 941 |       if (size > 0.1) {
 942 |         if (size >= 0.99) {
 943 |           // ===== LARGE CUBE CREATION =====
 944 |           // 27 large cubes forming the initial Rubik's cube structure
 945 |           const pats = fixedFaceAssignments.length > 0 ? fixedFaceAssignments.slice() : shuffle(FACE_PATTERNS.slice()); // Randomize pattern order per cube
 946 |           // Load all 6 bump map textures
 947 |           const bumpTextures = [1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n => {
 948 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 949 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 950 |             tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 951 |             tex.repeat.set(1, 1);
 952 |             return tex;
 953 |           });
 954 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 955 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 956 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out
 957 |             color: new THREE.Color(fillColor), // Use the fillColor parameter instead of hardcoded value
 958 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],
 959 |             bumpScale: 1.0, // Maximum bump effect
 960 |             transparent: false, // Opaque for performance
 961 |             depthWrite: false, // Disable depth writing to prevent z-fighting
 962 |             depthTest: true, // Still test depth for proper ordering
 963 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides (important for cube faces)
 964 |             metalness: 1.0, // Fully metallic
 965 |             roughness: 0.1, // Very shiny
 966 |             polygonOffset: true, // Offset depth to prevent z-fighting with edges
 967 |             polygonOffsetFactor: -4,
 968 |             polygonOffsetUnits: -4
 969 |           }));
 970 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mats); // Array of 6 materials, one per face
 971 |         } else {
 972 |           // ===== MINI CUBE CREATION =====
 973 |           // 729 mini cubes that emerge from within large cubes
 974 |          // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 975 |           // --- ORIGINAL MINI CUBE MATERIAL CREATION (commented out) ---
 976 |           // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 977 |           //   color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC), // Blue color for mini-cubes
 978 |           //   transparent: false, // Opaque
 979 |           //   opacity: 1.0, // Fully opaque
 980 |           //   depthWrite: true, // Enable depth writing to prevent see-through
 981 |           //   depthTest: true, // Test depth
 982 |           //   side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides
 983 |           //   metalness: 0.25, // Balanced metallic feel

 986 |           // mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
 987 | 
 988 |           // --- MINI CUBE MATERIAL WITH NO GLOW/EMISSIVE ---
 989 |           const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 990 |             color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC),
 991 |             transparent: false,
 992 |             opacity: 1.0,
 993 |             depthWrite: true,
 994 |             depthTest: true,
 995 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide,
 996 |             metalness: 0.25,
 997 |             roughness: 0.5,
 998 |             emissive: new THREE.Color(0x000000), // No glow
 999 |             emissiveIntensity: 0.0 // No glow
1000 |           });
1001 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
1002 |         }
1003 |       } else {
1004 |         // ===== TINY CUBE CREATION =====
1005 |         // Smallest cubes in final sculpture formation
1006 |         const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
1007 |           color: fillColor,
1008 |           metalness: 1.0, // Highly metallic
1009 |           roughness: 0.25, // Smooth surface
1010 |           clearcoat: 1.0, // Clear coat layer for extra shine
1011 |           clearcoatRoughness: 0.15, // Smooth clear coat
1012 | //          envMapIntensity: 1.2 // Environment reflection intensity
1013 |         });
1014 |         mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat); // Single material for all faces
1015 |       }
1016 |       // ===== MESH CONFIGURATION =====
1017 |       mesh.castShadow = true; // Cast shadows for depth
1018 |       mesh.receiveShadow = true; // Receive shadows from other objects
1019 | 
1020 |       // ===== EDGE CREATION =====
1021 |       // Add edges for all cubes, but make mini-cube edges very thin
1022 |       const edges = new THREE.LineSegments(

1029 |       edges.renderOrder = 10; // Render edges on top of faces

1035 |     /**
1036 |      * Set fill color for all meshes in a 3D object hierarchy
1037 |      * Used for global color changes during different animation phases
1038 |      * @param {THREE.Object3D} obj3D - Root object to traverse
1039 |      * @param {number} color - Color value (hex number)
1040 |      */
1041 |     function setCubeFillColor(obj3D, color) {
1042 |       obj3D.traverse(o => {
1043 |         if (o.isMesh && o.material) {
1044 |           if (Array.isArray(o.material)) {
1045 |             // Handle multi-material meshes (cubes with different face materials)
1046 |             o.material.forEach(m => { if (m && m.color) m.color.set(color); });
1047 |           } else {
1048 |             // Handle single-material meshes
1049 |             if (o.material.color) o.material.color.set(color);
1050 |           }
1051 |         }
1052 |       });
1053 |     }

1171 |     // ===== LARGE CUBE SYSTEM (27 PIECES) =====

1591 |       // Mapping of section index (0-based) to one or more animation phases to pin through
1592 |       const mapping = new Map([

1594 |         [4, [4]],     // The Hidden Relations: P4
1595 |         [5, [5,6]],   // The Moment of Truth: P5 + P6
1596 |         [6, [7]],     // Locks, Locks Everywhere: P7
1597 |         [7, [8,9]],   // The Future, Ready Today: P8 + P9
1598 |       ]);
1599 |       let totalPads = 0;
1600 |       sections.forEach((sec, idx) => {
1601 |         let pad = sec.querySelector('.phase-pad');
1602 |         if (!pad) { pad = document.createElement('div'); pad.className = 'phase-pad'; sec.appendChild(pad); }
1603 |         let targetPx = 0;
1604 |         const phaseIds = mapping.get(idx);
1605 |         if (phaseIds){

1607 |           for (const id of ids) {

1609 |             if (p) targetPx += Math.max(0, Math.floor((p.end - p.start) * baseBudget));

1613 |         pad.style.height = needed + 'px';
1614 |         totalPads += needed;

  4 | import arTranslations from '../locales/ar.json';
  5 | 
  6 | interface RubiksIframeProps {
  7 |   height?: string;
  8 |   progress?: number | null; // 0..1 to externally drive the animation; null to let iframe use its own scroll
  9 |   onReady?: () => void;
 10 |   onProgress?: (value: number) => void;
 11 |   onPhaseChange?: (id: number, label: string) => void;
 12 | }
 13 | 
 14 | const RubiksIframe = forwardRef<HTMLIFrameElement, RubiksIframeProps>(
 15 |   ({ height = '100vh', progress = null, onReady, onProgress, onPhaseChange }, ref) => {
 16 |     const iframeRef = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement | null>(null);
 17 |     const resourcesInjectedRef = useRef(false);
 18 |     const initialLanguageRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
 19 |     useImperativeHandle(ref, () => iframeRef.current as HTMLIFrameElement, []);
 20 |     const { i18n } = useTranslation();
 21 | 
 22 |   const targetOrigin = useMemo(() => '*', []);
 23 | 
 24 |   // Inject i18n resources into iframe when it loads
 25 |   useEffect(() => {
 26 |     const iframe = iframeRef.current;
 27 |     if (!iframe) return;
 28 |

 30 |       const win = iframe.contentWindow;
 31 |       if (!win) return;
 32 | 
 33 |       console.log('[RubiksIframe] Iframe loaded, injecting i18n resources');
 34 |       // Inject i18n resources
 35 |       (win as any).i18nResources = {
 36 |         en: enTranslations,
 37 |         ar: arTranslations
 38 |       };
 39 |       resourcesInjectedRef.current = true;
 40 |       initialLanguageRef.current = i18n.language;

 45 |     };

 50 |       resourcesInjectedRef.current = false;
 51 |       initialLanguageRef.current = null;
 52 |     };
 53 |   }, [targetOrigin, i18n.language]);
 54 | 
 55 |   // Listen to messages from the iframe
 56 |   useEffect(() => {
 57 |     function handleMessage(e: MessageEvent) {
 58 |       const data = e && (e.data as any);
 59 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 60 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_READY') {
 61 |         console.log('[RubiksIframe] Received RUBIKS_READY from iframe');
 62 |         onReady && onReady();
 63 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_PROGRESS') {
 64 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 65 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) onProgress && onProgress(v);
 66 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_PHASE') {
 67 |         const id = Number(data.id);
 68 |         const label = String(data.label ?? '');
 69 |         if (!Number.isNaN(id)) onPhaseChange && onPhaseChange(id, label);
 70 |       }
 71 |     }
 72 |     window.addEventListener('message', handleMessage);
 73 |     return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handleMessage);
 74 |   }, [onReady, onProgress, onPhaseChange]);
 75 |

 77 |   useEffect(() => {
 78 |     // Skip if this is the initial language or resources not injected yet
 79 |     if (!resourcesInjectedRef.current || initialLanguageRef.current === i18n.language) {
 80 |       return;

 97 |     } else {

 99 |       if (!Number.isNaN(v)) {
100 |         win.postMessage({ type: 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS', value: v }, targetOrigin);
101 |       }
102 |     }
103 |   }, [progress, targetOrigin]);
104 | 
105 |     return (
106 |       <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height }}>

 397 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 398 |         <h1>Transforming Strategy Execution</h1>
 399 |         <h2>COMPLEXITY AS AN ASSET</h2>
 400 |         <p>Most transformations fail because complexity overwhelms. We turned that complexity into an advantage—redefining planning, risks, and dashboards inside one integrated model.</p>
 401 |       </div></section>
 402 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 403 |         <h1>Imagine a Parallel Universe</h1>
 404 |         <h2>WHERE TRANSFORMATIONS<br>
 405 | FLOW</h2>
 406 |         <p>Let us show you a week in that universe — A Week in the Life of a Transformation Team &lt;video link&gt;. Farfetched? It’s here. We built the MVP: a Net.js web app with a Supabase database and a Gemini Assistant, built on a five-year scenario dataset inspired by real transformation events.</p>
 407 |       </div></section>
 408 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 409 |         <h1>So How Did We Do It?</h1>
 410 |         <h2>THE RIGHT QUESTIONS FIRST</h2>
 411 |         <p>Before answers, you need the right questions. This journey begins by uncovering the questions that matter most—the ones that unlock how complexity really works.</p>
 412 |       </div></section>
 413 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 414 |         <h1>The Anatomy of an Organization</h1>
 415 |         <h2>WHAT MAKES AN ORGANIZATION?</h2>
 416 |         <p>Many things, like a living system of systems—Strategy, Policies, Processes, Digital  shaped by external forces such as markets and global events. Real transformation means understanding how these components interact, not treating them in isolation.</p>
 417 |       </div></section>
 418 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 419 |         <h1>The Hidden Relations</h1>
 420 |         <h2>HOW DEEP DOES IT GO?</h2>
 421 |         <p>Each component has its own inputs, outputs, and hidden ties to others. When those ties are mapped, patterns emerge—a structure that shows why small changes ripple across the whole system.</p>
 422 |       </div></section>
 423 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 424 |         <h1>The Moment of Truth</h1>
 425 |         <h2>SHOULD YOU WALK THIS JOURNEY?</h2>
 426 |         <p>We already did—and the answer is yes. But do it with eyes open. Complexity runs deeper than expected, and guidance is scarce. That’s why we built a model that captures the whole picture and makes the path navigable.</p>
 427 |       </div></section>
 428 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 429 |         <h1>Locks, Locks Everywhere</h1>
 430 |         <h2>WHAT DID 2 YEARS REVEAL?</h2>
 431 |         <p>Unlock after unlock, the journey was long and often tedious. Every piece had to be dissected, connected, and validated until a full digital twin of dependencies emerged. Just as we reached this milestone, AI leapt forward—suddenly powerful, affordable, and accessible—turning what seemed impossible into reality.</p>
 432 |       </div></section>
 433 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 434 |         <h1>The Future, Ready Today</h1>
 435 |         <h2>WHAT PATH WILL YOU CHOOSE?</h2>
 436 |         <p>With the AI core in place, the Digital Twin comes alive. We’ve hit a milestone, but the journey is still unfolding. Two paths now await: a Knowledge Path, where you contribute ideas and shape the future of transformations; and a Builder Path, where you begin your own strategy execution journey and put the twin to work.</p>
 437 |       </div></section>

 450 |   <script type="module">
 451 |     /**
 452 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 453 |      *
 454 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 455 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 456 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 457 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 458 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 459 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 460 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 461 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 462 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 463 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 464 |      *
 465 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 466 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 467 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 468 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 469 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 470 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 471 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 472 |      */
 473 | 
 474 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 475 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 476 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 477 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 478 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 479 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 480 | 
 481 |     // Background video speed control
 482 |     const bgVideo = document.querySelector('.bg-video');
 483 |     const VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE = 0.4;
 484 |     function applyVideoSpeed() { 
 485 |       try { if (bgVideo) bgVideo.playbackRate = VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE; } catch(_){}
 486 |     }
 487 |     if (bgVideo) { bgVideo.addEventListener('loadeddata', applyVideoSpeed); bgVideo.addEventListener('play', applyVideoSpeed); }
 488 |     applyVideoSpeed();
 489 | 
 490 |     // ===== ENHANCED NAVIGATION FOR FINALE BUTTONS =====
 491 |     function handleNavigation(e) {
 492 |       e.preventDefault();
 493 |       const navPath = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('href');
 494 |       if (navPath && window.top) {
 495 |         window.top.location.hash = navPath;
 496 |       }
 497 |     }
 498 | 
 499 |     function initializeNavigation() {
 500 |       const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.finale-enter-btn');
 501 |       btns.forEach(btn => {
 502 |         btn.addEventListener('click', handleNavigation);
 503 |       });
 504 |     }
 505 |     
 506 |     setTimeout(initializeNavigation, 200); // Increased timeout for safety
 507 | 
 508 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 509 |     /**
 510 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 511 |      */
 512 | 
 513 |     /**
 514 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 515 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 516 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 517 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 518 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 519 |      */
 520 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 521 | 
 522 |     /**
 523 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 524 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 525 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 526 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 527 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 528 |      */
 529 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 530 | 
 531 |     /**
 532 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 533 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 534 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 535 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 536 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 537 |      */
 538 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 539 | 
 540 |     /**
 541 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 542 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 543 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 544 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 545 |      */
 546 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 547 | 
 548 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 549 |     /**
 550 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 551 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 552 |      */
 553 | 
 554 |     /**
 555 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 556 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 557 |      */
 558 |     let externalProgress = null;
 559 | 
 560 |     /**
 561 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 562 |      * Supports two message types:
 563 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 564 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 565 |      */
 566 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 567 |       const data = e && e.data;
 568 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 569 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 570 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 571 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 572 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 573 |         externalProgress = null;
 574 |       }
 575 |     });

 577 |     /**
 578 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 579 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 580 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 581 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 582 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 583 |      */
 584 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }

 586 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 587 |     /**
 588 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 589 |      */
 590 | 
 591 |     /**
 592 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 593 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 594 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 595 |      */
 596 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 597 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 598 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 599 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 600 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 601 |     }
 602 | 
 603 |     /**
 604 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 605 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 606 |      */
 607 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 608 | 
 609 |     /**
 610 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 611 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 612 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 613 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 614 |      */
 615 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 616 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 617 |       const res = [];
 618 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 619 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 620 |       }
 621 |       return res;
 622 |     }
 623 | 
 624 |     /**
 625 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 626 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 627 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 628 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 629 |      */
 630 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 631 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 632 |       for (const c of corners) {
 633 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 634 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 635 |       }
 636 |       return true;
 637 |     }
 638 | 
 639 |     /**
 640 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 641 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 642 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 643 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 644 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 645 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 646 |      */
 647 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 648 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 649 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 650 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 651 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 652 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 653 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 654 |       }
 655 |       return lo;
 656 |     }
