 658 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 659 |     /**
 660 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 661 |      *
 662 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 663 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 664 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 665 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 666 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 667 |      *
 668 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 669 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 670 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 671 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 672 |      *
 673 |      * CACHING:
 674 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 675 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 676 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 677 |      */
 678 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 679 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 680 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 681 | 
 682 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 683 | 
 684 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 685 |       .then(response => response.json())
 686 |       .then(data => {
 687 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 688 |       })
 689 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 690 | 
 691 |     /**
 692 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 693 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 694 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 695 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 696 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 697 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 698 |      */
 699 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 700 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 701 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 702 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 703 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 704 | 
 705 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 706 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 707 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 708 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 709 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 710 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 711 | 
 712 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 713 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 714 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 715 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 716 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 717 |       ctx.fill();
 718 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 719 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 720 |       /**
 721 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 722 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 723 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 724 |        */
 725 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 726 |         ctx.save();
 727 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 728 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 729 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 730 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 731 | 
 732 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 733 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 734 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 735 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 736 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 737 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 738 | 
 739 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 740 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 741 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 742 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 743 |           // Vertical lines
 744 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 745 |             ctx.beginPath();
 746 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 747 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 748 |             ctx.stroke();
 749 |           }
 750 |           // Horizontal lines
 751 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 752 |             ctx.beginPath();
 753 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 754 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 755 |             ctx.stroke();
 756 |           }
 757 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 758 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 759 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 760 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 761 |             ctx.beginPath();
 762 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 763 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 764 |             ctx.stroke();
 765 |           }
 766 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 767 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 768 |           ctx.beginPath();
 769 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 770 |           ctx.stroke();
 771 |           ctx.beginPath();
 772 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 773 |           ctx.stroke();
 774 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 775 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 776 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 777 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 778 |             ctx.beginPath();
 779 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 780 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 781 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 782 |             ctx.stroke();
 783 |           }
 784 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 785 |           // Hexagon pattern
 786 |           const r = size*0.22;
 787 |           ctx.beginPath();
 788 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 789 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 790 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 791 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 792 |           }
 793 |           ctx.closePath();
 794 |           ctx.stroke();
 795 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 796 |           // Sine wave pattern
 797 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 798 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 799 |             ctx.beginPath();
 800 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 801 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 802 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 803 |             }
 804 |             ctx.stroke();
 805 |           }
 806 |         }
 807 |         ctx.restore();
 808 |       };
 809 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 810 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 811 | 
 812 |       if (drawGloss) {
 813 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 814 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 815 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 816 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 817 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 818 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 819 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 820 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 821 |         ctx.fill();
 822 |       }
 823 | 
 824 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 825 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 826 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 827 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 828 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 829 |       return tex;
 830 |     }
 831 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 832 | 
 833 |     /**
 834 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 835 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 836 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 837 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 838 |      */
 839 |     function shuffle(array) {
 840 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 841 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 842 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 843 |       }
 844 |       return array;
 845 |     }
 846 | 
 847 |     /**
 848 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 849 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 850 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 851 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 852 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 853 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 854 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 855 |      */
 856 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 857 |       ctx.beginPath();
 858 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 859 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 860 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 861 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 862 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 863 |       ctx.closePath();
 864 |     }
 865 | 
 866 |     /**
 867 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 868 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 869 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 870 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 871 |      */
 872 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 873 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 874 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 875 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 876 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 877 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 878 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 879 |     }
 880 |     /**
 881 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss
 882 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 textures, one per pattern
 883 |      */
 884 |     function getLargeStickerTextures(){
 885 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs;
 886 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 887 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;
 888 |       return texs;
 889 |     }
 890 | 
 891 |     /**
 892 |      * Get cached textures for mini cubes with solid colors (no patterns, no gloss)
 893 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 solid color textures
 894 |      */
 895 |     function getMiniStickerTextures(){
 896 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs;
 897 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], false, false));
 898 |       STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs = texs;
 899 |       return texs;
 900 |     }
 901 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 902 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 903 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;
 904 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 905 |       const planes = [];
 906 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 907 |       const dirs = [
 908 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 909 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 910 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 911 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 912 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z
 913 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 914 |       ];
 915 |       dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
 916 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 917 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 918 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 919 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 920 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 921 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 922 |         mesh.add(m);
 923 |         planes.push(m);
 924 |       });
 925 |       return planes;
 926 |     }

 928 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 929 |     /**
 930 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 931 |      *
 932 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 933 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 934 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 935 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 936 |      *
 937 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 938 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 939 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 940 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 941 |      *
 942 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 943 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 944 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 945 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 946 |      *
 947 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 948 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 949 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)
 950 |      * @returns {THREE.Mesh} Configured cube mesh with edges
 951 |      */
 952 |     function makeCube(size, fillColor, edgeColor, cubeIndex = 0) {
 953 |       const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
 954 |       let mesh;
 955 | 
 956 |       if (size > 0.1) {
 957 |         if (size >= 0.99) {
 958 |           // ===== LARGE CUBE CREATION =====
 959 |           // 27 large cubes forming the initial Rubik's cube structure
 960 |           const pats = fixedFaceAssignments.length > 0 ? fixedFaceAssignments.slice() : shuffle(FACE_PATTERNS.slice()); // Randomize pattern order per cube
 961 |           // Load all 6 bump map textures
 962 |           const bumpTextures = [1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n => {
 963 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 964 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 965 |             tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 966 |             tex.repeat.set(1, 1);
 967 |             return tex;
 968 |           });
 969 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 970 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 971 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out
 972 |             color: new THREE.Color(fillColor), // Use the fillColor parameter instead of hardcoded value
 973 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],
 974 |             bumpScale: 1.0, // Maximum bump effect
 975 |             transparent: false, // Opaque for performance
 976 |             depthWrite: false, // Disable depth writing to prevent z-fighting
 977 |             depthTest: true, // Still test depth for proper ordering
 978 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides (important for cube faces)
 979 |             metalness: 1.0, // Fully metallic
 980 |             roughness: 0.1, // Very shiny
 981 |             polygonOffset: true, // Offset depth to prevent z-fighting with edges
 982 |             polygonOffsetFactor: -4,
 983 |             polygonOffsetUnits: -4
 984 |           }));
 985 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mats); // Array of 6 materials, one per face
 986 |         } else {
 987 |           // ===== MINI CUBE CREATION =====
 988 |           // 729 mini cubes that emerge from within large cubes
 989 |          // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 990 |           // --- ORIGINAL MINI CUBE MATERIAL CREATION (commented out) ---
 991 |           // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 992 |           //   color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC), // Blue color for mini-cubes
 993 |           //   transparent: false, // Opaque
 994 |           //   opacity: 1.0, // Fully opaque
 995 |           //   depthWrite: true, // Enable depth writing to prevent see-through
 996 |           //   depthTest: true, // Test depth
 997 |           //   side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides
 998 |           //   metalness: 0.25, // Balanced metallic feel
 999 |           //   roughness: 0.5 // Balanced surface roughness
1000 |           // });
1001 |           // mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
1002 | 
1003 |           // --- MINI CUBE MATERIAL WITH NO GLOW/EMISSIVE ---
1004 |           const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
1005 |             color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC),
1006 |             transparent: false,
1007 |             opacity: 1.0,
1008 |             depthWrite: true,
1009 |             depthTest: true,
1010 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide,
1011 |             metalness: 0.25,
1012 |             roughness: 0.5,
1013 |             emissive: new THREE.Color(0x000000), // No glow
1014 |             emissiveIntensity: 0.0 // No glow
1015 |           });
1016 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
1017 |         }
1018 |       } else {
1019 |         // ===== TINY CUBE CREATION =====
1020 |         // Smallest cubes in final sculpture formation
1021 |         const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
1022 |           color: fillColor,
1023 |           metalness: 1.0, // Highly metallic
1024 |           roughness: 0.25, // Smooth surface
1025 |           clearcoat: 1.0, // Clear coat layer for extra shine
1026 |           clearcoatRoughness: 0.15, // Smooth clear coat
1027 | //          envMapIntensity: 1.2 // Environment reflection intensity
1028 |         });
1029 |         mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat); // Single material for all faces
1030 |       }
1031 |       // ===== MESH CONFIGURATION =====
1032 |       mesh.castShadow = true; // Cast shadows for depth
1033 |       mesh.receiveShadow = true; // Receive shadows from other objects
1034 | 
1035 |       // ===== EDGE CREATION =====
1036 |       // Add edges for all cubes, but make mini-cube edges very thin
1037 |       const edges = new THREE.LineSegments(
1038 |         new THREE.EdgesGeometry(geom), // Extract edges from box geometry
1039 |         new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
1040 |           color: edgeColor, // Use provided edge color
1041 |           linewidth: size >= 0.99 ? 1 : 0.5 // Thin lines for mini-cubes
1042 |         })
1043 |       );
1044 |       edges.renderOrder = 10; // Render edges on top of faces
1045 |       mesh.add(edges); // Add as child so edges follow mesh transformations
1046 | 
1047 |       return mesh;
1048 |     }

1050 |     /**
1051 |      * Set fill color for all meshes in a 3D object hierarchy
1052 |      * Used for global color changes during different animation phases
1053 |      * @param {THREE.Object3D} obj3D - Root object to traverse
1054 |      * @param {number} color - Color value (hex number)
1055 |      */
1056 |     function setCubeFillColor(obj3D, color) {
1057 |       obj3D.traverse(o => {
1058 |         if (o.isMesh && o.material) {

1475 |      * PHASE TIMING (as percentage of total scroll):

1478 |      * 3: 12.06-14.48% - Pieces settle with random rotations
1479 |      * 4: 14.48-31.38% - Large cubes shrink, mini-cubes emerge

1481 |      * 6: 43.0-52.0% - Mini-cubes recolor cyan to purple one-by-one
1482 |      * 7: 52.0-62.0% - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
1483 |      * 8: 62.0-70.0% - Transform into final spherical sculpture
1484 |      * 9: 70.0-100% - Interactive final formation with mouse controls

1502 |     /*

1505 |       function dynamicPhase2Radius() {

1507 |         const halfMin = Math.min(halfW, halfH);

1513 |       function projectCornersWithinPad(center, halfDiag) {

1516 |           new THREE.Vector3( 1,-1, 1), new THREE.Vector3( 1,-1,-1),
1517 |           new THREE.Vector3(-1, 1, 1), new THREE.Vector3(-1, 1,-1),
1518 |           new THREE.Vector3(-1,-1, 1), new THREE.Vector3(-1,-1,-1)
1519 |         ];
1520 |         for (const c of corners) {
1521 |           const p = center.clone().add(c.multiplyScalar(halfDiag)).project(camera);
1522 |           if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC) return false;
1523 |         }

1572 |     (function buildSculpture(){

1574 |       const baseR = frameSize * (0.92 / 2.2); // match reference ratio, scaled to Phase 1 frame

1580 |           for(let b=0; b<lonSteps; b++){
1581 |             const theta = 2*Math.PI*(b/lonSteps);
1582 |             const nx = Math.sin(phi)*Math.cos(theta);
1583 |             const ny = Math.cos(phi);
1584 |             const nz = Math.sin(phi)*Math.sin(theta);

1587 |             const q=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1), new THREE.Vector3(nx,ny,nz));

1589 |             const s=new THREE.Vector3(1,1,elong);
1590 |             sculpturePos[k]=new THREE.Vector3(px,py,pz);
1591 |             sculptureQuat[k]=q;
1592 |             sculptureScale[k]=s;
1593 |             k++;
1594 |           }
1595 |         }
1596 |       }

<result>## ✅ Race Condition Fixed!

I've successfully fixed the race condition that was preventing the text from rendering. The issue was that the iframe was trying to render overlays immediately on `DOMContentLoaded`, but the i18n resources hadn't been injected yet.

### 🔧 What Was Fixed:

**Modified `public/rubiks-cdn.html`** - Updated the DOMContentLoaded listener to wait for i18n resources:

```javascript
// Wait for i18n resources to be injected before rendering overlays
window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  console.log("[rubiks-cdn] DOMContentLoaded, waiting for i18n resources");
  // Check if resources are already available
  if (window.i18nResources) {
    console.log("[rubiks-cdn] Resources already available, rendering overlays");
    renderOverlays();
  } else {
    // Wait for resources to be injected
    const checkResources = () => {
      if (window.i18nResources) {
        console.log("[rubiks-cdn] Resources now available, rendering overlays");
        renderOverlays();
      } else {
        setTimeout(checkResources, 50);
      }
    };
    checkResources();
  }
});
```

### 🎯 Expected Behavior Now:

1. **Iframe loads** → DOMContentLoaded fires → Waits for resources
2. **Parent injects i18n resources** → Resources become available
3. **Iframe detects resources** → Calls `renderOverlays()`
4. **Text renders** → Localized text appears and animates properly

### 📊 Console Logs to Verify:

You should now see these console messages in the correct order:
```
[rubiks-cdn] DOMContentLoaded, waiting for i18n resources
[RubiksIframe] Iframe loaded, injecting i18n resources
[RubiksIframe] i18n resources injected. Triggering initial render with language: en
[rubiks-cdn] Resources now available, rendering overlays
[renderOverlays] Step 1: Language = en
[renderOverlays] Step 2: overlays data = Object
[renderOverlays] Step 3: window.i18nResources = {en: {...}, ar: {...}}
[renderOverlays] Step 6: Final HTML length = [number > 0]
```

The Rubiks cube animation should now display localized text properly in both English and Arabic, with smooth transitions between text blocks as the animation progresses!</result>
</attempt_completion>

 228 |     <!-- END overlay blocks -->
 229 |     <script>
 230 |       // Simple i18n loader for overlays
 231 |       const overlayKeys = [
 232 |         "intro-1", "intro-2", "intro-3", "p23-your-org", "p4-hidden", "p56-where", "p7-two-years", "p89-future", "twinlab", "twinstudio", "finale-twinlab-twinstudio"
 233 |       ];
 234 |       function getI18n(lang) {
 235 |         if (window.i18nResources && window.i18nResources[lang] && window.i18nResources[lang].overlays) {
 236 |           return window.i18nResources[lang].overlays;
 237 |         }
 238 |         console.warn('No i18n resources found for language:', lang);
 239 |         return {};
 240 |       }
 241 |       function getLang() {
 242 |         try {
 243 |           if (window.parent && window.parent.document && window.parent.document.documentElement.lang) {
 244 |             return window.parent.document.documentElement.lang;
 245 |           }
 246 |         } catch (e) {}
 247 |         const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
 248 |         if (params.get('lang')) return params.get('lang');
 249 |         return 'en';
 250 |       }
 251 | 
 252 |        // Define overlayRoot before renderOverlays function
 253 |        const overlayRoot = 
 254 |        document.getElementById('phaseOverlay');
 255 | 
 256 | function renderOverlays(forceLang) {
 257 |   let lang = forceLang || getLang();
 258 |   lang = lang && lang.startsWith('ar') ? 'ar' : 'en';
 259 |   console.log('[renderOverlays] Step 1: Language =', lang);
 260 |   
 261 |   const overlays = getI18n(lang);
 262 |   console.log('[renderOverlays] Step 2: overlays data =', overlays);
 263 |   console.log('[renderOverlays] Step 3: window.i18nResources =', window.i18nResources);
 264 |   
 265 |   const overlayInner = document.getElementById('overlayInner');
 266 |   console.log('[renderOverlays] Step 4: overlayInner element =', overlayInner);
 267 |   
 268 |   if (!overlayInner || !overlays) {
 269 |     console.error('[renderOverlays] ABORT - missing overlayInner or overlays');
 270 |     return;
 271 |   }
 272 |   
 273 |   overlayInner.innerHTML = '';
 274 |  // console.log('[renderOverlays] Step 5: Starting to process keys');
 275 | 
 276 |         overlayKeys.forEach(key => {
 277 |           const data = overlays[key];
 278 |           if (!data) return;
 279 |           if (key === 'finale-twinlab-twinstudio') {
 280 |             overlayInner.innerHTML += `
 281 |               <div class="phase-text-block finale-blocks" data-key="finale-twinlab-twinstudio">
 282 |                 <div class="finale-columns">
 283 |                   <div class="finale-left-column">
 284 |                     <div class="finale-header">
 285 |                       <img src="/assets/cosmic/twinlab-logo.png" alt="TwinLab Logo" class="finale-logo">
 286 |                       <h1>${data.twinlab.h1}</h1>
 287 |                     </div>
 288 |                     <h2>${data.twinlab.h2}</h2>
 289 |                     <p>${data.twinlab.p}</p>
 290 |                     <div style="height: 36px;"></div>
 291 |                     <a href="#/twinlab" class="finale-enter-btn" aria-label="Enter TwinLab platform" title="Navigate to TwinLab - Knowledge Path" target="_top">${data.twinlab.enter}</a>
 292 |                   </div>
 293 |                   <div class="finale-right-column">
 294 |                     <div class="finale-header">
 295 |                       <img src="/images/josoorlogo.png" alt="TwinStudio Logo" class="finale-logo">
 296 |                       <h1>${data.twinstudio.h1}</h1>
 297 |                     </div>
 298 |                     <h2>${data.twinstudio.h2}</h2>
 299 |                     <p>${data.twinstudio.p}</p>
 300 |                     <div style="height: 36px;"></div>
 301 |                     <a href="#/roadmap" class="finale-enter-btn" aria-label="Enter TwinStudio" title="Navigate to TwinStudio - Roadmap" target="_top">${data.twinstudio.enter}</a>
 302 |                   </div>
 303 |                 </div>
 304 |               </div>
 305 |             `;
 306 |           } else {
 307 |             overlayInner.innerHTML += `
 308 |               <div class="phase-text-block" data-key="${key}" lang="${lang}" dir="${lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}">
 309 |                 <h1>${data.h1}</h1>
 310 |                 <h2>${data.h2}</h2>
 311 |                 <p>${data.p}</p>
 312 |               </div>
 313 |             `;
 314 |           }
 315 |         });  //this closes forEach
 316 |         console.log('[renderOverlays] Step 6: Final HTML length =', 
 317 |         overlayInner.innerHTML.length);
 318 | 
 319 |   console.log('[renderOverlays] Final HTML =', overlayInner.innerHTML.length, 'chars');
 320 |   
 321 |   // Re-initialize overlayBlocks array
 322 |   if (typeof overlayRoot !== 'undefined' && overlayRoot) {
 323 |     const newBlocks = Array.from(overlayRoot.querySelectorAll('.phase-text-block'));
 324 |     if (typeof overlayBlocks !== 'undefined') {
 325 |       overlayBlocks.length = 0;
 326 |       overlayBlocks.push(...newBlocks);
 327 |     }
 328 |     setTimeout(() => {
 329 |       if (typeof setActive === 'function') setActive('intro-1');
 330 |     }, 100);
 331 |   }
 332 | }  // This closes the function
 333 |   
 334 |     // Wait for i18n resources to be injected before rendering overlays
 335 |     window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
 336 |       console.log("[rubiks-cdn] DOMContentLoaded, waiting for i18n resources");
 337 |       // Check if resources are already available
 338 |       if (window.i18nResources) {
 339 |         console.log("[rubiks-cdn] Resources already available, rendering overlays");
 340 |         renderOverlays();
 341 |       } else {
 342 |         // Wait for resources to be injected
 343 |         const checkResources = () => {
 344 |           if (window.i18nResources) {
 345 |             console.log("[rubiks-cdn] Resources now available, rendering overlays");
 346 |             renderOverlays();
 347 |           } else {
 348 |             setTimeout(checkResources, 50);
 349 |           }
 350 |         };
 351 |         checkResources();
 352 |       }
 353 |     });
 354 |       const htmlEl = document.documentElement;
 355 |       if (window.MutationObserver) {
 356 |         new MutationObserver(() => renderOverlays()).observe(htmlEl, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['lang'] });
 357 |       }

 400 |         <p>Most transformations fail because complexity overwhelms. We turned that complexity into an advantage—redefining planning, risks, and dashboards inside one integrated model.</p>

 404 |         <h2>WHERE TRANSFORMATIONS<br>
 405 | FLOW</h2>
 406 |         <p>Let us show you a week in that universe — A Week in the Life of a Transformation Team &lt;video link&gt;. Farfetched? It’s here. We built the MVP: a Net.js web app with a Supabase database and a Gemini Assistant, built on a five-year scenario dataset inspired by real transformation events.</p>
 407 |       </div></section>
 408 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 409 |         <h1>So How Did We Do It?</h1>
 410 |         <h2>THE RIGHT QUESTIONS FIRST</h2>
 411 |         <p>Before answers, you need the right questions. This journey begins by uncovering the questions that matter most—the ones that unlock how complexity really works.</p>
 412 |       </div></section>
 413 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 414 |         <h1>The Anatomy of an Organization</h1>
 415 |         <h2>WHAT MAKES AN ORGANIZATION?</h2>
 416 |         <p>Many things, like a living system of systems—Strategy, Policies, Processes, Digital  shaped by external forces such as markets and global events. Real transformation means understanding how these components interact, not treating them in isolation.</p>
 417 |       </div></section>
 418 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 419 |         <h1>The Hidden Relations</h1>
 420 |         <h2>HOW DEEP DOES IT GO?</h2>
 421 |         <p>Each component has its own inputs, outputs, and hidden ties to others. When those ties are mapped, patterns emerge—a structure that shows why small changes ripple across the whole system.</p>
 422 |       </div></section>
 423 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 424 |         <h1>The Moment of Truth</h1>

 426 |         <p>We already did—and the answer is yes. But do it with eyes open. Complexity runs deeper than expected, and guidance is scarce. That’s why we built a model that captures the whole picture and makes the path navigable.</p>

Just as we reached this milestone, AI leapt forward—suddenly powerful, affordable, and accessible—turning what seemed impossible into reality.</p>

 450 |   <script type="module">
 451 |     /**
 452 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 453 |      *
 454 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 455 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 456 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 457 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 458 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 459 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 460 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 461 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 462 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 463 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 464 |      *
 465 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 466 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 467 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 468 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 469 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 470 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 471 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 472 |      */
 473 | 
 474 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 475 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 476 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 477 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 478 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 479 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 480 | 
 481 |     // Background video speed control
 482 |     const bgVideo = document.querySelector('.bg-video');
 483 |     const VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE = 0.4;
 484 |     function applyVideoSpeed() { 
 485 |       try { if (bgVideo) bgVideo.playbackRate = VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE; } catch(_){}
 486 |     }
 487 |     if (bgVideo) { bgVideo.addEventListener('loadeddata', applyVideoSpeed); bgVideo.addEventListener('play', applyVideoSpeed); }
 488 |     applyVideoSpeed();
 489 | 
 490 |     // ===== ENHANCED NAVIGATION FOR FINALE BUTTONS =====
 491 |     function handleNavigation(e) {
 492 |       e.preventDefault();
 493 |       const navPath = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('href');
 494 |       if (navPath && window.top) {
 495 |         window.top.location.hash = navPath;
 496 |       }
 497 |     }
 498 | 
 499 |     function initializeNavigation() {
 500 |       const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.finale-enter-btn');
 501 |       btns.forEach(btn => {
 502 |         btn.addEventListener('click', handleNavigation);
 503 |       });
 504 |     }
 505 |     
 506 |     setTimeout(initializeNavigation, 200); // Increased timeout for safety
 507 | 
 508 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 509 |     /**
 510 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 511 |      */
 512 | 
 513 |     /**
 514 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 515 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 516 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 517 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 518 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 519 |      */
 520 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 521 | 
 522 |     /**
 523 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 524 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 525 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 526 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 527 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 528 |      */
 529 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 530 | 
 531 |     /**
 532 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 533 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 534 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 535 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 536 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 537 |      */
 538 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 539 | 
 540 |     /**
 541 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 542 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 543 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 544 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 545 |      */
 546 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 547 | 
 548 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 549 |     /**
 550 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 551 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 552 |      */
 553 | 
 554 |     /**
 555 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 556 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 557 |      */
 558 |     let externalProgress = null;
 559 | 
 560 |     /**
 561 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 562 |      * Supports two message types:
 563 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 564 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 565 |      */
 566 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 567 |       const data = e && e.data;
 568 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 569 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 570 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 571 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 572 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 573 |         externalProgress = null;
 574 |       }
 575 |     });
 576 | 
 577 |     /**
 578 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 579 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 580 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 581 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 582 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 583 |      */
 584 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 585 | 
 586 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 587 |     /**
 588 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 589 |      */
 590 | 
 591 |     /**
 592 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 593 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 594 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 595 |      */
 596 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 597 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 598 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 599 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 600 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 601 |     }
 602 | 
 603 |     /**
 604 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 605 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 606 |      */
 607 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 608 | 
 609 |     /**
 610 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 611 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 612 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 613 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 614 |      */
 615 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 616 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 617 |       const res = [];
 618 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 619 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 620 |       }
 621 |       return res;
 622 |     }
 623 | 
 624 |     /**
 625 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 626 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 627 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 628 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 629 |      */
 630 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 631 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 632 |       for (const c of corners) {
 633 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 634 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 635 |       }
 636 |       return true;
 637 |     }
 638 | 
 639 |     /**
 640 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 641 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 642 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 643 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 644 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 645 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 646 |      */
 647 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 648 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 649 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 650 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 651 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 652 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 653 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 654 |       }
 655 |       return lo;
 656 |     }
 657 | 
 658 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 659 |     /**
 660 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 661 |      *
 662 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 663 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 664 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 665 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 666 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 667 |      *
 668 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 669 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 670 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 671 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 672 |      *
 673 |      * CACHING:
 674 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 675 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 676 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 677 |      */
 678 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 679 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 680 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 681 | 
 682 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 683 | 
 684 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 685 |       .then(response => response.json())
 686 |       .then(data => {
 687 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 688 |       })
 689 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 690 | 
 691 |     /**
 692 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 693 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 694 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 695 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 696 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 697 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 698 |      */
 699 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 700 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 701 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 702 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 703 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 704 | 
 705 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 706 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 707 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 708 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 709 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 710 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 711 | 
 712 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 713 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 714 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 715 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 716 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 717 |       ctx.fill();
 718 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 719 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 720 |       /**
 721 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 722 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 723 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 724 |        */
 725 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 726 |         ctx.save();
 727 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 728 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 729 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 730 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 731 | 
 732 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 733 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 734 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 735 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 736 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 737 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 738 | 
 739 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 740 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 741 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 742 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 743 |           // Vertical lines
 744 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 745 |             ctx.beginPath();
 746 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 747 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 748 |             ctx.stroke();
 749 |           }
 750 |           // Horizontal lines
 751 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 752 |             ctx.beginPath();
 753 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 754 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 755 |             ctx.stroke();
 756 |           }
 757 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 758 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 759 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 760 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 761 |             ctx.beginPath();
 762 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 763 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 764 |             ctx.stroke();
 765 |           }
 766 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 767 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 768 |           ctx.beginPath();
 769 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 770 |           ctx.stroke();
 771 |           ctx.beginPath();
 772 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 773 |           ctx.stroke();
 774 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 775 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 776 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 777 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 778 |             ctx.beginPath();
 779 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 780 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 781 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 782 |             ctx.stroke();
 783 |           }
 784 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 785 |           // Hexagon pattern
 786 |           const r = size*0.22;
 787 |           ctx.beginPath();
 788 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 789 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 790 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 791 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 792 |           }
 793 |           ctx.closePath();
 794 |           ctx.stroke();
 795 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 796 |           // Sine wave pattern
 797 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 798 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 799 |             ctx.beginPath();
 800 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 801 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 802 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 803 |             }
 804 |             ctx.stroke();
 805 |           }
 806 |         }
 807 |         ctx.restore();
 808 |       };
 809 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 810 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 811 | 
 812 |       if (drawGloss) {
 813 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 814 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 815 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 816 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 817 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 818 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 819 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 820 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 821 |         ctx.fill();
 822 |       }
 823 | 
 824 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 825 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 826 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 827 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 828 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 829 |       return tex;
 830 |     }
 831 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 832 | 
 833 |     /**
 834 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 835 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 836 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 837 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 838 |      */
 839 |     function shuffle(array) {
 840 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 841 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 842 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 843 |       }
 844 |       return array;
 845 |     }
 846 | 
 847 |     /**
 848 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 849 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 850 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 851 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 852 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 853 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 854 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 855 |      */
 856 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 857 |       ctx.beginPath();
 858 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 859 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 860 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 861 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 862 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 863 |       ctx.closePath();
 864 |     }
 865 | 
 866 |     /**
 867 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 868 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 869 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 870 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 871 |      */
 872 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 873 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 874 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 875 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 876 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 877 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 878 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 879 |     }
 880 |     /**
 881 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss
 882 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 textures, one per pattern
 883 |      */
 884 |     function getLargeStickerTextures(){
 885 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs;
 886 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 887 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;
 888 |       return texs;
 889 |     }
 890 | 
 891 |     /**
 892 |      * Get cached textures for mini cubes with solid colors (no patterns, no gloss)
 893 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 solid color textures
 894 |      */
 895 |     function getMiniStickerTextures(){
 896 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs;
 897 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], false, false));
 898 |       STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs = texs;
 899 |       return texs;
 900 |     }
 901 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 902 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset

 904 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 905 |       const planes = [];
 906 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 907 |       const dirs = [
 908 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 909 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 910 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 911 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 912 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z
 913 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 914 |       ];
 915 |       dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
 916 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 917 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 918 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 919 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 920 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 921 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 922 |         mesh.add(m);
 923 |         planes.push(m);
 924 |       });
 925 |       return planes;
 926 |     }

 928 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 929 |     /**
 930 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 931 |      *
 932 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 933 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 934 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 935 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 936 |      *
 937 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 938 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 939 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 940 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 941 |      *
 942 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 943 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 944 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 945 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 946 |      *
 947 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 948 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 949 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)

 951 |      */
 952 |     function makeCube(size, fillColor, edgeColor, cubeIndex = 0) {
 953 |       const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
 954 |       let mesh;
 955 | 
 956 |       if (size > 0.1) {
 957 |         if (size >= 0.99) {
 958 |           // ===== LARGE CUBE CREATION =====
 959 |           // 27 large cubes forming the initial Rubik's cube structure
 960 |           const pats = fixedFaceAssignments.length > 0 ? fixedFaceAssignments.slice() : shuffle(FACE_PATTERNS.slice()); // Randomize pattern order per cube
 961 |           // Load all 6 bump map textures
 962 |           const bumpTextures = [1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n => {
 963 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 964 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 965 |             tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 966 |             tex.repeat.set(1, 1);
 967 |             return tex;
 968 |           });
 969 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 970 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 971 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out
 972 |             color: new THREE.Color(fillColor), // Use the fillColor parameter instead of hardcoded value
 973 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],
 974 |             bumpScale: 1.0, // Maximum bump effect
 975 |             transparent: false, // Opaque for performance
 976 |             depthWrite: false, // Disable depth writing to prevent z-fighting
 977 |             depthTest: true, // Still test depth for proper ordering
 978 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides (important for cube faces)
 979 |             metalness: 1.0, // Fully metallic
 980 |             roughness: 0.1, // Very shiny
 981 |             polygonOffset: true, // Offset depth to prevent z-fighting with edges
 982 |             polygonOffsetFactor: -4,
 983 |             polygonOffsetUnits: -4
 984 |           }));
 985 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mats); // Array of 6 materials, one per face
 986 |         } else {
 987 |           // ===== MINI CUBE CREATION =====
 988 |           // 729 mini cubes that emerge from within large cubes
 989 |          // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 990 |           // --- ORIGINAL MINI CUBE MATERIAL CREATION (commented out) ---
 991 |           // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({

1000 |           // });
1001 |           // mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
1002 | 
1003 |           // --- MINI CUBE MATERIAL WITH NO GLOW/EMISSIVE ---
1004 |           const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
1005 |             color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC),
1006 |             transparent: false,
1007 |             opacity: 1.0,
1008 |             depthWrite: true,
1009 |             depthTest: true,
1010 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide,
1011 |             metalness: 0.25,
1012 |             roughness: 0.5,
1013 |             emissive: new THREE.Color(0x000000), // No glow
1014 |             emissiveIntensity: 0.0 // No glow
1015 |           });
1016 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
1017 |         }
1018 |       } else {
1019 |         // ===== TINY CUBE CREATION =====
1020 |         // Smallest cubes in final sculpture formation
1021 |         const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
1022 |           color: fillColor,
1023 |           metalness: 1.0, // Highly metallic
1024 |           roughness: 0.25, // Smooth surface
1025 |           clearcoat: 1.0, // Clear coat layer for extra shine
1026 |           clearcoatRoughness: 0.15, // Smooth clear coat
1027 | //          envMapIntensity: 1.2 // Environment reflection intensity
1028 |         });
1029 |         mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat); // Single material for all faces
1030 |       }
1031 |       // ===== MESH CONFIGURATION =====
1032 |       mesh.castShadow = true; // Cast shadows for depth
1033 |       mesh.receiveShadow = true; // Receive shadows from other objects
1034 | 
1035 |       // ===== EDGE CREATION =====
1036 |       // Add edges for all cubes, but make mini-cube edges very thin
1037 |       const edges = new THREE.LineSegments(
1038 |         new THREE.EdgesGeometry(geom), // Extract edges from box geometry
1039 |         new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
1040 |           color: edgeColor, // Use provided edge color
1041 |           linewidth: size >= 0.99 ? 1 : 0.5 // Thin lines for mini-cubes
1042 |         })

1044 |       edges.renderOrder = 10; // Render edges on top of faces

1050 |     /**
1051 |      * Set fill color for all meshes in a 3D object hierarchy
1052 |      * Used for global color changes during different animation phases
1053 |      * @param {THREE.Object3D} obj3D - Root object to traverse
1054 |      * @param {number} color - Color value (hex number)
1055 |      */
1056 |     function setCubeFillColor(obj3D, color) {
1057 |       obj3D.traverse(o => {
1058 |         if (o.isMesh && o.material) {
1059 |           if (Array.isArray(o.material)) {
1060 |             // Handle multi-material meshes (cubes with different face materials)
1061 |             o.material.forEach(m => { if (m && m.color) m.color.set(color); });
1062 |           } else {
1063 |             // Handle single-material meshes
1064 |             if (o.material.color) o.material.color.set(color);
1065 |           }
1066 |         }
1067 |       });
1068 |     }

1254 |     // ===== MINI CUBE SYSTEM (729 PIECES) =====
1255 |     /**

1582 |             const nx = Math.sin(phi)*Math.cos(theta);
1583 |             const ny = Math.cos(phi);
1584 |             const nz = Math.sin(phi)*Math.sin(theta);

1593 |             k++;
1594 |           }

1596 |       }

1606 |       // Mapping of section index (0-based) to one or more animation phases to pin through
1607 |       const mapping = new Map([
1608 |         [3, [2,3]],   // The Anatomy of an Organization: P2 + P3
1609 |         [4, [4]],     // The Hidden Relations: P4
1610 |         [5, [5,6]],   // The Moment of Truth: P5 + P6
1611 |         [6, [7]],     // Locks, Locks Everywhere: P7
1612 |         [7, [8,9]],   // The Future, Ready Today: P8 + P9

1616 |         let pad = sec.querySelector('.phase-pad');
1617 |         if (!pad) { pad = document.createElement('div'); pad.className = 'phase-pad'; sec.appendChild(pad); }
1618 |         let targetPx = 0;

1627 |         const needed = Math.max(0, targetPx);

We built the MVP: a Net.js web app with a Supabase database and a Gemini Assistant, built on a five-year scenario dataset inspired by real transformation events.</p>

 450 |   <script type="module">
 451 |     /**
 452 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 453 |      *
 454 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 455 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 456 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 457 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 458 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 459 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 460 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 461 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 462 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 463 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 464 |      *
 465 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 466 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 467 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 468 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 469 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 470 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 471 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 472 |      */
 473 | 
 474 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 475 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 476 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 477 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 478 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 479 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 480 | 
 481 |     // Background video speed control
 482 |     const bgVideo = document.querySelector('.bg-video');
 483 |     const VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE = 0.4;
 484 |     function applyVideoSpeed() { 
 485 |       try { if (bgVideo) bgVideo.playbackRate = VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE; } catch(_){}
 486 |     }
 487 |     if (bgVideo) { bgVideo.addEventListener('loadeddata', applyVideoSpeed); bgVideo.addEventListener('play', applyVideoSpeed); }
 488 |     applyVideoSpeed();
 489 | 
 490 |     // ===== ENHANCED NAVIGATION FOR FINALE BUTTONS =====
 491 |     function handleNavigation(e) {
 492 |       e.preventDefault();
 493 |       const navPath = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('href');
 494 |       if (navPath && window.top) {
 495 |         window.top.location.hash = navPath;

 499 |     function initializeNavigation() {
 500 |       const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.finale-enter-btn');
 501 |       btns.forEach(btn => {

 503 |       });
 504 |     }
