 506 |     setTimeout(initializeNavigation, 200); // Increased timeout for safety
 507 | 
 508 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 509 |     /**
 510 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 511 |      */
 512 | 
 513 |     /**
 514 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 515 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 516 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 517 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 518 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 519 |      */
 520 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 521 | 
 522 |     /**
 523 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 524 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 525 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 526 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 527 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 528 |      */
 529 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 530 | 
 531 |     /**
 532 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 533 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 534 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 535 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 536 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 537 |      */
 538 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 539 | 
 540 |     /**
 541 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 542 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 543 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 544 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 545 |      */
 546 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 547 | 
 548 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 549 |     /**
 550 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 551 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 552 |      */
 553 | 
 554 |     /**
 555 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 556 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 557 |      */
 558 |     let externalProgress = null;
 559 | 
 560 |     /**
 561 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 562 |      * Supports two message types:
 563 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 564 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 565 |      */
 566 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 567 |       const data = e && e.data;
 568 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 569 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 570 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 571 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 572 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 573 |         externalProgress = null;
 574 |       }
 575 |     });
 576 | 
 577 |     /**
 578 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 579 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 580 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 581 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 582 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 583 |      */
 584 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 585 | 
 586 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 587 |     /**
 588 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 589 |      */
 590 | 
 591 |     /**
 592 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 593 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 594 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 595 |      */
 596 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 597 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 598 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 599 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 600 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 601 |     }
 602 | 
 603 |     /**
 604 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 605 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 606 |      */
 607 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 608 | 
 609 |     /**
 610 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 611 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 612 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 613 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 614 |      */
 615 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 616 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 617 |       const res = [];
 618 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 619 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 620 |       }
 621 |       return res;
 622 |     }
 623 | 
 624 |     /**
 625 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 626 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 627 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 628 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 629 |      */
 630 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 631 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 632 |       for (const c of corners) {
 633 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 634 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 635 |       }
 636 |       return true;
 637 |     }
 638 | 
 639 |     /**
 640 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 641 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 642 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 643 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 644 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 645 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 646 |      */
 647 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 648 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 649 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 650 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 651 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 652 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 653 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 654 |       }
 655 |       return lo;
 656 |     }
 657 | 
 658 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 659 |     /**
 660 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 661 |      *
 662 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 663 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 664 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 665 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 666 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 667 |      *
 668 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 669 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 670 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 671 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 672 |      *
 673 |      * CACHING:
 674 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 675 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 676 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 677 |      */
 678 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 679 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 680 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 681 | 
 682 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 683 | 
 684 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 685 |       .then(response => response.json())
 686 |       .then(data => {
 687 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 688 |       })
 689 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 690 | 
 691 |     /**
 692 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 693 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 694 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 695 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 696 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 697 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 698 |      */
 699 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 700 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 701 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 702 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 703 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 704 | 
 705 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 706 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 707 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 708 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 709 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 710 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 711 | 
 712 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 713 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 714 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 715 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 716 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 717 |       ctx.fill();
 718 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 719 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 720 |       /**
 721 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 722 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 723 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 724 |        */
 725 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 726 |         ctx.save();
 727 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 728 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 729 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 730 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 731 | 
 732 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 733 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 734 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 735 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 736 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 737 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 738 | 
 739 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 740 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 741 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 742 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 743 |           // Vertical lines
 744 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 745 |             ctx.beginPath();
 746 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 747 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 748 |             ctx.stroke();
 749 |           }
 750 |           // Horizontal lines
 751 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 752 |             ctx.beginPath();
 753 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 754 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 755 |             ctx.stroke();
 756 |           }
 757 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 758 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 759 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 760 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 761 |             ctx.beginPath();
 762 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 763 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 764 |             ctx.stroke();
 765 |           }
 766 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 767 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 768 |           ctx.beginPath();
 769 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 770 |           ctx.stroke();
 771 |           ctx.beginPath();
 772 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 773 |           ctx.stroke();
 774 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 775 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 776 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 777 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 778 |             ctx.beginPath();
 779 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 780 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 781 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 782 |             ctx.stroke();
 783 |           }
 784 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 785 |           // Hexagon pattern
 786 |           const r = size*0.22;
 787 |           ctx.beginPath();
 788 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 789 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 790 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 791 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 792 |           }
 793 |           ctx.closePath();
 794 |           ctx.stroke();
 795 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 796 |           // Sine wave pattern
 797 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 798 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 799 |             ctx.beginPath();
 800 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 801 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 802 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 803 |             }
 804 |             ctx.stroke();
 805 |           }
 806 |         }
 807 |         ctx.restore();
 808 |       };

 810 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);

 812 |       if (drawGloss) {

 815 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);

 817 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 818 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom

 828 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 829 |       return tex;

 832 | 
 833 |     /**
 834 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 835 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 836 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 837 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 838 |      */
 839 |     function shuffle(array) {
 840 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 841 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 842 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 843 |       }
 844 |       return array;
 845 |     }
 846 | 
 847 |     /**
 848 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 849 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 850 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 851 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 852 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 853 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 854 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 855 |      */
 856 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 857 |       ctx.beginPath();
 858 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 859 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 860 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 861 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 862 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 863 |       ctx.closePath();
 864 |     }
 865 | 
 866 |     /**
 867 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 868 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 869 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 870 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 871 |      */
 872 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 873 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 874 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 875 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 876 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 877 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 878 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 879 |     }

 909 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 910 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 911 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y

 913 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 914 |       ];
 915 |       dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
 916 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 917 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 918 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 919 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 920 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 921 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 922 |         mesh.add(m);
 923 |         planes.push(m);

 926 |     }

1254 |     // ===== MINI CUBE SYSTEM (729 PIECES) =====
1255 |     /**
1256 |      * Create the inner 729 mini-cubes that emerge from within the large cubes
1257 |      * Each large cube contains a 3x3x3 grid of mini-cubes (27 total per large cube)
1258 |      * Mini-cubes are initially hidden and grow during Phase 4 transformation
1259 |      */
1260 | 
1261 |     const MINI_SIZE = 0.28; // Size of mini-cubes (smaller than large)
1262 |     const MINI_GAP = 0.06; // Gap between mini-cubes
1263 |     const MINI_STEP = MINI_SIZE + MINI_GAP; // Total spacing for mini-cubes
1264 |     const miniGroup = new THREE.Group(); // Group for collective mini-cube operations
1265 |     root.add(miniGroup);
1266 |     miniGroup.visible = false; // Hidden until Phase 4 reveals them
1267 |     const miniCubes = []; // Array to store all 729 mini-cube meshes
1268 | 
1269 |     // Generate mini-cubes within each large cube
1270 |     for (let ownerIndex = 0; ownerIndex < largePieces.length; ownerIndex++) {
1271 |       const lp = largePieces[ownerIndex];
1272 |       const base = lp.position.clone(); // Position relative to owning large cube
1273 | 
1274 |       // Create 3x3x3 grid within each large cube
1275 |       for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
1276 |         for (let j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
1277 |           for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) {
1278 |             const m = makeCube(MINI_SIZE, 0x1f2937, 0xffffff);
1279 |             m.position.set(base.x + i * MINI_STEP, base.y + j * MINI_STEP, base.z + k * MINI_STEP);
1280 | 
1281 |             // Store relationship data for animation logic
1282 |             m.userData.ownerIndex = ownerIndex; // Which large cube owns this mini
1283 |             m.userData.local = new THREE.Vector3(i, j, k); // Local position within 3x3x3 grid
1284 |             m.userData.isCenter = (i === 0 && j === 0 && k === 0); // Center mini-cube flag
1285 |             m.userData.base = new THREE.Vector3(i, j, k); // Base position for animations
1286 |             m.userData.initialScale = 0.0001; // Start tiny for growth animation
1287 |             m.scale.setScalar(m.userData.initialScale);
1288 | 
1289 |             miniGroup.add(m);
1290 |             miniCubes.push(m);
1291 |           }
1292 |         }
1293 |       }
1294 |     }

1481 |      * 6: 43.0-52.0% - Mini-cubes recolor cyan to purple one-by-one

1483 |      * 8: 62.0-70.0% - Transform into final spherical sculpture

1568 |     // Final sculpture targets (layered spherical distribution with oriented/elongated minis)

1572 |     (function buildSculpture(){
1573 |       const layers=9, latSteps=9, lonSteps=9;
1574 |       const baseR = frameSize * (0.92 / 2.2); // match reference ratio, scaled to Phase 1 frame
1575 |       let k=0;
1576 |       for(let l=0; l<layers; l++){
1577 |         const r = 0.55 + (l/(layers-1))*0.40;
1578 |         for(let a=0; a<latSteps; a++){
1579 |           const phi = Math.PI * (a+0.5)/latSteps;
1580 |           for(let b=0; b<lonSteps; b++){
1581 |             const theta = 2*Math.PI*(b/lonSteps);
1582 |             const nx = Math.sin(phi)*Math.cos(theta);
1583 |             const ny = Math.cos(phi);
1584 |             const nz = Math.sin(phi)*Math.sin(theta);
1585 |             const rad = baseR*r;
1586 |             const px=nx*rad, py=ny*rad, pz=nz*rad;
1587 |             const q=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1), new THREE.Vector3(nx,ny,nz));
1588 |             const elong = 1.0 + 0.85*((a%3===0?0.9:0.4)+0.15*Math.sin((a+b+l)*0.7));
1589 |             const s=new THREE.Vector3(1,1,elong);
1590 |             sculpturePos[k]=new THREE.Vector3(px,py,pz);
1591 |             sculptureQuat[k]=q;
1592 |             sculptureScale[k]=s;
1593 |             k++;
1594 |           }
1595 |         }
1596 |       }
1597 |     })();

1599 |     // ===== Text-Phase Sync (pin text while animation runs given phases) =====
1600 |     function setupPhaseTextSync(){
1601 |       const sections = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.hero-row .text-section'));
1602 |       if (sections.length < 8) return; // expect 8 sections
1603 |       // Use a fixed scroll budget (the spacer) to avoid feedback loops that desync phases
1604 |       const spacer = document.querySelector('.spacer');
1605 |       const baseBudget = spacer ? parseFloat(getComputedStyle(spacer).height) || 20000 : 20000;
1606 |       // Mapping of section index (0-based) to one or more animation phases to pin through
1607 |       const mapping = new Map([
1608 |         [3, [2,3]],   // The Anatomy of an Organization: P2 + P3
1609 |         [4, [4]],     // The Hidden Relations: P4
1610 |         [5, [5,6]],   // The Moment of Truth: P5 + P6
1611 |         [6, [7]],     // Locks, Locks Everywhere: P7
1612 |         [7, [8,9]],   // The Future, Ready Today: P8 + P9
1613 |       ]);
1614 |       let totalPads = 0;
1615 |       sections.forEach((sec, idx) => {
1616 |         let pad = sec.querySelector('.phase-pad');
1617 |         if (!pad) { pad = document.createElement('div'); pad.className = 'phase-pad'; sec.appendChild(pad); }
1618 |         let targetPx = 0;
1619 |         const phaseIds = mapping.get(idx);
1620 |         if (phaseIds){
1621 |           const ids = Array.isArray(phaseIds) ? phaseIds : [phaseIds];
1622 |           for (const id of ids) {
1623 |             const p = PHASES.find(pp => pp.id === id);
1624 |             if (p) targetPx += Math.max(0, Math.floor((p.end - p.start) * baseBudget));
1625 |           }
1626 |         }
1627 |         const needed = Math.max(0, targetPx);
1628 |         pad.style.height = needed + 'px';
1629 |         totalPads += needed;
1630 |       });
1631 |       // Offset pads by shrinking the spacer so total scroll stays aligned with the animation’s timeline
1632 |       if (spacer) {
1633 |         const minTail = 600; // keep extra tail so last sticky stays pinned through P9
1634 |         const newHeight = Math.max(minTail, baseBudget - totalPads + minTail);
1635 |         spacer.style.height = newHeight + 'px';
1636 |       }
1637 |     }

2607 |     // ===== Resize =====
2608 |     function fitCameraToPhase1Bounds() {
2609 |       const scale = 1.5;
2610 |       const halfExtent = (STEP + LARGE_SIZE * 0.5) * scale;
2611 |       const fov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov * 0.5);
2612 |       const rect = containerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
2613 |       const aspect = Math.max(0.0001, rect.width / Math.max(1, rect.height));
2614 |       const dVert = halfExtent / Math.tan(fov);
2615 |       const dHoriz = (halfExtent / aspect) / Math.tan(fov);
2616 |       let need = Math.max(dVert, dHoriz) * 1.8; // stronger margin to ensure full fit
2617 |       const current = camera.position.length();
2618 |       if (need < current) need = current; // never move closer than current distance
2619 |       const dir = camera.position.clone().normalize();
2620 |       camera.position.copy(dir.multiplyScalar(need));
2621 |       camera.lookAt(0, CAMERA_TARGET_Y, 0);
2622 |     }

  5 | 
  6 | interface RubiksIframeProps {
  7 |   height?: string;
  8 |   progress?: number | null; // 0..1 to externally drive the animation; null to let iframe use its own scroll
  9 |   onReady?: () => void;
 10 |   onProgress?: (value: number) => void;
 11 |   onPhaseChange?: (id: number, label: string) => void;
 12 | }
 13 | 
 14 | const RubiksIframe = forwardRef<HTMLIFrameElement, RubiksIframeProps>(
 15 |   ({ height = '100vh', progress = null, onReady, onProgress, onPhaseChange }, ref) => {
 16 |     const iframeRef = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement | null>(null);
 17 |     const resourcesInjectedRef = useRef(false);
 18 |     const initialLanguageRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
 19 |     useImperativeHandle(ref, () => iframeRef.current as HTMLIFrameElement, []);
 20 |     const { i18n } = useTranslation();
 21 | 
 22 |   const targetOrigin = useMemo(() => '*', []);
 23 | 
 24 |   // Inject i18n resources into iframe when it loads
 25 |   useEffect(() => {
 26 |     const iframe = iframeRef.current;
 27 |     if (!iframe) return;
 28 | 
 29 |     const handleLoad = () => {
 30 |       const win = iframe.contentWindow;
 31 |       if (!win) return;
 32 | 
 33 |       console.log('[RubiksIframe] Iframe loaded, injecting i18n resources');
 34 |       // Inject i18n resources
 35 |       (win as any).i18nResources = {
 36 |         en: enTranslations,
 37 |         ar: arTranslations
 38 |       };
 39 |       resourcesInjectedRef.current = true;
 40 |       initialLanguageRef.current = i18n.language;
 41 |       console.log('[RubiksIframe] i18n resources injected. Triggering initial render with language:', i18n.language);
 42 | 
 43 |       // Trigger initial render with current language
 44 |       win.postMessage({ type: 'RENDER_OVERLAYS', lang: i18n.language }, targetOrigin);
 45 |     };
 46 | 
 47 |     iframe.addEventListener('load', handleLoad);
 48 |     return () => {
 49 |       iframe.removeEventListener('load', handleLoad);
 50 |       resourcesInjectedRef.current = false;
 51 |       initialLanguageRef.current = null;
 52 |     };
 53 |   }, [targetOrigin, i18n.language]);
 54 | 
 55 |   // Listen to messages from the iframe
 56 |   useEffect(() => {
 57 |     function handleMessage(e: MessageEvent) {
 58 |       const data = e && (e.data as any);
 59 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 60 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_READY') {
 61 |         console.log('[RubiksIframe] Received RUBIKS_READY from iframe');
 62 |         onReady && onReady();
 63 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_PROGRESS') {
 64 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 65 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) onProgress && onProgress(v);
 66 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_PHASE') {
 67 |         const id = Number(data.id);
 68 |         const label = String(data.label ?? '');
 69 |         if (!Number.isNaN(id)) onPhaseChange && onPhaseChange(id, label);
 70 |       }
 71 |     }

 73 |     return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handleMessage);
 74 |   }, [onReady, onProgress, onPhaseChange]);

 314 |                 <p>${data.p}</p>
 315 |               </div>

 317 |           }

 320 |         overlayInner.innerHTML.length);

 399 |     <div class="hero-row">
 400 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 401 |         <h1>Transforming Strategy Execution</h1>
 402 |         <h2>COMPLEXITY AS AN ASSET</h2>
 403 |         <p>Most transformations fail because complexity overwhelms. We turned that complexity into an advantage—redefining planning, risks, and dashboards inside one integrated model.</p>
 404 |       </div></section>
 405 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 406 |         <h1>Imagine a Parallel Universe</h1>
 407 |         <h2>WHERE TRANSFORMATIONS<br>
 408 | FLOW</h2>
 409 |         <p>Let us show you a week in that universe — A Week in the Life of a Transformation Team &lt;video link&gt;. Farfetched? It’s here. We built the MVP: a Net.js web app with a Supabase database and a Gemini Assistant, built on a five-year scenario dataset inspired by real transformation events.</p>
 410 |       </div></section>
 411 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 412 |         <h1>So How Did We Do It?</h1>
 413 |         <h2>THE RIGHT QUESTIONS FIRST</h2>
 414 |         <p>Before answers, you need the right questions. This journey begins by uncovering the questions that matter most—the ones that unlock how complexity really works.</p>
 415 |       </div></section>
 416 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 417 |         <h1>The Anatomy of an Organization</h1>
 418 |         <h2>WHAT MAKES AN ORGANIZATION?</h2>
 419 |         <p>Many things, like a living system of systems—Strategy, Policies, Processes, Digital  shaped by external forces such as markets and global events. Real transformation means understanding how these components interact, not treating them in isolation.</p>
 420 |       </div></section>
 421 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 422 |         <h1>The Hidden Relations</h1>
 423 |         <h2>HOW DEEP DOES IT GO?</h2>
 424 |         <p>Each component has its own inputs, outputs, and hidden ties to others. When those ties are mapped, patterns emerge—a structure that shows why small changes ripple across the whole system.</p>
 425 |       </div></section>
 426 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 427 |         <h1>The Moment of Truth</h1>
 428 |         <h2>SHOULD YOU WALK THIS JOURNEY?</h2>
 429 |         <p>We already did—and the answer is yes. But do it with eyes open. Complexity runs deeper than expected, and guidance is scarce. That’s why we built a model that captures the whole picture and makes the path navigable.</p>
 430 |       </div></section>
 431 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 432 |         <h1>Locks, Locks Everywhere</h1>
 433 |         <h2>WHAT DID 2 YEARS REVEAL?</h2>
 434 |         <p>Unlock after unlock, the journey was long and often tedious. Every piece had to be dissected, connected, and validated until a full digital twin of dependencies emerged. Just as we reached this milestone, AI leapt forward—suddenly powerful, affordable, and accessible—turning what seemed impossible into reality.</p>
 435 |       </div></section>
 436 |       <section class="text-section"><div class="text-col">
 437 |         <h1>The Future, Ready Today</h1>
 438 |         <h2>WHAT PATH WILL YOU CHOOSE?</h2>
 439 |         <p>With the AI core in place, the Digital Twin comes alive. We’ve hit a milestone, but the journey is still unfolding. Two paths now await: a Knowledge Path, where you contribute ideas and shape the future of transformations; and a Builder Path, where you begin your own strategy execution journey and put the twin to work.</p>
 440 |       </div></section>

 453 |   <script type="module">
 454 |     /**
 455 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 456 |      *
 457 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 458 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 459 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 460 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 461 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 462 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 463 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 464 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 465 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 466 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 467 |      *
 468 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 469 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 470 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 471 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 472 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 473 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 474 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 475 |      */

 511 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 512 |     /**
 513 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 514 |      */
 515 | 
 516 |     /**
 517 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 518 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 519 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 520 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 521 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 522 |      */
 523 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 524 | 
 525 |     /**
 526 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 527 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 528 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 529 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 530 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 531 |      */
 532 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 533 | 
 534 |     /**
 535 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 536 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 537 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 538 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 539 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 540 |      */
 541 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 542 | 
 543 |     /**
 544 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 545 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 546 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 547 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 548 |      */
 549 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 550 | 
 551 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 552 |     /**
 553 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 554 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 555 |      */
 556 | 
 557 |     /**
 558 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 559 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 560 |      */
 561 |     let externalProgress = null;
 562 | 
 563 |     /**
 564 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 565 |      * Supports two message types:
 566 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 567 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 568 |      */
 569 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 570 |       const data = e && e.data;
 571 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 572 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 573 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 574 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 575 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 576 |         externalProgress = null;
 577 |       }
 578 |     });
 579 | 
 580 |     /**
 581 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 582 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 583 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 584 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 585 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 586 |      */
 587 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }

 589 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 590 |     /**
 591 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 592 |      */
 593 | 
 594 |     /**
 595 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 596 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 597 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 598 |      */
 599 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 600 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 601 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 602 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 603 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 604 |     }
 605 | 
 606 |     /**
 607 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 608 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 609 |      */
 610 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 611 | 
 612 |     /**
 613 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 614 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 615 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 616 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 617 |      */
 618 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 619 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 620 |       const res = [];
 621 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 622 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 623 |       }
 624 |       return res;
 625 |     }
 626 | 
 627 |     /**
 628 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 629 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 630 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 631 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 632 |      */
 633 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 634 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 635 |       for (const c of corners) {
 636 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 637 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 638 |       }
 639 |       return true;
 640 |     }
 641 | 
 642 |     /**
 643 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 644 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 645 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 646 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 647 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 648 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 649 |      */
 650 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 651 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 652 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 653 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 654 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 655 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 656 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 657 |       }
 658 |       return lo;
 659 |     }

 661 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 662 |     /**
 663 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 664 |      *
 665 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 666 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 667 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 668 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 669 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 670 |      *
 671 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 672 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 673 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 674 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 675 |      *
 676 |      * CACHING:
 677 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 678 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 679 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 680 |      */
 681 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 682 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 683 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 684 | 
 685 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 686 | 
 687 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 688 |       .then(response => response.json())
 689 |       .then(data => {
 690 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 691 |       })
 692 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 693 | 
 694 |     /**
 695 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 696 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 697 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 698 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 699 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 700 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 701 |      */
 702 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 703 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 704 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 705 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 706 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 707 | 
 708 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 709 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 710 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 711 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 712 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 713 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 714 | 
 715 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 716 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 717 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 718 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 719 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 720 |       ctx.fill();
 721 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 722 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 723 |       /**
 724 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 725 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 726 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 727 |        */
 728 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 729 |         ctx.save();
 730 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 731 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 732 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 733 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 734 | 
 735 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 736 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 737 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 738 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 739 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 740 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 741 | 
 742 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 743 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 744 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 745 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 746 |           // Vertical lines
 747 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 748 |             ctx.beginPath();
 749 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 750 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 751 |             ctx.stroke();
 752 |           }
 753 |           // Horizontal lines
 754 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 755 |             ctx.beginPath();
 756 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 757 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 758 |             ctx.stroke();
 759 |           }
 760 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 761 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 762 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 763 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 764 |             ctx.beginPath();
 765 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 766 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 767 |             ctx.stroke();
 768 |           }
 769 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 770 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 771 |           ctx.beginPath();
 772 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 773 |           ctx.stroke();
 774 |           ctx.beginPath();
 775 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 776 |           ctx.stroke();
 777 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 778 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 779 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 780 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 781 |             ctx.beginPath();
 782 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 783 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 784 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 785 |             ctx.stroke();
 786 |           }
 787 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 788 |           // Hexagon pattern
 789 |           const r = size*0.22;
 790 |           ctx.beginPath();
 791 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 792 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 793 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 794 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 795 |           }
 796 |           ctx.closePath();
 797 |           ctx.stroke();
 798 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 799 |           // Sine wave pattern
 800 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 801 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 802 |             ctx.beginPath();
 803 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 804 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 805 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 806 |             }
 807 |             ctx.stroke();
 808 |           }
 809 |         }
 810 |         ctx.restore();
 811 |       };
 812 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 813 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 814 | 
 815 |       if (drawGloss) {
 816 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 817 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 818 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 819 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 820 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 821 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 822 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 823 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 824 |         ctx.fill();
 825 |       }
 826 | 
 827 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 828 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 829 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 830 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 831 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 832 |       return tex;
 833 |     }
 834 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 835 | 
 836 |     /**
 837 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 838 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 839 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 840 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 841 |      */
 842 |     function shuffle(array) {
 843 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 844 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 845 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 846 |       }
 847 |       return array;
 848 |     }
 849 | 
 850 |     /**
 851 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 852 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 853 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 854 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 855 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 856 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 857 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 858 |      */
 859 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 860 |       ctx.beginPath();
 861 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 862 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 863 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 864 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 865 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 866 |       ctx.closePath();
 867 |     }
 868 | 
 869 |     /**
 870 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 871 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 872 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 873 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 874 |      */
 875 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 876 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 877 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 878 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 879 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 880 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 881 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 882 |     }
 883 |     /**
 884 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss
 885 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 textures, one per pattern
 886 |      */
 887 |     function getLargeStickerTextures(){
 888 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs;
 889 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 890 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;
 891 |       return texs;
 892 |     }
 893 | 
 894 |     /**
 895 |      * Get cached textures for mini cubes with solid colors (no patterns, no gloss)
 896 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 solid color textures
 897 |      */
 898 |     function getMiniStickerTextures(){
 899 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs;
 900 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], false, false));
 901 |       STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs = texs;
 902 |       return texs;
 903 |     }
 904 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 905 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 906 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;
 907 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 908 |       const planes = [];
 909 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 910 |       const dirs = [
 911 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 912 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 913 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 914 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 915 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z
 916 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 917 |       ];
 918 |       dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
 919 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 920 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 921 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 922 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 923 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 924 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 925 |         mesh.add(m);
 926 |         planes.push(m);
 927 |       });
 928 |       return planes;
 929 |     }

 931 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 932 |     /**
 933 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 934 |      *
 935 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 936 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 937 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 938 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 939 |      *
 940 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 941 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 942 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 943 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 944 |      *
 945 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 946 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 947 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 948 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 949 |      *
 950 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 951 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 952 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)
 953 |      * @returns {THREE.Mesh} Configured cube mesh with edges
 954 |      */
 955 |     function makeCube(size, fillColor, edgeColor, cubeIndex = 0) {
 956 |       const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
 957 |       let mesh;
 958 | 
 959 |       if (size > 0.1) {
 960 |         if (size >= 0.99) {
 961 |           // ===== LARGE CUBE CREATION =====
 962 |           // 27 large cubes forming the initial Rubik's cube structure

1053 |     /**
1054 |      * Set fill color for all meshes in a 3D object hierarchy
1055 |      * Used for global color changes during different animation phases
1056 |      * @param {THREE.Object3D} obj3D - Root object to traverse
1057 |      * @param {number} color - Color value (hex number)
1058 |      */
1059 |     function setCubeFillColor(obj3D, color) {
1060 |       obj3D.traverse(o => {
1061 |         if (o.isMesh && o.material) {
1062 |           if (Array.isArray(o.material)) {
1063 |             // Handle multi-material meshes (cubes with different face materials)
1064 |             o.material.forEach(m => { if (m && m.color) m.color.set(color); });
1065 |           } else {
1066 |             // Handle single-material meshes
1067 |             if (o.material.color) o.material.color.set(color);
1068 |           }
1069 |         }
1070 |       });
1071 |     }

1289 |             m.userData.initialScale = 0.0001; // Start tiny for growth animation

1292 |             miniGroup.add(m);

1609 |       // Mapping of section index (0-based) to one or more animation phases to pin through
1610 |       const mapping = new Map([
1611 |         [3, [2,3]],   // The Anatomy of an Organization: P2 + P3
1612 |         [4, [4]],     // The Hidden Relations: P4
1613 |         [5, [5,6]],   // The Moment of Truth: P5 + P6
1614 |         [6, [7]],     // Locks, Locks Everywhere: P7
1615 |         [7, [8,9]],   // The Future, Ready Today: P8 + P9
1616 |       ]);

1618 |       sections.forEach((sec, idx) => {
1619 |         let pad = sec.querySelector('.phase-pad');
1620 |         if (!pad) { pad = document.createElement('div'); pad.className = 'phase-pad'; sec.appendChild(pad); }
1621 |         let targetPx = 0;
1622 |         const phaseIds = mapping.get(idx);
1623 |         if (phaseIds){

1625 |           for (const id of ids) {

1635 |       if (spacer) {

  1 | import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, forwardRef, useImperativeHandle } from 'react';
  2 | import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
  3 | import enTranslations from '../locales/en.json';
  4 | import arTranslations from '../locales/ar.json';
  5 | 
  6 | interface RubiksIframeProps {
  7 |   height?: string;
  8 |   progress?: number | null; // 0..1 to externally drive the animation; null to let iframe use its own scroll
  9 |   onReady?: () => void;
 10 |   onProgress?: (value: number) => void;
 11 |   onPhaseChange?: (id: number, label: string) => void;
 12 | }
 13 | 
 14 | const RubiksIframe = forwardRef<HTMLIFrameElement, RubiksIframeProps>(
 15 |   ({ height = '100vh', progress = null, onReady, onProgress, onPhaseChange }, ref) => {
 16 |     const iframeRef = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement | null>(null);
 17 |     const resourcesInjectedRef = useRef(false);
 18 |     const initialLanguageRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
 19 |     useImperativeHandle(ref, () => iframeRef.current as HTMLIFrameElement, []);
 20 |     const { i18n } = useTranslation();
 21 | 
 22 |   const targetOrigin = useMemo(() => '*', []);
 23 | 
 24 |   // Inject i18n resources into iframe when it loads
 25 |   useEffect(() => {
 26 |     const iframe = iframeRef.current;
 27 |     if (!iframe) return;
 28 | 
 29 |     const handleLoad = () => {
 30 |       const win = iframe.contentWindow;
 31 |       if (!win) return;
 32 | 
 33 |       console.log('[RubiksIframe] Iframe loaded, injecting i18n resources');
 34 |       // Inject i18n resources
 35 |       (win as any).i18nResources = {
 36 |         en: enTranslations,
 37 |         ar: arTranslations
 38 |       };
 39 |       resourcesInjectedRef.current = true;
 40 |       initialLanguageRef.current = i18n.language;
 41 |       console.log('[RubiksIframe] i18n resources injected. Triggering initial render with language:', i18n.language);
 42 | 
 43 |       // Trigger initial render with current language
 44 |       win.postMessage({ type: 'RENDER_OVERLAYS', lang: i18n.language }, targetOrigin);
 45 |     };
 46 | 
 47 |     iframe.addEventListener('load', handleLoad);
 48 |     return () => {
 49 |       iframe.removeEventListener('load', handleLoad);
 50 |       resourcesInjectedRef.current = false;
 51 |       initialLanguageRef.current = null;
 52 |     };
 53 |   }, [targetOrigin, i18n.language]);
 54 | 
 55 |   // Listen to messages from the iframe
 56 |   useEffect(() => {
 57 |     function handleMessage(e: MessageEvent) {
 58 |       const data = e && (e.data as any);
 59 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 60 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_READY') {
 61 |         console.log('[RubiksIframe] Received RUBIKS_READY from iframe');
 62 |         onReady && onReady();
 63 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_PROGRESS') {
 64 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 65 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) onProgress && onProgress(v);
 66 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_PHASE') {
 67 |         const id = Number(data.id);
 68 |         const label = String(data.label ?? '');
 69 |         if (!Number.isNaN(id)) onPhaseChange && onPhaseChange(id, label);
 70 |       }
 71 |     }
 72 |     window.addEventListener('message', handleMessage);
 73 |     return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handleMessage);
 74 |   }, [onReady, onProgress, onPhaseChange]);
 75 | 
 76 |   // Send language change to iframe when language changes (but not on initial render)
 77 |   useEffect(() => {
 78 |     // Skip if this is the initial language or resources not injected yet
 79 |     if (!resourcesInjectedRef.current || initialLanguageRef.current === i18n.language) {
 80 |       return;
 81 |     }
 82 | 
 83 |     const win = iframeRef.current?.contentWindow;
 84 |     if (!win) return;
 85 |     
 86 |     console.log('[RubiksIframe] Language changed from', initialLanguageRef.current, 'to', i18n.language);
 87 |     initialLanguageRef.current = i18n.language;
 88 |     win.postMessage({ type: 'RENDER_OVERLAYS', lang: i18n.language }, targetOrigin);
 89 |   }, [i18n.language, targetOrigin]);
 90 | 
 91 |   // Push progress to the iframe when provided
 92 |   useEffect(() => {
 93 |     const win = iframeRef.current?.contentWindow;
 94 |     if (!win) return;
 95 |     if (progress === null || typeof progress === 'undefined') {
 96 |       win.postMessage({ type: 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL' }, targetOrigin);
 97 |     } else {
 98 |       const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(progress)));
 99 |       if (!Number.isNaN(v)) {
100 |         win.postMessage({ type: 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS', value: v }, targetOrigin);
101 |       }
102 |     }
103 |   }, [progress, targetOrigin]);
104 | 
105 |     return (
106 |       <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height }}>
107 |         <iframe
108 |           ref={iframeRef}
109 |           src="/rubiks-cdn.html"
110 |           title="Rubiks Animation"
111 |           style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', border: 'none' }}
112 |           allow="autoplay; fullscreen; xr-spatial-tracking; clipboard-write"
113 |           sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-pointer-lock allow-top-navigation"
114 |         />
115 |       </div>
116 |     );
117 |   }
118 | );
119 | 
120 | export default RubiksIframe;

<instructions>Simplify RubiksIframe to switch between two hardcoded HTML files based on language instead of complex i18n injection</instructions>
<code_edit>import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, forwardRef, useImperativeHandle } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

interface RubiksIframeProps {
  height?: string;
  progress?: number | null; // 0..1 to externally drive the animation; null to let iframe use its own scroll
  onReady?: () => void;
  onProgress?: (value: number) => void;
  onPhaseChange?: (id: number, label: string) => void;
}

const RubiksIframe = forwardRef<HTMLIFrameElement, RubiksIframeProps>(
  ({ height = '100vh', progress = null, onReady, onProgress, onPhaseChange }, ref) => {
    const iframeRef = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement | null>(null);
    useImperativeHandle(ref, () => iframeRef.current as HTMLIFrameElement, []);
    const { i18n } = useTranslation();

    // Choose iframe src based on current language
    const iframeSrc = useMemo(() => {
      const isArabic = i18n.language && i18n.language.startsWith('ar');
      return isArabic ? '/rubiks-cdn-ar.html' : '/rubiks-cdn.html';
    }, [i18n.language]);

  const targetOrigin = useMemo(() => '*', []);

  // Listen to messages from the iframe
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleMessage(e: MessageEvent) {
      const data = e && (e.data as any);
      if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
      if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_READY') {
        console.log('[RubiksIframe] Received RUBIKS_READY from iframe');
        onReady && onReady();
      } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_PROGRESS') {
        const v = Number(data.value);
        if (!Number.isNaN(v)) onProgress && onProgress(v);
      } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_PHASE') {
        const id = Number(data.id);
        const label = String(data.label ?? '');
        if (!Number.isNaN(id)) onPhaseChange && onPhaseChange(id, label);
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('message', handleMessage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handleMessage);
  }, [onReady, onProgress, onPhaseChange]);

  // Push progress to the iframe when provided
  useEffect(() => {
    const win = iframeRef.current?.contentWindow;
    if (!win) return;
    if (progress === null || typeof progress === 'undefined') {
      win.postMessage({ type: 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL' }, targetOrigin);
    } else {
      const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(progress)));
      if (!Number.isNaN(v)) {
        win.postMessage({ type: 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS', value: v }, targetOrigin);
      }
    }
  }, [progress, targetOrigin]);

    return (
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height }}>
        <iframe
          ref={iframeRef}
          src={iframeSrc}
          title="Rubiks Animation"
          style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', border: 'none' }}
          allow="autoplay; fullscreen; xr-spatial-tracking; clipboard-write"
          sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-pointer-lock allow-top-navigation"
        />
      </div>
    );
  }
);

export default RubiksIframe;</code_edit>
</edit_file>

 453 |   <script type="module">
 454 |     /**
 455 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 456 |      *
 457 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 458 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 459 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 460 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 461 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 462 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 463 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 464 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 465 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 466 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 467 |      *
 468 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 469 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 470 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 471 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 472 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 473 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 474 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 475 |      */
 476 | 
 477 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 478 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 479 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 480 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 481 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 482 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 483 | 
 484 |     // Background video speed control
 485 |     const bgVideo = document.querySelector('.bg-video');
 486 |     const VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE = 0.4;
 487 |     function applyVideoSpeed() { 
 488 |       try { if (bgVideo) bgVideo.playbackRate = VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE; } catch(_){}
 489 |     }
 490 |     if (bgVideo) { bgVideo.addEventListener('loadeddata', applyVideoSpeed); bgVideo.addEventListener('play', applyVideoSpeed); }
 491 |     applyVideoSpeed();
 492 | 
 493 |     // ===== ENHANCED NAVIGATION FOR FINALE BUTTONS =====
 494 |     function handleNavigation(e) {
 495 |       e.preventDefault();
 496 |       const navPath = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('href');
 497 |       if (navPath && window.top) {
 498 |         window.top.location.hash = navPath;

 501 | 
 502 |     function initializeNavigation() {
 503 |       const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.finale-enter-btn');
 504 |       btns.forEach(btn => {

 506 |       });
