 509 |     setTimeout(initializeNavigation, 200); // Increased timeout for safety
 510 | 
 511 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 512 |     /**
 513 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 514 |      */
 515 | 
 516 |     /**
 517 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 518 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 519 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 520 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 521 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 522 |      */
 523 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 524 | 
 525 |     /**
 526 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 527 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 528 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 529 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 530 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 531 |      */
 532 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 533 | 
 534 |     /**
 535 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 536 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 537 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 538 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 539 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 540 |      */
 541 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 542 | 
 543 |     /**
 544 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 545 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 546 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 547 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 548 |      */
 549 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 550 | 
 551 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 552 |     /**
 553 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 554 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 555 |      */
 556 | 
 557 |     /**
 558 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 559 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 560 |      */
 561 |     let externalProgress = null;
 562 | 
 563 |     /**
 564 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 565 |      * Supports two message types:
 566 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 567 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 568 |      */
 569 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 570 |       const data = e && e.data;
 571 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 572 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 573 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 574 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 575 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 576 |         externalProgress = null;
 577 |       }
 578 |     });
 579 | 
 580 |     /**
 581 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 582 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 583 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 584 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 585 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 586 |      */
 587 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 588 | 
 589 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 590 |     /**
 591 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 592 |      */
 593 | 
 594 |     /**
 595 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 596 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 597 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 598 |      */
 599 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 600 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 601 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 602 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 603 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 604 |     }
 605 | 
 606 |     /**
 607 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 608 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 609 |      */
 610 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 611 | 
 612 |     /**
 613 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 614 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 615 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 616 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 617 |      */
 618 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 619 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 620 |       const res = [];
 621 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 622 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 623 |       }
 624 |       return res;
 625 |     }
 626 | 
 627 |     /**
 628 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 629 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 630 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 631 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 632 |      */
 633 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 634 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 635 |       for (const c of corners) {
 636 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 637 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 638 |       }
 639 |       return true;
 640 |     }
 641 | 
 642 |     /**
 643 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 644 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 645 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 646 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 647 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 648 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 649 |      */
 650 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 651 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 652 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 653 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 654 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 655 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 656 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 657 |       }
 658 |       return lo;
 659 |     }
 660 | 
 661 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 662 |     /**
 663 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 664 |      *
 665 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 666 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 667 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 668 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 669 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 670 |      *
 671 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 672 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 673 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 674 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 675 |      *
 676 |      * CACHING:
 677 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 678 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 679 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 680 |      */
 681 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 682 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 683 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 684 | 
 685 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 686 | 
 687 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 688 |       .then(response => response.json())
 689 |       .then(data => {
 690 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 691 |       })
 692 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 693 | 
 694 |     /**
 695 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 696 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 697 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 698 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 699 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 700 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 701 |      */
 702 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 703 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 704 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 705 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 706 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 707 | 
 708 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 709 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 710 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 711 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 712 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 713 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 714 | 
 715 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 716 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 717 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 718 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 719 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 720 |       ctx.fill();
 721 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 722 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 723 |       /**
 724 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 725 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 726 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 727 |        */
 728 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 729 |         ctx.save();
 730 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 731 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 732 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 733 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 734 | 
 735 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 736 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 737 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 738 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 739 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 740 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 741 | 
 742 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 743 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 744 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 745 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 746 |           // Vertical lines
 747 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 748 |             ctx.beginPath();
 749 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 750 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 751 |             ctx.stroke();
 752 |           }
 753 |           // Horizontal lines
 754 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 755 |             ctx.beginPath();
 756 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 757 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 758 |             ctx.stroke();
 759 |           }
 760 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 761 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 762 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 763 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 764 |             ctx.beginPath();
 765 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 766 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 767 |             ctx.stroke();
 768 |           }
 769 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 770 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 771 |           ctx.beginPath();
 772 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 773 |           ctx.stroke();
 774 |           ctx.beginPath();
 775 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 776 |           ctx.stroke();
 777 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 778 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 779 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 780 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 781 |             ctx.beginPath();
 782 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 783 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 784 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 785 |             ctx.stroke();
 786 |           }
 787 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 788 |           // Hexagon pattern
 789 |           const r = size*0.22;
 790 |           ctx.beginPath();
 791 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 792 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 793 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 794 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 795 |           }
 796 |           ctx.closePath();
 797 |           ctx.stroke();
 798 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 799 |           // Sine wave pattern
 800 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 801 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 802 |             ctx.beginPath();
 803 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 804 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 805 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 806 |             }
 807 |             ctx.stroke();
 808 |           }
 809 |         }
 810 |         ctx.restore();
 811 |       };
 812 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 813 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 814 | 
 815 |       if (drawGloss) {
 816 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 817 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 818 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 819 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 820 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 821 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 822 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 823 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 824 |         ctx.fill();
 825 |       }
 826 | 
 827 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 828 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 829 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 830 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 831 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 832 |       return tex;
 833 |     }
 834 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 835 | 
 836 |     /**
 837 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 838 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 839 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 840 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 841 |      */
 842 |     function shuffle(array) {
 843 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 844 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 845 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 846 |       }
 847 |       return array;
 848 |     }
 849 | 
 850 |     /**
 851 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 852 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 853 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 854 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 855 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 856 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 857 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 858 |      */
 859 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 860 |       ctx.beginPath();
 861 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 862 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 863 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 864 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 865 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 866 |       ctx.closePath();
 867 |     }
 868 | 
 869 |     /**
 870 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 871 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 872 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 873 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 874 |      */
 875 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 876 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 877 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 878 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 879 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 880 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 881 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 882 |     }
 883 |     /**
 884 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss
 885 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 textures, one per pattern

 888 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs;
 889 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 890 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;
 891 |       return texs;
 892 |     }

 894 |     /**
 895 |      * Get cached textures for mini cubes with solid colors (no patterns, no gloss)

 897 |      */
 898 |     function getMiniStickerTextures(){
 899 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs;
 900 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], false, false));
 901 |       STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs = texs;

 904 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 905 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 906 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;
 907 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 908 |       const planes = [];
 909 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 910 |       const dirs = [
 911 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 912 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 913 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 914 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 915 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z
 916 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 917 |       ];
 918 |       dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
 919 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 920 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 921 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 922 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 923 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 924 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 925 |         mesh.add(m);
 926 |         planes.push(m);
 927 |       });
 928 |       return planes;
 929 |     }

 931 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 932 |     /**
 933 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 934 |      *
 935 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 936 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 937 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 938 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 939 |      *
 940 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 941 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 942 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 943 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 944 |      *
 945 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 946 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 947 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 948 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 949 |      *
 950 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 951 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 952 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)

 954 |      */
 955 |     function makeCube(size, fillColor, edgeColor, cubeIndex = 0) {

 963 |           const pats = fixedFaceAssignments.length > 0 ? fixedFaceAssignments.slice() : shuffle(FACE_PATTERNS.slice()); // Randomize pattern order per cube
 964 |           // Load all 6 bump map textures

 966 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 967 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 968 |             tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 969 |             tex.repeat.set(1, 1);

 971 |           });
 972 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 973 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 974 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out

 976 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],
 977 |             bumpScale: 1.0, // Maximum bump effect

 989 |         } else {

 992 |          // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({

1003 |           // });
1004 |           // mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
1005 |

1007 |           const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
1008 |             color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC),
1009 |             transparent: false,
1010 |             opacity: 1.0,
1011 |             depthWrite: true,
1012 |             depthTest: true,
1013 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide,
1014 |             metalness: 0.25,
1015 |             roughness: 0.5,
1016 |             emissive: new THREE.Color(0x000000), // No glow
1017 |             emissiveIntensity: 0.0 // No glow

1019 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
1020 |         }
1021 |       } else {

1053 |     /**
1054 |      * Set fill color for all meshes in a 3D object hierarchy

1057 |      * @param {number} color - Color value (hex number)
1058 |      */
1059 |     function setCubeFillColor(obj3D, color) {
1060 |       obj3D.traverse(o => {
1061 |         if (o.isMesh && o.material) {
1062 |           if (Array.isArray(o.material)) {
1063 |             // Handle multi-material meshes (cubes with different face materials)
1064 |             o.material.forEach(m => { if (m && m.color) m.color.set(color); });
1065 |           } else {
1066 |             // Handle single-material meshes
1067 |             if (o.material.color) o.material.color.set(color);
1068 |           }
1069 |         }
1070 |       });
1071 |     }

1189 |     // ===== LARGE CUBE SYSTEM (27 PIECES) =====
1190 |     /**
1191 |      * Create the initial 3x3x3 Rubik's cube structure
1192 |      * These 27 large cubes form the foundation of the animation

1194 | 
1195 |     const LARGE_SIZE = 1.0; // Base size for large cubes
1196 |     const GAP = 0.08; // Gap between cubes for visual separation
1197 |     const STEP = LARGE_SIZE + GAP; // Total spacing including gap
1198 |     const largePieces = []; // Array to store all large cube meshes

1200 |     const largeGroup = new THREE.Group(); // Group for collective transformations
1201 |     root.add(largeGroup);

1203 |     // Generate 3x3x3 grid of large cubes
1204 |     let cubeIndex = 0;
1205 |     for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
1206 |       for (let y = -1; y <= 1; y++) {
1207 |         for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
1208 |           const cube = makeCube(LARGE_SIZE, 0x000096, 0xffffff, cubeIndex++);
1209 |           cube.position.set(x * STEP, y * STEP, z * STEP); // Position in grid

1481 |      * 3: 12.06-14.48% - Pieces settle with random rotations
1482 |      * 4: 14.48-31.38% - Large cubes shrink, mini-cubes emerge
1483 |      * 5: 31.38-43.0% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud
1484 |      * 6: 43.0-52.0% - Mini-cubes recolor cyan to purple one-by-one
1485 |      * 7: 52.0-62.0% - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
1486 |      * 8: 62.0-70.0% - Transform into final spherical sculpture
1487 |      * 9: 70.0-100% - Interactive final formation with mouse controls
1488 |      */

1575 |     (function buildSculpture(){

1581 |         for(let a=0; a<latSteps; a++){
1582 |           const phi = Math.PI * (a+0.5)/latSteps;
1583 |           for(let b=0; b<lonSteps; b++){
1584 |             const theta = 2*Math.PI*(b/lonSteps);
1585 |             const nx = Math.sin(phi)*Math.cos(theta);
1586 |             const ny = Math.cos(phi);
1587 |             const nz = Math.sin(phi)*Math.sin(theta);
1588 |             const rad = baseR*r;
1589 |             const px=nx*rad, py=ny*rad, pz=nz*rad;
1590 |             const q=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1), new THREE.Vector3(nx,ny,nz));

1594 |             sculptureQuat[k]=q;
1595 |             sculptureScale[k]=s;
1596 |             k++;
1597 |           }
1598 |         }
1599 |       }

1602 |     // ===== Text-Phase Sync (pin text while animation runs given phases) =====
1603 |     function setupPhaseTextSync(){
1604 |       const sections = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.hero-row .text-section'));
1605 |       if (sections.length < 8) return; // expect 8 sections
1606 |       // Use a fixed scroll budget (the spacer) to avoid feedback loops that desync phases
1607 |       const spacer = document.querySelector('.spacer');
1608 |       const baseBudget = spacer ? parseFloat(getComputedStyle(spacer).height) || 20000 : 20000;
1609 |       // Mapping of section index (0-based) to one or more animation phases to pin through
1610 |       const mapping = new Map([
1611 |         [3, [2,3]],   // تشريح المنظمة: P2 + P3
1612 |         [4, [4]],     // العلاقات الخفية: P4
1613 |         [5, [5,6]],   // لحظة الحقيقة: P5 + P6
1614 |         [6, [7]],     // أقفال في كل مكان: P7
1615 |         [7, [8,9]],   // المستقبل جاهز اليوم: P8 + P9
1616 |       ]);
1617 |       let totalPads = 0;
1618 |       sections.forEach((sec, idx) => {
1619 |         let pad = sec.querySelector('.phase-pad');
1620 |         if (!pad) { pad = document.createElement('div'); pad.className = 'phase-pad'; sec.appendChild(pad); }
1621 |         let targetPx = 0;
1622 |         const phaseIds = mapping.get(idx);
1623 |         if (phaseIds){
1624 |           const ids = Array.isArray(phaseIds) ? phaseIds : [phaseIds];
1625 |           for (const id of ids) {
1626 |             const p = PHASES.find(pp => pp.id === id);
1627 |             if (p) targetPx += Math.max(0, Math.floor((p.end - p.start) * baseBudget));
1628 |           }
1629 |         }
1630 |         const needed = Math.max(0, targetPx);
1631 |         pad.style.height = needed + 'px';
1632 |         totalPads += needed;
1633 |       });
1634 |       // Offset pads by shrinking the spacer so total scroll stays aligned with the animation’s timeline
1635 |       if (spacer) {
1636 |         const minTail = 600; // keep extra tail so last sticky stays pinned through P9
1637 |         const newHeight = Math.max(minTail, baseBudget - totalPads + minTail);
1638 |         spacer.style.height = newHeight + 'px';
1639 |       }
1640 |     }

    const data = overlays[key];
    if (!data) return;

            <div class="finale-right-column">

                <img src="/images/josoorlogo.png" alt="توين ستوديو Logo" class="finale-logo">

              </div>
              <h2>${data.twinstudio.h2}</h2>
              <p>${data.twinstudio.p}</p>

 226 |         <div class="phase-text-block" data-key="intro-1">
 227 |           <h1>Transforming Strategy Execution</h1>
 228 |           <h2>COMPLEXITY AS AN ASSET</h2>
 229 |           <p>Most transformations fail because complexity overwhelms. We turned that complexity into an advantage—redefining planning, risks, and dashboards inside one integrated model.</p>
 230 |         </div>
 231 |         <div class="phase-text-block" data-key="intro-2">
 232 |           <h1>Imagine a parallel universe</h1>
 233 |           <h2>WHERE TRANSFORMATIONS FLOW</h2>
 234 |           <p>Let us show you a week in that universe — A Week in the Life of a Transformation Team <b><a href="/assets/aweekin.mp4">video</a></b>. Farfetched? It’s here. We built the MVP: a Net.js web app with a Supabase database and a Gemini Assistant, built on a five-year scenario dataset inspired by real transformation events.</p>
 235 |         </div>
 236 |         <div class="phase-text-block" data-key="intro-3">
 237 |           <h1>So How Did We Do It?</h1>
 238 |           <h2>THE RIGHT QUESTIONS FIRST</h2>
 239 |           <p>Before answers, you need the right questions. This journey begins by uncovering the questions that matter most—the ones that unlock how complexity really works.</p>
 240 |         </div>
 241 |         <div class="phase-text-block" data-key="p23-your-org">
 242 |           <h1>The Anatomy of an Organization</h1>
 243 |           <h2>WHAT MAKES AN ORGANIZATION?</h2>
 244 |           <p>Many things, like a living system of systems—Strategy, Policies, Processes, Digital—shaped by external forces such as markets and global events. Real transformation means understanding how these components interact, not treating them in isolation.</p>
 245 |         </div>
 246 |         <div class="phase-text-block" data-key="p4-hidden">
 247 |           <h1>The Hidden Relations</h1>
 248 |           <h2>HOW DEEP DOES IT GO?</h2>
 249 |           <p>Each component has its own inputs, outputs, and hidden ties to others. When those ties are mapped, patterns emerge—a structure that shows why small changes ripple across the whole system.</p>
 250 |         </div>
 251 |         <div class="phase-text-block" data-key="p56-where">
 252 |           <h1>The Moment of Truth</h1>
 253 |           <h2>SHOULD YOU WALK THIS JOURNEY?</h2>
 254 |           <p>We already did—and the answer is yes. But do it with eyes open. Complexity runs deeper than expected, and guidance is scarce. That’s why we built a model that captures the whole picture and makes the path navigable.</p>
 255 |         </div>
 256 |         <div class="phase-text-block" data-key="p7-two-years">
 257 |           <h1>Locks, Locks Everywhere</h1>
 258 |           <h2>WHAT DID TWO YEARS REVEAL?</h2>
 259 |           <p>Two years of relentless work, unlocking barrier after barrier. Each layer exposed new dependencies, each cube revealed hidden ties. Piece by piece, the digital twin took shape—a living map of complexity. And just as it came together, AI leapt forward, suddenly powerful and accessible, turning years of struggle into a working reality.</p>
 260 |         </div>
 261 |         <div class="phase-text-block" data-key="p89-future">
 262 |           <h1>The Future, Ready Today</h1>
 263 |           <h2>WHICH PATH WILL YOU CHOOSE?</h2>
 264 |           <p>With the final piece in place—the very heart of the solution—the AI breathed life into the Digital Twin, reigniting hope for true transformation. The journey is not over for us or you, it continues through two distinct hubs... Scroll down to explore.</p>
 265 |           </div>

 360 |         <p>Many things, like a living system of systems—Strategy, Policies, Processes, Digital  shaped by external forces such as markets and global events. Real transformation means understanding how these components interact, not treating them in isolation.</p>
 361 |       </div></section>

 364 |         <h2>HOW DEEP DOES IT GO?</h2>

Just as we reached this milestone, AI leapt forward—suddenly powerful, affordable, and accessible—turning what seemed impossible into reality.</p>

 394 |   <script type="module">
 395 |     /**
 396 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 397 |      *
 398 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 399 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 400 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 401 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 402 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 403 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 404 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 405 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 406 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 407 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 408 |      *
 409 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 410 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 411 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 412 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 413 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 414 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 415 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 416 |      */
 417 | 
 418 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 419 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 420 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 421 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 422 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 423 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 424 |

 430 |     }

 432 |     applyVideoSpeed();

 452 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 453 |     /**
 454 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 455 |      */
 456 | 
 457 |     /**
 458 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 459 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 460 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 461 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 462 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 463 |      */
 464 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 465 | 
 466 |     /**
 467 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 468 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 469 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 470 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 471 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 472 |      */
 473 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 474 | 
 475 |     /**
 476 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 477 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 478 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 479 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 480 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 481 |      */
 482 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 483 | 
 484 |     /**
 485 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 486 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 487 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 488 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 489 |      */
 490 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 491 | 
 492 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 493 |     /**
 494 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 495 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 496 |      */
 497 | 
 498 |     /**
 499 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 500 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 501 |      */
 502 |     let externalProgress = null;
 503 | 
 504 |     /**
 505 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 506 |      * Supports two message types:
 507 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 508 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 509 |      */
 510 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 511 |       const data = e && e.data;
 512 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 513 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 514 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 515 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 516 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 517 |         externalProgress = null;
 518 |       }
 519 |     });
 520 | 
 521 |     /**
 522 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 523 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 524 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 525 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 526 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 527 |      */
 528 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 529 | 
 530 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 531 |     /**
 532 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 533 |      */
 534 | 
 535 |     /**
 536 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 537 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 538 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 539 |      */
 540 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 541 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 542 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 543 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 544 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 545 |     }
 546 | 
 547 |     /**
 548 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 549 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 550 |      */
 551 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 552 | 
 553 |     /**
 554 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 555 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 556 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 557 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 558 |      */
 559 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 560 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 561 |       const res = [];
 562 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 563 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 564 |       }
 565 |       return res;
 566 |     }
 567 | 
 568 |     /**
 569 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 570 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 571 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 572 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 573 |      */
 574 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 575 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 576 |       for (const c of corners) {
 577 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 578 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 579 |       }
 580 |       return true;
 581 |     }
 582 | 
 583 |     /**
 584 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 585 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 586 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 587 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 588 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 589 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 590 |      */
 591 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 592 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 593 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 594 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 595 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 596 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 597 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 598 |       }
 599 |       return lo;
 600 |     }
 601 | 
 602 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 603 |     /**
 604 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 605 |      *
 606 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 607 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 608 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 609 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 610 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 611 |      *
 612 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 613 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 614 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 615 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 616 |      *
 617 |      * CACHING:
 618 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 619 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 620 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 621 |      */
 622 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 623 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 624 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 625 | 
 626 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 627 | 
 628 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 629 |       .then(response => response.json())
 630 |       .then(data => {
 631 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 632 |       })
 633 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 634 | 
 635 |     /**
 636 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 637 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 638 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 639 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 640 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 641 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 642 |      */
 643 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 644 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 645 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 646 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 647 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 648 | 
 649 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 650 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 651 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 652 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 653 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 654 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 655 | 
 656 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 657 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 658 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 659 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 660 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 661 |       ctx.fill();
 662 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 663 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 664 |       /**
 665 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 666 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 667 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 668 |        */
 669 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 670 |         ctx.save();
 671 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 672 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 673 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 674 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 675 | 
 676 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 677 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 678 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 679 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 680 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 681 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 682 | 
 683 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 684 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 685 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 686 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 687 |           // Vertical lines
 688 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 689 |             ctx.beginPath();
 690 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 691 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 692 |             ctx.stroke();
 693 |           }
 694 |           // Horizontal lines
 695 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 696 |             ctx.beginPath();
 697 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 698 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 699 |             ctx.stroke();
 700 |           }
 701 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 702 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 703 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 704 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 705 |             ctx.beginPath();
 706 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 707 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 708 |             ctx.stroke();
 709 |           }
 710 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 711 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 712 |           ctx.beginPath();
 713 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 714 |           ctx.stroke();
 715 |           ctx.beginPath();
 716 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 717 |           ctx.stroke();
 718 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 719 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 720 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 721 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 722 |             ctx.beginPath();
 723 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 724 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 725 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 726 |             ctx.stroke();
 727 |           }
 728 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 729 |           // Hexagon pattern
 730 |           const r = size*0.22;
 731 |           ctx.beginPath();
 732 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 733 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 734 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 735 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 736 |           }
 737 |           ctx.closePath();
 738 |           ctx.stroke();
 739 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 740 |           // Sine wave pattern
 741 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 742 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 743 |             ctx.beginPath();
 744 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 745 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 746 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 747 |             }
 748 |             ctx.stroke();
 749 |           }
 750 |         }
 751 |         ctx.restore();
 752 |       };
 753 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 754 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 755 | 
 756 |       if (drawGloss) {
 757 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 758 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 759 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 760 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 761 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 762 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 763 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 764 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 765 |         ctx.fill();
 766 |       }
 767 | 
 768 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 769 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 770 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 771 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 772 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 773 |       return tex;
 774 |     }
 775 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 776 | 
 777 |     /**
 778 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 779 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 780 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 781 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 782 |      */
 783 |     function shuffle(array) {
 784 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 785 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 786 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 787 |       }
 788 |       return array;
 789 |     }
 790 | 
 791 |     /**
 792 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 793 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 794 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 795 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 796 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 797 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 798 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 799 |      */
 800 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 801 |       ctx.beginPath();
 802 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 803 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 804 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 805 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 806 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 807 |       ctx.closePath();
 808 |     }
 809 | 
 810 |     /**
 811 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 812 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 813 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 814 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 815 |      */
 816 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 817 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 818 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 819 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 820 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 821 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 822 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 823 |     }
 824 |     /**
 825 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss
 826 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 textures, one per pattern
 827 |      */
 828 |     function getLargeStickerTextures(){
 829 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs;
 830 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 831 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;
 832 |       return texs;
 833 |     }
 834 | 
 835 |     /**
 836 |      * Get cached textures for mini cubes with solid colors (no patterns, no gloss)
 837 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 solid color textures
 838 |      */
 839 |     function getMiniStickerTextures(){
 840 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs;
 841 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], false, false));
 842 |       STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs = texs;
 843 |       return texs;
 844 |     }
 845 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 846 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 847 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;
 848 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 849 |       const planes = [];
 850 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 851 |       const dirs = [
 852 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 853 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 854 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 855 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 856 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z

 872 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 873 |     /**
 874 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 875 |      *
 876 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 877 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 878 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 879 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 880 |      *
 881 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 882 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 883 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 884 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 885 |      *
 886 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 887 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 888 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 889 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 890 |      *
 891 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 892 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 893 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)
 894 |      * @returns {THREE.Mesh} Configured cube mesh with edges
 895 |      */
 896 |     function makeCube(size, fillColor, edgeColor, cubeIndex = 0) {
 897 |       const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
 898 |       let mesh;
 899 | 
 900 |       if (size > 0.1) {
 901 |         if (size >= 0.99) {
 902 |           // ===== LARGE CUBE CREATION =====
 903 |           // 27 large cubes forming the initial Rubik's cube structure
 904 |           const pats = fixedFaceAssignments.length > 0 ? fixedFaceAssignments.slice() : shuffle(FACE_PATTERNS.slice()); // Randomize pattern order per cube
 905 |           // Load all 6 bump map textures
 906 |           const bumpTextures = [1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n => {
 907 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 908 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 909 |             tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 910 |             tex.repeat.set(1, 1);
 911 |             return tex;
 912 |           });
 913 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 914 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 915 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out
 916 |             color: new THREE.Color(fillColor), // Use the fillColor parameter instead of hardcoded value
 917 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],
 918 |             bumpScale: 1.0, // Maximum bump effect
 919 |             transparent: false, // Opaque for performance
 920 |             depthWrite: false, // Disable depth writing to prevent z-fighting
 921 |             depthTest: true, // Still test depth for proper ordering
 922 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides (important for cube faces)
 923 |             metalness: 1.0, // Fully metallic
 924 |             roughness: 0.1, // Very shiny
 925 |             polygonOffset: true, // Offset depth to prevent z-fighting with edges
 926 |             polygonOffsetFactor: -4,
 927 |             polygonOffsetUnits: -4
 928 |           }));
 929 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mats); // Array of 6 materials, one per face
 930 |         } else {
 931 |           // ===== MINI CUBE CREATION =====
 932 |           // 729 mini cubes that emerge from within large cubes
 933 |          // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 934 |           // --- ORIGINAL MINI CUBE MATERIAL CREATION (commented out) ---
 935 |           // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 936 |           //   color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC), // Blue color for mini-cubes
 937 |           //   transparent: false, // Opaque
 938 |           //   opacity: 1.0, // Fully opaque
 939 |           //   depthWrite: true, // Enable depth writing to prevent see-through
 940 |           //   depthTest: true, // Test depth
 941 |           //   side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides
 942 |           //   metalness: 0.25, // Balanced metallic feel
 943 |           //   roughness: 0.5 // Balanced surface roughness
 944 |           // });
 945 |           // mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
 946 | 
 947 |           // --- MINI CUBE MATERIAL WITH NO GLOW/EMISSIVE ---
 948 |           const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 949 |             color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC),
 950 |             transparent: false,
 951 |             opacity: 1.0,
 952 |             depthWrite: true,
 953 |             depthTest: true,
 954 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide,
 955 |             metalness: 0.25,
 956 |             roughness: 0.5,
 957 |             emissive: new THREE.Color(0x000000), // No glow
 958 |             emissiveIntensity: 0.0 // No glow
 959 |           });
 960 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
 961 |         }
 962 |       } else {
 963 |         // ===== TINY CUBE CREATION =====
 964 |         // Smallest cubes in final sculpture formation
 965 |         const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
 966 |           color: fillColor,
 967 |           metalness: 1.0, // Highly metallic
 968 |           roughness: 0.25, // Smooth surface
 969 |           clearcoat: 1.0, // Clear coat layer for extra shine
 970 |           clearcoatRoughness: 0.15, // Smooth clear coat
 971 | //          envMapIntensity: 1.2 // Environment reflection intensity
 972 |         });
 973 |         mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat); // Single material for all faces
 974 |       }
 975 |       // ===== MESH CONFIGURATION =====
 976 |       mesh.castShadow = true; // Cast shadows for depth
 977 |       mesh.receiveShadow = true; // Receive shadows from other objects
 978 | 
 979 |       // ===== EDGE CREATION =====
 980 |       // Add edges for all cubes, but make mini-cube edges very thin
 981 |       const edges = new THREE.LineSegments(
 982 |         new THREE.EdgesGeometry(geom), // Extract edges from box geometry
 983 |         new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
 984 |           color: edgeColor, // Use provided edge color
 985 |           linewidth: size >= 0.99 ? 1 : 0.5 // Thin lines for mini-cubes
 986 |         })
 987 |       );
 988 |       edges.renderOrder = 10; // Render edges on top of faces
 989 |       mesh.add(edges); // Add as child so edges follow mesh transformations
 990 | 
 991 |       return mesh;
 992 |     }

 994 |     /**
 995 |      * Set fill color for all meshes in a 3D object hierarchy
 996 |      * Used for global color changes during different animation phases
 997 |      * @param {THREE.Object3D} obj3D - Root object to traverse
 998 |      * @param {number} color - Color value (hex number)
 999 |      */
1000 |     function setCubeFillColor(obj3D, color) {
1001 |       obj3D.traverse(o => {
1002 |         if (o.isMesh && o.material) {
1003 |           if (Array.isArray(o.material)) {
1004 |             // Handle multi-material meshes (cubes with different face materials)
1005 |             o.material.forEach(m => { if (m && m.color) m.color.set(color); });
1006 |           } else {
1007 |             // Handle single-material meshes
1008 |             if (o.material.color) o.material.color.set(color);
1009 |           }
1010 |         }
1011 |       });
1012 |     }

1198 |     // ===== MINI CUBE SYSTEM (729 PIECES) =====
1199 |     /**
1200 |      * Create the inner 729 mini-cubes that emerge from within the large cubes

1217 | 
1218 |       // Create 3x3x3 grid within each large cube
1219 |       for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
1220 |         for (let j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {

1222 |             const m = makeCube(MINI_SIZE, 0x1f2937, 0xffffff);

1228 |             m.userData.isCenter = (i === 0 && j === 0 && k === 0); // Center mini-cube flag
1229 |             m.userData.base = new THREE.Vector3(i, j, k); // Base position for animations
1230 |             m.userData.initialScale = 0.0001; // Start tiny for growth animation
1231 |             m.scale.setScalar(m.userData.initialScale);
1232 | 
1233 |             miniGroup.add(m);
1234 |             miniCubes.push(m);
1235 |           }
1236 |         }
1237 |       }
1238 |     }

 384 |         <h1>لحظة الحقيقة</h1>
 385 |         <h2>هل يجب أن تسلك هذا الطريق؟</h2>
 386 |         <p>We already did—and the answer is yes. But do it with eyes open. Complexity runs deeper than expected, and guidance is scarce. That’s why we built a model that captures the whole picture and makes the path navigable.</p>
 387 |       </div></section>

 389 |         <h1>أقفال في كل مكان</h1>
 390 |         <h2>ماذا كشفت سنتان؟</h2>
 391 |         <p>سنتان من العمل الدؤوب، فتحنا الحواجز واحدة تلو الأخرى. كل طبقة كشفت عن تبعيات جديدة، وكل مكعب أظهر روابط خفية. قطعة قطعة، تشكل التوأم الرقمي—خريطة حية للتعقيد. ومع اكتماله، قفز الذكاء الاصطناعي فجأة، وأصبح قويًا ومتوفراً، محولاً سنوات من الجهد إلى واقع عملي.</p>
 392 |       </div></section>

 396 |         <p>With the AI core in place, the Digital Twin comes alive. We’ve hit a milestone, but the journey is still unfolding. Two paths now await: a Knowledge Path, where you contribute ideas and shape the future of transformations; and a Builder Path, where you begin your own strategy execution journey and put the twin to work.</p>

 410 |   <script type="module">
 411 |     /**
 412 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 413 |      *
 414 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 415 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 416 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 417 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 418 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 419 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 420 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 421 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 422 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 423 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 424 |      *
 425 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 426 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 427 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 428 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 429 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 430 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 431 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 432 |      */
 433 | 
 434 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 435 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 436 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 437 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 438 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 439 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 440 | 
 441 |     // Background video speed control
 442 |     const bgVideo = document.querySelector('.bg-video');
 443 |     const VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE = 0.4;
 444 |     function applyVideoSpeed() { 
 445 |       try { if (bgVideo) bgVideo.playbackRate = VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE; } catch(_){}
 446 |     }
 447 |     if (bgVideo) { bgVideo.addEventListener('loadeddata', applyVideoSpeed); bgVideo.addEventListener('play', applyVideoSpeed); }
 448 |     applyVideoSpeed();
 449 |

 454 |       if (navPath && window.top) {

 459 |     function initializeNavigation() {

 463 |       });
