 467 | 
 468 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 469 |     /**
 470 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 471 |      */
 472 | 
 473 |     /**
 474 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 475 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 476 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 477 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 478 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 479 |      */
 480 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 481 | 
 482 |     /**
 483 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 484 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 485 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 486 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 487 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 488 |      */
 489 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 490 | 
 491 |     /**
 492 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 493 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 494 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 495 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 496 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 497 |      */
 498 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 499 | 
 500 |     /**
 501 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 502 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 503 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 504 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 505 |      */
 506 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 507 | 
 508 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 509 |     /**
 510 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 511 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 512 |      */
 513 | 
 514 |     /**
 515 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 516 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 517 |      */
 518 |     let externalProgress = null;
 519 | 
 520 |     /**
 521 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 522 |      * Supports two message types:
 523 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 524 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 525 |      */
 526 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 527 |       const data = e && e.data;
 528 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 529 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 530 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 531 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 532 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 533 |         externalProgress = null;
 534 |       }
 535 |     });
 536 | 
 537 |     /**
 538 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 539 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 540 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 541 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 542 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 543 |      */
 544 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 545 | 
 546 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 547 |     /**
 548 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 549 |      */
 550 | 
 551 |     /**
 552 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 553 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 554 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 555 |      */
 556 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 557 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 558 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 559 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 560 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 561 |     }
 562 | 
 563 |     /**
 564 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 565 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 566 |      */
 567 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 568 | 
 569 |     /**
 570 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 571 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 572 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 573 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 574 |      */
 575 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 576 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 577 |       const res = [];
 578 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 579 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 580 |       }
 581 |       return res;
 582 |     }
 583 | 
 584 |     /**
 585 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 586 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 587 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 588 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 589 |      */
 590 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 591 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 592 |       for (const c of corners) {
 593 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 594 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 595 |       }
 596 |       return true;
 597 |     }
 598 | 
 599 |     /**
 600 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 601 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 602 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 603 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 604 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 605 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 606 |      */
 607 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 608 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 609 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 610 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 611 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 612 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 613 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 614 |       }
 615 |       return lo;
 616 |     }
 617 | 
 618 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 619 |     /**
 620 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 621 |      *
 622 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 623 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 624 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 625 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 626 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 627 |      *
 628 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 629 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 630 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 631 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 632 |      *
 633 |      * CACHING:
 634 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 635 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 636 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 637 |      */
 638 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 639 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 640 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 641 | 
 642 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 643 | 
 644 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 645 |       .then(response => response.json())
 646 |       .then(data => {
 647 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 648 |       })
 649 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 650 | 
 651 |     /**
 652 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 653 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 654 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 655 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 656 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 657 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 658 |      */
 659 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 660 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 661 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 662 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 663 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 664 | 
 665 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 666 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 667 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 668 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 669 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 670 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 671 | 
 672 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 673 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 674 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 675 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 676 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 677 |       ctx.fill();
 678 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 679 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 680 |       /**
 681 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 682 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 683 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 684 |        */
 685 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 686 |         ctx.save();
 687 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 688 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 689 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 690 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 691 | 
 692 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 693 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 694 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 695 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 696 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 697 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 698 | 
 699 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 700 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 701 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 702 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 703 |           // Vertical lines
 704 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 705 |             ctx.beginPath();
 706 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 707 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 708 |             ctx.stroke();
 709 |           }
 710 |           // Horizontal lines
 711 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 712 |             ctx.beginPath();
 713 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 714 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 715 |             ctx.stroke();
 716 |           }
 717 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 718 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 719 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 720 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 721 |             ctx.beginPath();
 722 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 723 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 724 |             ctx.stroke();
 725 |           }
 726 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 727 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 728 |           ctx.beginPath();
 729 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 730 |           ctx.stroke();
 731 |           ctx.beginPath();
 732 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 733 |           ctx.stroke();
 734 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 735 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 736 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 737 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 738 |             ctx.beginPath();
 739 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 740 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 741 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 742 |             ctx.stroke();
 743 |           }
 744 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 745 |           // Hexagon pattern
 746 |           const r = size*0.22;
 747 |           ctx.beginPath();
 748 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 749 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 750 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 751 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 752 |           }
 753 |           ctx.closePath();
 754 |           ctx.stroke();
 755 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 756 |           // Sine wave pattern
 757 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 758 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 759 |             ctx.beginPath();
 760 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 761 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 762 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 763 |             }
 764 |             ctx.stroke();
 765 |           }
 766 |         }
 767 |         ctx.restore();
 768 |       };
 769 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 770 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 771 | 
 772 |       if (drawGloss) {
 773 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 774 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 775 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 776 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 777 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 778 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 779 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 780 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 781 |         ctx.fill();
 782 |       }
 783 | 
 784 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 785 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 786 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 787 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 788 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 789 |       return tex;
 790 |     }
 791 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 792 | 
 793 |     /**
 794 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 795 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 796 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 797 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 798 |      */
 799 |     function shuffle(array) {
 800 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 801 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 802 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 803 |       }
 804 |       return array;
 805 |     }
 806 | 
 807 |     /**
 808 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 809 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 810 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 811 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 812 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 813 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 814 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 815 |      */
 816 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 817 |       ctx.beginPath();
 818 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 819 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 820 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 821 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 822 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 823 |       ctx.closePath();
 824 |     }
 825 | 
 826 |     /**
 827 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 828 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 829 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 830 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 831 |      */
 832 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 833 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 834 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 835 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 836 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 837 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 838 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 839 |     }
 840 |     /**
 841 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss
 842 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 textures, one per pattern
 843 |      */
 844 |     function getLargeStickerTextures(){
 845 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs;
 846 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 847 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;
 848 |       return texs;
 849 |     }
 850 | 
 851 |     /**
 852 |      * Get cached textures for mini cubes with solid colors (no patterns, no gloss)
 853 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 solid color textures
 854 |      */
 855 |     function getMiniStickerTextures(){
 856 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs;
 857 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], false, false));
 858 |       STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs = texs;
 859 |       return texs;
 860 |     }
 861 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 862 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 863 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;
 864 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 865 |       const planes = [];
 866 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 867 |       const dirs = [
 868 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 869 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 870 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 871 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 872 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z
 873 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z

 888 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 889 |     /**
 890 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 891 |      *
 892 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 893 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 894 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 895 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 896 |      *
 897 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 898 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 899 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 900 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 901 |      *
 902 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 903 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 904 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 905 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 906 |      *
 907 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 908 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 909 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)
 910 |      * @returns {THREE.Mesh} Configured cube mesh with edges
 911 |      */
 912 |     function makeCube(size, fillColor, edgeColor, cubeIndex = 0) {
 913 |       const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
 914 |       let mesh;
 915 | 
 916 |       if (size > 0.1) {
 917 |         if (size >= 0.99) {
 918 |           // ===== LARGE CUBE CREATION =====
 919 |           // 27 large cubes forming the initial Rubik's cube structure
 920 |           const pats = fixedFaceAssignments.length > 0 ? fixedFaceAssignments.slice() : shuffle(FACE_PATTERNS.slice()); // Randomize pattern order per cube
 921 |           // Load all 6 bump map textures
 922 |           const bumpTextures = [1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n => {
 923 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 924 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 925 |             tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 926 |             tex.repeat.set(1, 1);
 927 |             return tex;
 928 |           });
 929 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 930 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 931 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out
 932 |             color: new THREE.Color(fillColor), // Use the fillColor parameter instead of hardcoded value
 933 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],
 934 |             bumpScale: 1.0, // Maximum bump effect
 935 |             transparent: false, // Opaque for performance
 936 |             depthWrite: false, // Disable depth writing to prevent z-fighting
 937 |             depthTest: true, // Still test depth for proper ordering
 938 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides (important for cube faces)
 939 |             metalness: 1.0, // Fully metallic
 940 |             roughness: 0.1, // Very shiny
 941 |             polygonOffset: true, // Offset depth to prevent z-fighting with edges
 942 |             polygonOffsetFactor: -4,
 943 |             polygonOffsetUnits: -4
 944 |           }));
 945 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mats); // Array of 6 materials, one per face
 946 |         } else {
 947 |           // ===== MINI CUBE CREATION =====
 948 |           // 729 mini cubes that emerge from within large cubes
 949 |          // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 950 |           // --- ORIGINAL MINI CUBE MATERIAL CREATION (commented out) ---
 951 |           // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 952 |           //   color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC), // Blue color for mini-cubes
 953 |           //   transparent: false, // Opaque
 954 |           //   opacity: 1.0, // Fully opaque
 955 |           //   depthWrite: true, // Enable depth writing to prevent see-through
 956 |           //   depthTest: true, // Test depth
 957 |           //   side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides
 958 |           //   metalness: 0.25, // Balanced metallic feel
 959 |           //   roughness: 0.5 // Balanced surface roughness
 960 |           // });
 961 |           // mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
 962 | 
 963 |           // --- MINI CUBE MATERIAL WITH NO GLOW/EMISSIVE ---
 964 |           const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 965 |             color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC),
 966 |             transparent: false,
 967 |             opacity: 1.0,
 968 |             depthWrite: true,
 969 |             depthTest: true,
 970 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide,
 971 |             metalness: 0.25,
 972 |             roughness: 0.5,
 973 |             emissive: new THREE.Color(0x000000), // No glow
 974 |             emissiveIntensity: 0.0 // No glow
 975 |           });
 976 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
 977 |         }
 978 |       } else {
 979 |         // ===== TINY CUBE CREATION =====
 980 |         // Smallest cubes in final sculpture formation
 981 |         const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
 982 |           color: fillColor,
 983 |           metalness: 1.0, // Highly metallic
 984 |           roughness: 0.25, // Smooth surface
 985 |           clearcoat: 1.0, // Clear coat layer for extra shine
 986 |           clearcoatRoughness: 0.15, // Smooth clear coat
 987 | //          envMapIntensity: 1.2 // Environment reflection intensity
 988 |         });
 989 |         mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat); // Single material for all faces
 990 |       }
 991 |       // ===== MESH CONFIGURATION =====
 992 |       mesh.castShadow = true; // Cast shadows for depth
 993 |       mesh.receiveShadow = true; // Receive shadows from other objects
 994 | 
 995 |       // ===== EDGE CREATION =====
 996 |       // Add edges for all cubes, but make mini-cube edges very thin
 997 |       const edges = new THREE.LineSegments(
 998 |         new THREE.EdgesGeometry(geom), // Extract edges from box geometry
 999 |         new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
1000 |           color: edgeColor, // Use provided edge color
1001 |           linewidth: size >= 0.99 ? 1 : 0.5 // Thin lines for mini-cubes
1002 |         })
1003 |       );
1004 |       edges.renderOrder = 10; // Render edges on top of faces
1005 |       mesh.add(edges); // Add as child so edges follow mesh transformations
1006 | 
1007 |       return mesh;
1008 |     }

1010 |     /**
1011 |      * Set fill color for all meshes in a 3D object hierarchy
1012 |      * Used for global color changes during different animation phases
1013 |      * @param {THREE.Object3D} obj3D - Root object to traverse
1014 |      * @param {number} color - Color value (hex number)
1015 |      */
1016 |     function setCubeFillColor(obj3D, color) {
1017 |       obj3D.traverse(o => {
1018 |         if (o.isMesh && o.material) {
1019 |           if (Array.isArray(o.material)) {
1020 |             // Handle multi-material meshes (cubes with different face materials)
1021 |             o.material.forEach(m => { if (m && m.color) m.color.set(color); });
1022 |           } else {
1023 |             // Handle single-material meshes
1024 |             if (o.material.color) o.material.color.set(color);
1025 |           }
1026 |         }
1027 |       });
1028 |     }

1214 |     // ===== MINI CUBE SYSTEM (729 PIECES) =====
1215 |     /**
1216 |      * Create the inner 729 mini-cubes that emerge from within the large cubes

1218 |      * Mini-cubes are initially hidden and grow during Phase 4 transformation

1234 |       // Create 3x3x3 grid within each large cube
1235 |       for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {

1246 |             m.userData.initialScale = 0.0001; // Start tiny for growth animation
1247 |             m.scale.setScalar(m.userData.initialScale);
1248 | 
1249 |             miniGroup.add(m);
1250 |             miniCubes.push(m);
1251 |           }
1252 |         }
1253 |       }
1254 |     }

1559 |     // ===== Text-Phase Sync (pin text while animation runs given phases) =====
1560 |     function setupPhaseTextSync(){

1562 |       if (sections.length < 8) return; // expect 8 sections
1563 |       // Use a fixed scroll budget (the spacer) to avoid feedback loops that desync phases
1564 |       const spacer = document.querySelector('.spacer');
1565 |       const baseBudget = spacer ? parseFloat(getComputedStyle(spacer).height) || 20000 : 20000;
1566 |       // Mapping of section index (0-based) to one or more animation phases to pin through
1567 |       const mapping = new Map([
1568 |         [3, [2,3]],   // تشريح المنظمة: P2 + P3
1569 |         [4, [4]],     // العلاقات الخفية: P4
1570 |         [5, [5,6]],   // لحظة الحقيقة: P5 + P6
1571 |         [6, [7]],     // أقفال في كل مكان: P7
1572 |         [7, [8,9]],   // المستقبل جاهز اليوم: P8 + P9
1573 |       ]);
1574 |       let totalPads = 0;
1575 |       sections.forEach((sec, idx) => {
1576 |         let pad = sec.querySelector('.phase-pad');
1577 |         if (!pad) { pad = document.createElement('div'); pad.className = 'phase-pad'; sec.appendChild(pad); }
1578 |         let targetPx = 0;
1579 |         const phaseIds = mapping.get(idx);
1580 |         if (phaseIds){
1581 |           const ids = Array.isArray(phaseIds) ? phaseIds : [phaseIds];
1582 |           for (const id of ids) {
1583 |             const p = PHASES.find(pp => pp.id === id);
1584 |             if (p) targetPx += Math.max(0, Math.floor((p.end - p.start) * baseBudget));
1585 |           }
1586 |         }
1587 |         const needed = Math.max(0, targetPx);
1588 |         pad.style.height = needed + 'px';
1589 |         totalPads += needed;
1590 |       });
1591 |       // Offset pads by shrinking the spacer so total scroll stays aligned with the animation’s timeline
1592 |       if (spacer) {
1593 |         const minTail = 600; // keep extra tail so last sticky stays pinned through P9
1594 |         const newHeight = Math.max(minTail, baseBudget - totalPads + minTail);
1595 |         spacer.style.height = newHeight + 'px';
1596 |       }
1597 |     }

 226 |         <div class="phase-text-block" dir="rtl" data-key="intro-1">
 227 |           <h1>تحويل تنفيذ الاستراتيجية</h1>
 228 |           <h2>التعقيد كأصل</h2>
 229 |           <p>تفشل معظم التحولات لأن التعقيد يطغى عليها. لقد حولنا هذا التعقيد إلى ميزة—وأعدنا تعريف التخطيط والمخاطر ولوحات المعلومات داخل نموذج متكامل واحد.</p>
 230 |         </div>

 232 |           <h1>تخيل كونًا موازيًا</h1>
 233 |           <h2>حيث تتدفق التحولات</h2>
 234 |           <p>Let us show you a week in that universe — A Week in the Life of a Transformation Team <b><a href="/assets/aweekin.mp4">video</a></b>. Farfetched? It’s here. We built the MVP: a Net.js web app with a Supabase database and a Gemini Assistant, built on a five-year scenario dataset inspired by real transformation events.</p>
 235 |         </div>
 236 |         <div class="phase-text-block" dir="rtl" data-key="intro-3">
 237 |           <h1>كيف فعلنا ذلك؟</h1>
 238 |           <h2>الأسئلة الصحيحة أولاً</h2>
 239 |           <p>قبل الإجابات، تحتاج إلى الأسئلة الصحيحة. تبدأ هذه الرحلة باكتشاف الأسئلة الأكثر أهمية—تلك التي تكشف كيف يعمل التعقيد حقًا.</p>
 240 |         </div>
 241 |         <div class="phase-text-block" dir="rtl" data-key="p23-your-org">
 242 |           <h1>تشريح المنظمة</h1>
 243 |           <h2>ما الذي يصنع المنظمة؟</h2>
 244 |           <p>Many things, like a living system of systems—Strategy, Policies, Processes, Digital—shaped by external forces such as markets and global events. Real transformation means understanding how these components interact, not treating them in isolation.</p>
 245 |         </div>
 246 |         <div class="phase-text-block" dir="rtl" data-key="p4-hidden">
 247 |           <h1>العلاقات الخفية</h1>
 248 |           <h2>إلى أي عمق تصل؟</h2>
 249 |           <p>لكل مكون مدخلاته ومخرجاته وروابطه الخفية مع الآخرين. عندما تُرسم هذه الروابط، تظهر أنماط—هيكل يوضح لماذا تؤثر التغييرات الصغيرة على النظام بأكمله.</p>
 250 |         </div>
 251 |         <div class="phase-text-block" dir="rtl" data-key="p56-where">
 252 |           <h1>لحظة الحقيقة</h1>
 253 |           <h2>هل يجب أن تسلك هذا الطريق؟</h2>
 254 |           <p>We already did—and the answer is yes. But do it with eyes open. Complexity runs deeper than expected, and guidance is scarce. That’s why we built a model that captures the whole picture and makes the path navigable.</p>
 255 |         </div>
 256 |         <div class="phase-text-block" dir="rtl" data-key="p7-two-years">
 257 |           <h1>أقفال في كل مكان</h1>
 258 |           <h2>ماذا كشفت سنتان؟</h2>
 259 |           <p>سنتان من العمل الدؤوب، فتح حاجز تلو الآخر. كل طبقة كشفت عن تبعيات جديدة، كل مكعب أظهر روابط خفية. قطعة قطعة، تشكل التوأم الرقمي—خريطة حية للتعقيد. ومع تشكلها، قفز الذكاء الاصطناعي فجأة، أصبح قويًا ومتاحًا، محولاً سنوات من الجهد إلى واقع عملي.</p>
 260 |         </div>

 262 |           <h1>المستقبل جاهز اليوم</h1>
 263 |           <h2>أي طريق ستختار؟</h2>
 264 |           <p>With the final piece in place—the very heart of the solution—the AI breathed life into the Digital Twin, reigniting hope for true transformation. The journey is not over for us or you, it continues through two distinct hubs... Scroll down to explore.</p>

 394 |   <script type="module">
 395 |     /**
 396 |      * RUBIKS CUBE ANIMATION SYSTEM
 397 |      *
 398 |      * This script implements a complex 3D Rubik's cube animation with 9 distinct phases:
 399 |      * Phase 1: Idle/Gentle Float - Large cube with gentle rotation and hover
 400 |      * Phase 2: First Dismantle - Large pieces explode into cloud formation
 401 |      * Phase 3: Settle with Perspective - Pieces hover with random rotations
 402 |      * Phase 4: Rubik Transform - Large pieces shrink, mini-cubes (729 total) grow from within
 403 |      * Phase 5: Expand to 43.3% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud formation
 404 |      * Phase 6: Popcorn Recolor - Mini-cubes recolor from cyan to purple one-by-one
 405 |      * Phase 7: Dance - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
 406 |      * Phase 8: Morph to Sculpture - Transform into final spherical sculpture
 407 |      * Phase 9: Final Formation - Interactive phase with mouse controls
 408 |      *
 409 |      * KEY COMPONENTS:
 410 |      * - 27 Large cubes (3x3x3) with metallic patterns and randomized face arrangements
 411 |      * - 729 Mini-cubes (27x27x27) with solid blue colors that recolor to purple
 412 |      * - Procedural texture generation for realistic sticker patterns
 413 |      * - Physically-based lighting and post-processing effects
 414 |      * - Scroll-driven animation with external control support
 415 |      * - Interactive mouse controls in phases 1 and 9
 416 |      */
 417 | 
 418 |     import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js';
 419 |    // import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';
 420 |     import { EffectComposer } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
 421 |     import { RenderPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
 422 |     import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
 423 |     import { RoomEnvironment } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
 424 | 
 425 |     // Background video speed control
 426 |     const bgVideo = document.querySelector('.bg-video');
 427 |     const VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE = 0.4;
 428 |     function applyVideoSpeed() { 
 429 |       try { if (bgVideo) bgVideo.playbackRate = VIDEO_PLAYBACK_RATE; } catch(_){}
 430 |     }
 431 |     if (bgVideo) { bgVideo.addEventListener('loadeddata', applyVideoSpeed); bgVideo.addEventListener('play', applyVideoSpeed); }
 432 |     applyVideoSpeed();
 433 | 
 434 |     // ===== ENHANCED NAVIGATION FOR FINALE BUTTONS =====
 435 |     function handleNavigation(e) {
 436 |       e.preventDefault();
 437 |       const navPath = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('href');
 438 |       if (navPath && window.top) {
 439 |         window.top.location.hash = navPath;
 440 |       }
 441 |     }
 442 | 
 443 |     function initializeNavigation() {
 444 |       const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.finale-enter-btn');
 445 |       btns.forEach(btn => {
 446 |         btn.addEventListener('click', handleNavigation);
 447 |       });
 448 |     }
 449 |     
 450 |     setTimeout(initializeNavigation, 200); // Increased timeout for safety
 451 | 
 452 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 453 |     /**
 454 |      * Mathematical utility functions for animation calculations
 455 |      */
 456 | 
 457 |     /**
 458 |      * Clamps a value between min and max bounds
 459 |      * @param {number} x - Value to clamp
 460 |      * @param {number} a - Minimum bound
 461 |      * @param {number} b - Maximum bound
 462 |      * @returns {number} Clamped value
 463 |      */
 464 |     const clamp = (x, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
 465 | 
 466 |     /**
 467 |      * Linear interpolation between two values
 468 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 469 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 470 |      * @param {number} t - Interpolation factor (0-1)
 471 |      * @returns {number} Interpolated value
 472 |      */
 473 |     const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
 474 | 
 475 |     /**
 476 |      * Inverse linear interpolation - finds t value for a point between a and b
 477 |      * @param {number} a - Start value
 478 |      * @param {number} b - End value
 479 |      * @param {number} v - Value to find t for
 480 |      * @returns {number} Interpolation factor (0-1)
 481 |      */
 482 |     const invLerp = (a, b, v) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
 483 | 
 484 |     /**
 485 |      * Smooth easing function for natural animation curves
 486 |      * Uses cubic easing for smooth acceleration/deceleration
 487 |      * @param {number} t - Input value (0-1)
 488 |      * @returns {number} Eased value (0-1)
 489 |      */
 490 |     const easeInOut = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
 491 | 
 492 |     // ===== EXTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM =====
 493 |     /**
 494 |      * External progress control allows parent components to drive animation
 495 |      * Used by RubiksIframe component for programmatic control
 496 |      */
 497 | 
 498 |     /**
 499 |      * External progress override - when set, replaces scroll-based progress
 500 |      * @type {number|null} Value between 0-1, or null to use scroll
 501 |      */
 502 |     let externalProgress = null;
 503 | 
 504 |     /**
 505 |      * Message handler for external control from parent iframe
 506 |      * Supports two message types:
 507 |      * - RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS: Set animation progress (0-1)
 508 |      * - RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL: Return to scroll-based control
 509 |      */
 510 |     window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
 511 |       const data = e && e.data;
 512 |       if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
 513 |       if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_SET_PROGRESS') {
 514 |         const v = Number(data.value);
 515 |         if (!Number.isNaN(v)) externalProgress = clamp(v, 0, 1);
 516 |       } else if (data.type === 'RUBIKS_CLEAR_EXTERNAL') {
 517 |         externalProgress = null;
 518 |       }
 519 |     });
 520 | 
 521 |     /**
 522 |      * Calculate progress within a specific phase range
 523 |      * @param {number} global - Global progress (0-1)
 524 |      * @param {number} a - Phase start point
 525 |      * @param {number} b - Phase end point
 526 |      * @returns {number} Local phase progress (0-1)
 527 |      */
 528 |     function phaseProgress(global, a, b) { return invLerp(a, b, global); }
 529 | 
 530 |     // ===== VIEWPORT AND CAMERA UTILITIES =====
 531 |     /**
 532 |      * Functions for calculating camera frustum and ensuring objects fit in view
 533 |      */
 534 | 
 535 |     /**
 536 |      * Calculate world-space half-extents of camera viewport at distance
 537 |      * @param {THREE.Camera} cam - Camera to calculate for
 538 |      * @returns {Object} Object with halfW and halfH properties
 539 |      */
 540 |     function viewportWorldHalfExtents(cam) {
 541 |       const d = cam.position.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3());
 542 |       const halfH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * d;
 543 |       const halfW = halfH * cam.aspect;
 544 |       return { halfW, halfH };
 545 |     }
 546 | 
 547 |     /**
 548 |      * Normalized device coordinate padding - allows full viewport usage
 549 |      * Value of 1.0 means no safety margin, objects can touch viewport edges
 550 |      */
 551 |     const PAD_NDC = 1.0; // allow full viewport usage (no extra safety margin)
 552 | 
 553 |     /**
 554 |      * Generate all 8 corners of a cube
 555 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 556 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 557 |      * @returns {THREE.Vector3[]} Array of 8 corner positions
 558 |      */
 559 |     function cubeCorners(center, half) {
 560 |       const offs = [-1, 1];
 561 |       const res = [];
 562 |       for (const dx of offs) for (const dy of offs) for (const dz of offs) {
 563 |         res.push(new THREE.Vector3(center.x + dx*half, center.y + dy*half, center.z + dz*half));
 564 |       }
 565 |       return res;
 566 |     }
 567 | 
 568 |     /**
 569 |      * Check if a cube fits entirely within the camera viewport
 570 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} center - Cube center position
 571 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 572 |      * @returns {boolean} True if cube fits in view
 573 |      */
 574 |     function cornersFitInView(center, half) {
 575 |       const corners = cubeCorners(center, half);
 576 |       for (const c of corners) {
 577 |         const p = c.clone().project(camera);
 578 |         if (Math.abs(p.x) > PAD_NDC || Math.abs(p.y) > PAD_NDC || p.z < -1 || p.z > 1) return false;
 579 |       }
 580 |       return true;
 581 |     }
 582 | 
 583 |     /**
 584 |      * Find maximum scale along a direction that keeps cube in viewport
 585 |      * Uses binary search to find optimal position
 586 |      * @param {THREE.Vector3} dir - Direction vector
 587 |      * @param {number} R - Maximum radius to search
 588 |      * @param {number} half - Half-size of cube
 589 |      * @returns {number} Maximum scale factor that keeps cube in view
 590 |      */
 591 |     function clampAlongDirToFit(dir, R, half) {
 592 |       // binary search max s in [0, R] such that corners fit
 593 |       let lo = 0, hi = R;
 594 |       for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
 595 |         const mid = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
 596 |         const pos = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(mid);
 597 |         if (cornersFitInView(pos, half)) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
 598 |       }
 599 |       return lo;
 600 |     }

 602 |     // ===== PROCEDURAL TEXTURE GENERATION SYSTEM =====
 603 |     /**
 604 |      * Dynamic texture creation for cube faces with various patterns and colors
 605 |      *
 606 |      * PATTERN SYSTEM:
 607 |      * - 6 distinct pattern types: grid, stripes, ring, chevron, hex, wave
 608 |      * - Each pattern is procedurally generated on 512x512 canvas
 609 |      * - Navy blue color palette with gradient backgrounds
 610 |      * - Optional gloss effects for metallic appearance
 611 |      *
 612 |      * RANDOMIZATION:
 613 |      * - Large cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 614 |      * - Mini cubes: Each gets 6 shuffled patterns, one per face
 615 |      * - Colors: 6 different blue shades for visual variety
 616 |      *
 617 |      * CACHING:
 618 |      * - Textures are cached to avoid recreation on each frame
 619 |      * - Large and mini textures cached separately
 620 |      * - Canvas-based generation for crisp, scalable results
 621 |      */
 622 |     const STICKER_CACHE = { largeTexs: null, miniTexs: null };
 623 |     const FACE_PATTERNS = ['grid','stripes','ring','chevron','hex','wave'];
 624 |     const BLUES = ['#000033','#000066','#000099','#0000CC','#000033','#000066'];
 625 | 
 626 |     let fixedFaceAssignments = [];
 627 | 
 628 |     fetch('/faces.json')
 629 |       .then(response => response.json())
 630 |       .then(data => {
 631 |         fixedFaceAssignments = data.faces.map(face => face.pattern);
 632 |       })
 633 |       .catch(error => console.error('Error loading face patterns:', error));
 634 | 
 635 |     /**
 636 |      * Create a procedural sticker texture with pattern and optional gloss
 637 |      * @param {string} pattern - Pattern type: 'grid', 'stripes', 'ring', 'chevron', 'hex', 'wave'
 638 |      * @param {string} baseHex - Base color in hex format (e.g., '#000066')
 639 |      * @param {boolean} drawPatterns - Whether to draw the pattern overlay
 640 |      * @param {boolean} drawGloss - Whether to add gloss/highlight effect
 641 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture} Generated texture for Three.js
 642 |      */
 643 |     function createStickerTexture(pattern, baseHex, drawPatterns = true, drawGloss = true){
 644 |       const size = 512; // High resolution for crisp textures
 645 |       const c = document.createElement('canvas');
 646 |       c.width = c.height = size;
 647 |       const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
 648 | 
 649 |       // Create gradient background for depth
 650 |       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,size);
 651 |       grad.addColorStop(0, baseHex); // Primary color
 652 |       grad.addColorStop(1, shadeHex(baseHex, -20)); // Darker shade for depth
 653 |       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
 654 |       ctx.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 655 | 
 656 |       // Inner rounded rectangle for sticker inset effect
 657 |       const inset = Math.floor(size * 0.08); // 8% inset from edges
 658 |       roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor(size*0.06));
 659 |       ctx.fillStyle = shadeHex(baseHex, -35); // Even darker for inset shadow
 660 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22; // Semi-transparent inset
 661 |       ctx.fill();
 662 |       ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // Reset alpha
 663 |       // ===== PATTERN DRAWING SYSTEM =====
 664 |       /**
 665 |        * Draw specific pattern on the texture
 666 |        * Each pattern is centered and uses white strokes with drop shadows
 667 |        * for raised 3D appearance
 668 |        */
 669 |       const drawPattern = (name) => {
 670 |         ctx.save();
 671 |         ctx.translate(size/2, size/2); // Center coordinate system
 672 |         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1.0)'; // Pure white for maximum contrast
 673 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; // Semi-transparent white for fills
 674 |         ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(8, size*0.015); // Responsive line width
 675 | 
 676 |         // Drop shadow for raised 3D effect
 677 |         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,1.0)';
 678 |         ctx.shadowBlur = Math.max(12, size*0.03);
 679 |         ctx.shadowOffsetX = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 680 |         ctx.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(5, size*0.01);
 681 |         // ===== INDIVIDUAL PATTERN IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
 682 | 
 683 |         if (name === 'grid') {
 684 |           // Grid pattern: Regular intersecting lines
 685 |           ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
 686 |           const step = Math.floor(size/10); // 10 divisions
 687 |           // Vertical lines
 688 |           for(let x=inset; x<=size-inset; x+=step){
 689 |             ctx.beginPath();
 690 |             ctx.moveTo(x,inset);
 691 |             ctx.lineTo(x,size-inset);
 692 |             ctx.stroke();
 693 |           }
 694 |           // Horizontal lines
 695 |           for(let y=inset; y<=size-inset; y+=step){
 696 |             ctx.beginPath();
 697 |             ctx.moveTo(inset,y);
 698 |             ctx.lineTo(size-inset,y);
 699 |             ctx.stroke();
 700 |           }
 701 |         } else if (name === 'stripes') {
 702 |           // Diagonal stripe pattern
 703 |           ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/6); // 30-degree angle
 704 |           for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
 705 |             ctx.beginPath();
 706 |             ctx.moveTo(-size, i*32);
 707 |             ctx.lineTo(size, i*32);
 708 |             ctx.stroke();
 709 |           }
 710 |         } else if (name === 'ring') {
 711 |           // Concentric ring pattern
 712 |           ctx.beginPath();
 713 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.28,0,Math.PI*2); // Outer ring
 714 |           ctx.stroke();
 715 |           ctx.beginPath();
 716 |           ctx.arc(0,0,size*0.14,0,Math.PI*2); // Inner ring
 717 |           ctx.stroke();
 718 |         } else if (name === 'chevron') {
 719 |           // Chevron/V pattern
 720 |           for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
 721 |             const off = -size*0.15 + i*size*0.1;
 722 |             ctx.beginPath();
 723 |             ctx.moveTo(-size*0.25, off);
 724 |             ctx.lineTo(0, off+size*0.08);
 725 |             ctx.lineTo(size*0.25, off);
 726 |             ctx.stroke();
 727 |           }
 728 |         } else if (name === 'hex') {
 729 |           // Hexagon pattern
 730 |           const r = size*0.22;
 731 |           ctx.beginPath();
 732 |           for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
 733 |             const a = Math.PI/3*i; // 60-degree increments
 734 |             const x = r*Math.cos(a), y=r*Math.sin(a);
 735 |             if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 736 |           }
 737 |           ctx.closePath();
 738 |           ctx.stroke();
 739 |         } else if (name === 'wave') {
 740 |           // Sine wave pattern
 741 |           ctx.translate(-size*0.3, 0);
 742 |           for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
 743 |             ctx.beginPath();
 744 |             for(let x=-size*0.2; x<=size*0.2; x+=8){
 745 |               const y = Math.sin((x/50)+i)*size*0.04;
 746 |               if (x===-size*0.2) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 747 |             }
 748 |             ctx.stroke();
 749 |           }
 750 |         }
 751 |         ctx.restore();
 752 |       };
 753 |       // Apply pattern and gloss effects
 754 |       if (drawPatterns) drawPattern(pattern);
 755 | 
 756 |       if (drawGloss) {
 757 |         // ===== GLOSS/HIGHLIGHT EFFECT =====
 758 |         // Creates metallic shine effect on upper portion of texture
 759 |         const gloss = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);
 760 |         gloss.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); // Bright highlight at top
 761 |         gloss.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'); // Fade to middle
 762 |         gloss.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'); // Transparent at bottom
 763 |         ctx.fillStyle = gloss;
 764 |         roundedRect(ctx, inset, inset, size-2*inset, Math.floor((size-2*inset)*0.55), Math.floor(size*0.06));
 765 |         ctx.fill();
 766 |       }
 767 | 
 768 |       // ===== TEXTURE CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION =====
 769 |       const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
 770 |       tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; // Standard RGB color space
 771 |       tex.anisotropy = 8; // Anisotropic filtering for better quality at angles
 772 |       tex.needsUpdate = true; // Mark for GPU upload
 773 |       return tex;
 774 |     }
 775 |     // ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====
 776 | 
 777 |     /**
 778 |      * Shuffle array in-place using Fisher-Yates algorithm
 779 |      * Used to randomize pattern order for visual variety
 780 |      * @param {Array} array - Array to shuffle
 781 |      * @returns {Array} Same array, shuffled in place
 782 |      */
 783 |     function shuffle(array) {
 784 |       for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 785 |         const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
 786 |         [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
 787 |       }
 788 |       return array;
 789 |     }
 790 | 
 791 |     /**
 792 |      * Draw rounded rectangle path on canvas
 793 |      * @param {CanvasRenderingContext2D} ctx - Canvas context
 794 |      * @param {number} x - X position
 795 |      * @param {number} y - Y position
 796 |      * @param {number} w - Width
 797 |      * @param {number} h - Height
 798 |      * @param {number} r - Corner radius
 799 |      */
 800 |     function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
 801 |       ctx.beginPath();
 802 |       ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
 803 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
 804 |       ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
 805 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
 806 |       ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
 807 |       ctx.closePath();
 808 |     }
 809 | 
 810 |     /**
 811 |      * Shade hex color by adding/subtracting brightness
 812 |      * @param {string} hex - Hex color string (with or without #)
 813 |      * @param {number} amt - Amount to add/subtract (-255 to 255)
 814 |      * @returns {string} New hex color string
 815 |      */
 816 |     function shadeHex(hex, amt){
 817 |       const c = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
 818 |       const num = parseInt(c,16);
 819 |       const r = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>16)&0xff) + amt));
 820 |       const g = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, ((num>>8)&0xff) + amt));
 821 |       const b = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (num&0xff) + amt));
 822 |       return `#${(r<<16|g<<8|b).toString(16).padStart(6,'0')}`;
 823 |     }
 824 |     /**
 825 |      * Get cached textures for large cubes with full patterns and gloss
 826 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 textures, one per pattern
 827 |      */
 828 |     function getLargeStickerTextures(){
 829 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs;
 830 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true));
 831 |       STICKER_CACHE.largeTexs = texs;
 832 |       return texs;
 833 |     }
 834 | 
 835 |     /**
 836 |      * Get cached textures for mini cubes with solid colors (no patterns, no gloss)
 837 |      * @returns {THREE.CanvasTexture[]} Array of 6 solid color textures
 838 |      */
 839 |     function getMiniStickerTextures(){
 840 |       if (STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs) return STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs;
 841 |       const texs = FACE_PATTERNS.map((pat, i) => createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], false, false));
 842 |       STICKER_CACHE.miniTexs = texs;
 843 |       return texs;
 844 |     }
 845 |     function addStickers(mesh, size){
 846 |       const s = size * 0.94; // slight inset
 847 |       const offset = size/2 + 0.02;
 848 |       const mats = getLargeStickerMaterials();
 849 |       const planes = [];
 850 |       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(s, s);
 851 |       const dirs = [
 852 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), rot: [0, -Math.PI/2, 0] }, // +X
 853 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), rot: [0,  Math.PI/2, 0] }, // -X
 854 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 1, 0), rot: [ Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // +Y
 855 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0,-1, 0), rot: [-Math.PI/2, 0, 0] }, // -Y
 856 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0, 1), rot: [0, 0, 0] },           // +Z
 857 |         { n: new THREE.Vector3( 0, 0,-1), rot: [0,  Math.PI, 0] },    // -Z
 858 |       ];
 859 |       dirs.forEach((d, i) => {
 860 |         const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mats[i]);
 861 |         m.position.copy(d.n.clone().multiplyScalar(offset));
 862 |         m.rotation.set(d.rot[0], d.rot[1], d.rot[2]);
 863 |         m.renderOrder = 5;
 864 |         m.userData.sticker = true;
 865 |         m.name = `sticker-${i}`;
 866 |         mesh.add(m);
 867 |         planes.push(m);
 868 |       });
 869 |       return planes;
 870 |     }

 872 |     // ===== CUBE CREATION SYSTEM =====
 873 |     /**
 874 |      * Create a cube with size-appropriate materials and geometry
 875 |      *
 876 |      * SIZE-BASED MATERIAL SYSTEM:
 877 |      * - Large cubes (>0.99): MeshStandardMaterial with metallic properties and shuffled patterns
 878 |      * - Mini cubes (0.1-0.99): MeshBasicMaterial with solid blue colors for recoloring
 879 |      * - Tiny cubes (<0.1): MeshPhysicalMaterial with metallic properties
 880 |      *
 881 |      * MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
 882 |      * - Large: metalness=0.2, roughness=0.6, polygon offset for depth sorting
 883 |      * - Mini: Basic material for efficient recoloring during Phase 6
 884 |      * - Tiny: High metalness/roughness for metallic appearance
 885 |      *
 886 |      * EDGE SYSTEM:
 887 |      * - All cubes get LineSegments edges with dark navy color (#000033)
 888 |      * - Edges render on top (renderOrder=10) for crisp outlines
 889 |      * - Edges are added as children of the mesh for proper transformation
 890 |      *
 891 |      * @param {number} size - Cube size (determines material type)
 892 |      * @param {number} fillColor - Fill color for tiny cubes
 893 |      * @param {number} edgeColor - Edge color (typically dark navy)
 894 |      * @returns {THREE.Mesh} Configured cube mesh with edges
 895 |      */
 896 |     function makeCube(size, fillColor, edgeColor, cubeIndex = 0) {
 897 |       const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
 898 |       let mesh;
 899 | 
 900 |       if (size > 0.1) {
 901 |         if (size >= 0.99) {
 902 |           // ===== LARGE CUBE CREATION =====
 903 |           // 27 large cubes forming the initial Rubik's cube structure
 904 |           const pats = fixedFaceAssignments.length > 0 ? fixedFaceAssignments.slice() : shuffle(FACE_PATTERNS.slice()); // Randomize pattern order per cube
 905 |           // Load all 6 bump map textures
 906 |           const bumpTextures = [1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n => {
 907 |             const tex = new THREE.TextureLoader().load(`/assets/textures/cubeface${n}.png`);
 908 |             tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 909 |             tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 910 |             tex.repeat.set(1, 1);
 911 |             return tex;
 912 |           });
 913 |           // Randomly assign bump map to each face
 914 |           const mats = pats.map((pat, i) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 915 |             // map: createStickerTexture(pat, BLUES[i%BLUES.length], true, true), // Pattern overlay commented out
 916 |             color: new THREE.Color(fillColor), // Use the fillColor parameter instead of hardcoded value
 917 |             bumpMap: bumpTextures[Math.floor(Math.random()*6)],
 918 |             bumpScale: 1.0, // Maximum bump effect
 919 |             transparent: false, // Opaque for performance
 920 |             depthWrite: false, // Disable depth writing to prevent z-fighting
 921 |             depthTest: true, // Still test depth for proper ordering
 922 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides (important for cube faces)
 923 |             metalness: 1.0, // Fully metallic
 924 |             roughness: 0.1, // Very shiny
 925 |             polygonOffset: true, // Offset depth to prevent z-fighting with edges
 926 |             polygonOffsetFactor: -4,
 927 |             polygonOffsetUnits: -4
 928 |           }));
 929 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mats); // Array of 6 materials, one per face
 930 |         } else {
 931 |           // ===== MINI CUBE CREATION =====
 932 |           // 729 mini cubes that emerge from within large cubes
 933 |          // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 934 |           // --- ORIGINAL MINI CUBE MATERIAL CREATION (commented out) ---
 935 |           // const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 936 |           //   color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC), // Blue color for mini-cubes
 937 |           //   transparent: false, // Opaque
 938 |           //   opacity: 1.0, // Fully opaque
 939 |           //   depthWrite: true, // Enable depth writing to prevent see-through
 940 |           //   depthTest: true, // Test depth
 941 |           //   side: THREE.DoubleSide, // Render both sides
 942 |           //   metalness: 0.25, // Balanced metallic feel
 943 |           //   roughness: 0.5 // Balanced surface roughness
 944 |           // });
 945 |           // mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
 946 | 
 947 |           // --- MINI CUBE MATERIAL WITH NO GLOW/EMISSIVE ---
 948 |           const miniMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
 949 |             color: new THREE.Color(0x0066CC),
 950 |             transparent: false,
 951 |             opacity: 1.0,
 952 |             depthWrite: true,
 953 |             depthTest: true,
 954 |             side: THREE.DoubleSide,
 955 |             metalness: 0.25,
 956 |             roughness: 0.5,
 957 |             emissive: new THREE.Color(0x000000), // No glow
 958 |             emissiveIntensity: 0.0 // No glow
 959 |           });
 960 |           mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, miniMaterial); // Single metallic material for all faces
 961 |         }
 962 |       } else {
 963 |         // ===== TINY CUBE CREATION =====
 964 |         // Smallest cubes in final sculpture formation
 965 |         const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
 966 |           color: fillColor,
 967 |           metalness: 1.0, // Highly metallic
 968 |           roughness: 0.25, // Smooth surface
 969 |           clearcoat: 1.0, // Clear coat layer for extra shine
 970 |           clearcoatRoughness: 0.15, // Smooth clear coat
 971 | //          envMapIntensity: 1.2 // Environment reflection intensity
 972 |         });
 973 |         mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat); // Single material for all faces
 974 |       }

1414 |     // ===== ANIMATION PHASE SYSTEM =====
1415 |     /**

1418 |      *
1419 |      * PHASE TIMING (as percentage of total scroll):
1420 |      * 1: 0.00-2.01% - Initial idle state with gentle floating
1421 |      * 2: 2.01-12.06% - Large cubes explode into cloud formation
1422 |      * 3: 12.06-14.48% - Pieces settle with random rotations
1423 |      * 4: 14.48-31.38% - Large cubes shrink, mini-cubes emerge
1424 |      * 5: 31.38-43.0% - Mini-cubes expand outward in cloud
1425 |      * 6: 43.0-52.0% - Mini-cubes recolor cyan to purple one-by-one
1426 |      * 7: 52.0-62.0% - Mini-cubes swirl and orbit in complex patterns
1427 |      * 8: 62.0-70.0% - Transform into final spherical sculpture
1428 |      * 9: 70.0-100% - Interactive final formation with mouse controls
1429 |      */

1437 |       { id: 7, start: 0.52, end: 0.62, label: 'Phase 7 — Dance' },
1438 |       { id: 8, start: 0.62, end: 0.70, label: 'Phase 8 — Final Morph' },

1553 |         [4, [4]],     // العلاقات الخفية: P4
